name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Las Vegas City Center

reviews.title: Billing problems
reviews.text: An issue occurred which required my contacting the hotel. A young, professional, understanding, considerate assistant by the name of Latanya, took the time to listen, understand and correct the problem. She put me at ease with my concerns and took care of the situation. I cannot thank her enough.

reviews.title: Business long-term stay
reviews.text: Didn't have a choice staying here due to work selecting the location. However I have grown to like this location. Hotel are just walls and a roof but homewood suites staff has gone above and beyond my expectations, this is how a hotel stands out. LATANYA at the front desk,  especially went out of her way when I needed assistance when I was having complications with my account.  HOMEWOOD SUITES do everything you can to keep her on your staff!

reviews.title: Incredible hotel stay!
reviews.text: I don’t normally write reviews, but in this case I need too. I checked in, and had the pleasure of meeting the most friendly front desk agent EVER!!! Latanya was very informative, well spoken, and personable. This lady is the most amazing person! My stay was amazing, and I’ll definitely be coming back on my next trip to Vegas. Please make sure that Latanya knows that she made all the difference in my experience here. Kudos to this amazing employee at  your company!!

reviews.title: Not a Hilton property by the service and quality level
reviews.text: The manager was very rude when requesting vegetarian/ vegan breakfast options and said we (3 of us who stayed 13 nights) should go to the next door hotel as an alternative where they charged for breakfast. The room was very dated with old furnishings and dirty walls. The carpet is deliberately dark but could tell the extensive extremely ground in dirt. Lamps were dirty and loose..USB connector was broken... bedding unironed even when room was remade 4 days later... lots of things wrong. Curtains were dirty. I would not put the Hilton label to this property. I give the 3 stars for the staff that were friendly and professional as you would expect....Shanta...Latanja were lovely. Would not stay here again.

reviews.title: Latanya Made My Stay Extraordinary!
reviews.text: From the moment I checked in, Latanya provided the warmest welcome! She was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and professional, making the entire process smooth and enjoyable. Her kind demeanor and helpful nature set the tone for a fantastic stay. The hotel’s location is perfect—off the strip but still within easy walking distance. I’ll definitely be back, and I hope Latanya gets the recognition she deserves for her outstanding service!

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: I had a great experience staying at the Homewood Suites Las Vegas City Center. The hotel’s staff, Latanya, Katherine, and Renee provided excellent customer service. They were able to answer questions and offer helpful suggestions. The location is within walking distance to the strip and the restaurant at the Hilton Garden Inn is right next door.

reviews.title: City Center - The Hidden Gem Of Las Vegas
reviews.text: This Homewood Suites is a true gem! It’s tucked away but only a 15 min walk over the bridge to the strip! I arrived shortly after 11pm and was greeted by the most lovely front desk clerk. Latanya had everything set up ahead of time, which made the check in process quick and easy. She said she is not new to the hotel but new to front desk but you cannot tell.. THIS LADY IS A PRO!!!!! I felt like the staff somehow knew I had a long day of traveling and wanted to go above and beyond to make me comfortable! This is a beautiful property and breakfast was a HIT as well! 10/10 would recommend. Thank you all for a great experience.

reviews.title: Great staff!
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of interacting with Gabriela and Latanya at the front desk, and I cannot say enough about their outstanding customer service! When I arrived, Gabriela was warm, welcoming, and incredibly attentive to my needs. She went above and beyond to ensure that my experience was seamless, answering all my questions with patience and a genuine willingness to help.Both Latanya and Gabriela kindness truly stood out, making me feel valued and well taken care of. It’s rare to come across people as dedicated and personable, and I sincerely appreciate their efforts.The hotel was clean, great amenities and a quick Lyft to the strip. Would absolutely stay again when I visit Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Good shuttle driver
reviews.text: Was good the shuttle driver Jacque was great made the trip worthy it very friendly and on time she should get a raise she works hard.Took us right to where we need to go and made sure we had everything we need..plz notice her she definitely deserves it..I don't how long she been with you but you have a great person working for youAnd the hotel was very nice also

reviews.title: Negative
reviews.text: Absolute lack of courtesy from the lobby staff, which does not solve any problem presented by the group. The rooms do not match the reservations and deliver as supposed beds sofas that have broken springs in the mattress! The rooms are not regoverned daily and I do not pay to make beds and clean bathrooms. Not recommended. It's also far from the center

reviews.title: Amazing staff. Felt like family
reviews.text: This was one of the best stays I’ve ever had. Our housekeeper, Yessenia polished the place from head to toe! She is fabulous! She even folded my blanket that I brought from home and left it on the bed for me. Also, Dre is the one of the best at the front desk. He represents the company proudly and professionally :)

reviews.title: Staying here for an extended stay and greatly appreciated the hospitality
reviews.text: Being here for an extended stay, I was very pleased to be welcomed by Dre (the front desk receptionist). He is very hospitable, and always has a smile on his face. From coming down to breakfast at 6:30am, to having dinner at 7pm, he is always eager to make our stay more pleasurable.

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: Hotel was great! Wonderful service, very helpful staff! Very clean and kept. Dre in particular represents exceptional quality service! Always a smiling face when you come through the lobby morning, noon, or night. He’s very versatile in his services helping with anything you need! He’s such a fun lively sprit that will bring a smile to anyone’s face. Would highly recommend have an extended stay here for your next trip to Vegas!

reviews.title: Thanks for the warm welcome Mya!
reviews.text: Having had the opportunity to interact with Mya one of Homewood Suites Las Vegas amazing employees, I was able to have a nice visit while on business in Las Vegas.  Mya gave me a very warm welcome and even offered me a bottle of water which made me feel special particularly working in the summer heat.  I am happy to know that it’s the little things that Mya has done which is definitely taking customer service to a higher level raising the bar that other hotels cannot compete with from a hospitality perspective.

reviews.title: Sept 2024 weekend
reviews.text: There are only 3 Homewood suites here in Vegas and this is #1 closest to strip but would still go to this one because of cleanliness and the amazing staff.  Allan R. was a true Hilton ambassador this weekend and helped make this trip one to remember.  A++++++ service and support!!!

reviews.title: Comfortable stay and accommodative staff
reviews.text: We stayed during the labor day weekend 2024 and enjoyed our visit particularly we stayed with kids and we needed help with the Hilton staff. They were very accomodative. Specially Dre Williams(Manager) Also the location is very close to the las vegas strip and 35 mins from hoover dam.

reviews.title: Our Homewood Experience (WE LOVE DRE)
reviews.text: There were nice workers and we made one friend named Dre. He was helpful and kind. Dre also helped us navigate the Strip and where we should start. The rooms were nice and comfy, the air-con was cold. They give free breakfast when you get a room.

reviews.title: Dre, at the front desk, SUPERB SERIVCE!
reviews.text: Dre at the front desk greeted us as we first checked into the hotel and he was full of energy and was so helpful. He definitely was the highlight of the stay. My kids simply adored him and his personality. He was very welcoming and helpful. He gave us tips on how to walk the strip and tricks on where to park. He gave us recommendations and we saw it to fruition and we did not regret it. It's one of those hidden gem staff that a hotel has that just makes the stay very comfortable and well worth coming back to because we know that our stay will be well worth the trip. We can't Thank you guys enough for the stay. We love it and will be coming back for sure.

reviews.title: The best breakfast I’ve had in a while!
reviews.text: The gravy was my grandparents favorite by far but the waffles were so fluffy and crunchy! The room was so clean! Thank you Virginia! I was pleasantly surprised to have the shampoo, conditioner, and the body soap full! The staff was so nice and welcoming. Especially Dre at the front desk! Definitely will return!

reviews.title: One of the only hotels in Vegas that allow cats
reviews.text: Absolutely. Love this hotel, especially because it was the only hotel that would allow me to have my cat. All the other hotels in Vegas only allow dogs. Their host tell staff is very accommodating and friendly. I would definitely recommend this hotel.  I especially have to give a big. Thank you to Dre, who helped me when i had a family emergency, and continue to check on me throughout my stay.

reviews.title: Great stay. Great staff.
reviews.text: Great location just a short walk off the strip.  .3 miles to the Aria resort.  Very clean and comfortable rooms. Amazing breakfast buffet.  The staff at this hotel were extremely professional and refreshingly friendly, especially Latanya.  Her pleasant demeanor during our breakfast made the start of our day perfect.

reviews.title: Hard pass
reviews.text: This is the most unwelcoming and unfriendly hotel I have ever stayed at. If you’re looking for a clean, spacious room, you got it. As long as you never need to stop by the front desk, you’ll be fine. If you don’t mind being treated like a nuisance instead of a guest, then you’ll be fine. If customer service, or even the least bit of cordiality is important to you, then don’t stay here. Katerine is very unhappy in this job and it shows. The rest of the front desk are no better. They act like sulky teenagers and you are the annoying parents. Management, how is it acceptable to allow all of them to behave like this? They need serious training on customer interaction.Homewood Suites is my favorite of Hilton brands, because of their 2 bedroom suites and breakfast each morning. We were in town to move our daughter into UNLV, so we will be coming back to Vegas a few times a year to visit. Our poor experience began right at check in and it was so unpleasant, it just left a cloud hanging over the entire stay. We will never stay here again, not when there is an abundance of properties in Las Vegas that provide an excellent guest experience all around.

reviews.title: A Beautiful Place to Stay
reviews.text: We love this hotel! The gorgeous pool, the well balanced fitness room, scrumptious complimentary breakfast, Wednesday evening meal fit for a King, and the  landscaping  around this property is just beautiful. The staff is friendly, helpful, and wants to please. Thank you Dre (front desk) for entertaining and informing us over our favorite sport-Basketball! With that said, we did notice some areas that lacked some attention. -The hotel is operating on one super slow elevator. The second elevator was still inoperable for the ten days we stayed. -During our stay , the pools hot tub was out of order for three of the 10 days. Maybe this out of the hotels control if hotel guests are responsible. -We don’t come to Vegas to drive a car, but we love the walk to the strip to get our daily step count. The concern: how can we make this walk safer as the homeless situation has worsened. They haven’t caused us problems yet, but some obviously have mental health issues. Possibly schedule some hotel shuttle trips to the strip? An Uber to Aria is currently $10 each way (that does includes tip). All in all this is still one of the best places in all of Vegas to stay with no resort fee. It may be the only property in Vegas that doesn’t require the ridiculous resort fee and a complimentary breakfast. Please keep this policy going. Also, please keep the 20% discount  for Homewood guests to walk 30 steps over to the Hilton Garden Inn restaurant. The food there is outstanding and  the severs are even better. It’s our family refuge after a long day of walking and shopping. Our thanks to everyone there who made our trip another memorable one!!!!

reviews.title: Wonderful experience!!!
reviews.text: The friendliness of the staff is fabulous, they helped us with everything we asked. The bed is comfortable the cleanliness was excellent I recommend The hotel was calm and family friendly, I felt relaxed and the breakfast was exquisite the clean and quiet pool area I recommend *****

reviews.title: 4 Star hotel stay-could have gone smoother, but would def stay again!
reviews.text: This was a terrific hotel stay. The rooms are quite large and squeaky clean! Parking was a breeze, the staff was friendly & the morning buffet was great! The only reasons I’m not giving 5 stars - I checked in very late, 2 am, which cancelled my prepaid reservation, and was charged for 2 day’s stay. But that was resolved by the fantastic management staff. Also at 2am, it took a few minutes to get into the lobby as the main doors were locked. Luckily someone was coming out and I was able to sneak in and alert someone at the front desk to checkin.

reviews.title: 10/10 Recommend
reviews.text: We've stayed in plenty of places but LOVE LOVE LOVE this property! Not too far from the strip, clean rooms, beautiful pool, & AMAZING STAFF! Latanya is THE BEST! Breakfast was great! We can't wait for our next visit at the end of summer! Thank you so much for a wonderful experience!

reviews.title: Amazing accommodation.
reviews.text: If you want to stay in vegas and gamble don't stay here. If you want a spotless accommodation a lovely pool and brilliant breakfast stay here. The staff are always helpful and with only 15 minutes walk to the strip close enough for all the casinos.

reviews.title: Terrific one week stay!
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for a week at the end of January. She was in town for work while I tagged along to play. Last year, we stayed next door at the Hilton Garden Inn. This year we decided to try the sister hotel next door and are glad we did. You get more bang for your buck at this hotel than the HGI. Breakfast bar is included with your room and the rooms are larger, more comfortable than HGI. Hot breakfast each morning with a variety of choices for meat, eggs, potatoes, etc. each day along with pastries, muffins, yogurt, fruit, cold and hot cereals, plus several juices and hot coffee. All prepared and served with a smile by some of the most friendly and courteous hotel kitchen staff I have ever encountered. Dre was one of our most favorite employees we met and had a chance to speak with almost every day we were there. The entire staff - front desk, house keeping, food service - were some of the best hotel employees we have enjoyed meeting anywhere we have stayed. We received daily text from the front desk asking how are stay was going and if we needed anything. One of the best things about this hotel is it's location. Very quiet, you wouldn't know you were right next to the interstate and a block away from the Strip. Dean Martin Blvd. is a great alternative to beat the traffic of I-15 or the Strip. Several dining options close by as well as other hotels and casinos.Can't think of any negatives about this place other than we had to leave.

reviews.title: Hotel Recommended
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at this Homewood Suites! The staff was very friendly and accommodating. Accommodating meaning we were able to check in early, extra towels and pillows were promptly brought to our room. In addition, there is always someone at the front desk. During our stay whether early in the morning, afternoon, or late evening, we always saw someone manning the front desk.Location: Lyft friendly, off the strip, really no view of the strip, maybe a partial view depending on where your room is located. There are 6 floors total. The onsite restaurant is not open to serving until 5 pm daily so if you miss breakfast, you only have In & Out that is walking distance. Otherwise you can DoorDash or take an Lyft/Uber to a place to eat. Amenities: Onsite Laundry (you will need quarters where you can ask the front desk to give you change), small shop where you can buy snacks, medicine, and drinks, etc. One of the main reasons why we stayed here was for the full kitchen that included a full size fridge, microwave, plates, glasses, and utensils plus cookware including a toaster, coffee maker (could be used for hot water too). We didn't use the pool but it looked to be an average size as we walked past it. The complimentary breakfast was different every day and we took advantage of the free meal before we started our day. It gets pretty crowded FYI. You have the option to take everything back to your room or sit in the dining area. They are always making sure there is enough food for everyone. You will see them cleaning the counters, tidying up spills right away, and some of workers are even going to the tables inquiring with guests how their stay is so far. There are two elevators total. We had no issues going up and down without a wait. Room: Awesome room (Room 234), very spacious on the 2nd floor. I prefer a higher floor but we wanted to check in early since we got there early morning around 9 am.  Partial view of the strip but mostly of the building next door and the highway. The only item and this is nit-picking were the walls of the room were very thin. You can literally hear ppl's conversations and their toilet flushing lol. In addition, be careful to not touch some of the walls (at least in our room) as it is very rough. Especially in the kitchen by the fridge and entrance area, hubby and I got a couple of scrapes on our arms and knuckles where we had to put a band-aid. I would think you would especially need to be careful if you had children with you. I am not sure if all the rooms were set up like ours but our stay would have been 5 stars and a perfect stay if it were not for that. Not sure why only the bathroom and wall in back of the bed headboard had wallpaper? We thought that was weird as we have stayed at multiple Homewoods in SoCal and on the East Coast, we did not have this issue.The question being would we come back? The answer is yes, but I would want to stay on the 6th floor preferably with no one above me and a corner room so we are only sharing one wall. Otherwise great job to everyone at this hotel for making our 4 days an enjoyable stay!

reviews.title: Right Across From the Strip
reviews.text: Second visit to this hotel within 6 years. Great location. Just across the interstate from the strip. Parking fee under $20 a day (garage).Structurally connected to the Hilton Garden Inn. Outside pool and hot tub. Large dining (breakfast area). But some of the tables were uneven (leg wise).In and Out restaurant within walking distance. Rideshares usually best option for a 10 minute drive from this hotel. About 10 minutes to Airport.Great customer service. Evening social on Wednesdays. Studio suites and 1 bedroom suites very roomy. Prices increase during spring break season. Breakfast options were not as good as my previous stay, but it was free and supplemental. Beautiful pool scenery and seating around the hotel entrance and pool. I would check several sites for prices but I'd definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Great Breakfast
reviews.text: The hotel was nice and clean.  The parking was easy in adjoining parking garage. One of the highlights was the hot breakfast each morning made by Latanya and team. The hotel was busy, but they were always attentive and  were so friendly!  We enjoyed our stay.

reviews.title: Perfect for a family stay
reviews.text: We were visiting last Vegas as a familyOf 5 (my husband and I with our 3 young kids ages 8.4 and under 1). I had originally booked a casino hotel on the strip but last minute we cancelled the reservation and booked this hotel and I am sooo glad we did!The hotel so lovely and clean, and it had a really nice homely feel to it. The staff were lovely and friendly and the area felt really safe.We easily walked to the strip from the hotel with the 3 kids with no issues (however we did this during the day…I’m not sure if the trip would be okay to do at night, but during the day it felt very safe indeed. Another day we got an Uber into the strip and that was pretty easy and quick to do too.The breakfast was lovely and an added bonus of a free dinner/snacks aswell. The kids loved it.The pool was lovely and the kids had so much fun in there. It was pretty simple but the kids were just happy with any swimming pool.It was nice and quiet and actually after a day on the strip doing various activities it felt really nice to come away a little off the strip and it be nice and quiet.I would 100% recommend anyone staying with families to stay here :)

reviews.title: Thanks Dre!
reviews.text: Dre helped me find my ear pod and went the extra mile.I returned to the the hotel 3 times and the final time he was determined to assist me with what I needed rather than turning me away.  As Find my ear pods was clearly stating they were in the room where I stayed.

reviews.title: Awesome customer service.
reviews.text: Cleans rooms, very helpful staff Mya is the best. Friendly and helpful. Had some issues with me stay she sorted out said issues. And got me on my way. Would definitely recommend staying here, and will be staying here on future business trips.

reviews.title: Great Family spot
reviews.text: We booked our family vacation from Canada to Vegas to see the grand canyon, hover dam and red rock. We were pleasantly surprised at how nice this hotel was for our family.Our only suggestion is for the pool to be a little warmer.Breakfast was great for 3 days, staff was very accommodating friendly and helpful. Specifically a staff member "Dre" who provided help on multiple occasions, provided local suggestions and made us feel very welcome.Rooms were clean and well kept. Location is off the strip but walk able. "In and out Burger" around the corner is fast and delicious for a late night snack.Will return, and recommend 100%.

reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.text: Nice, clean, friendly place to stay:). Stayed here many times before and I am still pleased with the service and comfort.  Latanya is so sweet and took care of us at the hot breakfast!  A great place for families as well as business needs.  Convenient to the Strip, without all the noise and chaos.

reviews.title: multiple rooms, all located close to each other and billing after the group departed was all confirmed with no issues
reviews.text: multiple rooms, all located close to each other and billing after the group departed was all confirmed with no issues

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: The light bites and snacks were delicious and the perfect snack serving sizes. The server Dre was very polite and considerate of my hyper kids, my kids also forgot cookies and he went out of his way to bring them cookie to the table. I would highly recommend.

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Mya at the front desk was very helpful!  She helped me with directions to an event I was attending.  One morning I was working in the dining area and she was kind enough to get me some hot water when I asked her for it. It was nice of her to do that when I could see she was very busy. Very nice, polite, & professional young lady.  I travel a lot for business and appreciate this when it happens.

reviews.title: Very welcoming and  well maintained
reviews.text: First off let me start by saying how welcoming and caring the staff is here at this location. Dre and Angela took care of all of our needs and questions , an absolute blessing and phenomenal hospitality. Highly recommend this location beautiful property.

reviews.title: Exactly what we were looking for.
reviews.text: We were met by Latonya and Dre who promptly unloaded our car for an early checkin.  They proceeded to fill us in on all of the perks and how to use them. I especially appreciated their accessibility throughout the week that we were there. I have enjoyed snacking on the Cracker Jack bag that Dre gave me for the drive home.

reviews.title: Great way to stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: Great hotel! We had zero issues with check-in and the stay- the rooms are great size for all our players! Staff was super accommodating! We were allowed to have meals and meet without hustle and smoke of casino hotels! We will be back! Thank you to staff!

reviews.title: Give Mya a raise!
reviews.text: This review is all about the customer service we received from Mya at the front desk. If my company had an office in Las Vegas, I'd offer her a job no questions asked. She was very helpful in dealing with some changes to our booking and getting service to our rooms all weekend. She is a rockstar and deserves a raise before someone comes in and snatches her up. Thanks again, Mya. Because of you, I'd be happy to stay here again on my next visit to Vegas.

reviews.title: The Best Stay in Vegas
reviews.text: In my 40 years of staying at hotels, let me first say these are the friendlyist hotel staff I have ever met. Each one had a smile on their face and were really out to be sure that your stay was nice. The lady that fixed breakfast was checking on everything to make sure the temperature was just right. The room was amazing, clean and spacious, the beds and pillows comfortable. Flavor water was provided for when you came in parched from walking, breakfast was great and although there was no alcohol at the evening reception, the food was a great appetizer for dinner.  Although it's not an easy walk to the strip, my daughter stayed at the Paris and we were about a 10 minute drive from her hotel. The hotel was quiet at night and we slept really well.  It was too cold to get into the pool, but there is a nice patio area that you can enjoy the outdoors and the pool did look fun if it would have been about 75 outside. There is a nice restaurant on site that is inexpensive and offers good food. My husband raved about the Asian Chicken wings and wished he would have gotten more. Side note: I mentioned that my daughter and her friends chose to stay at the Paris. My husband and I did discuss that our room was more than half the cost, but was bigger,  had more amenities and the staff at our hotel was nicer.  Hands down if we ever come back to Vegas, this is where we'd stay.

reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.text: Staff members, Mya, Gaby, and Stephanie provided great customer service to ensure that my stay was enjoyable.  The rooms are spacious, comfortable, clean, and updated.  The free breakfast has a wide variety of items to choose from and the Wednesday night Manager's reception is excellent. Easy access to the Strip.  As a long time, Hilton Diamond Member, I recommend this hotel!  Joseph P.

reviews.title: Let the good times roll
reviews.text: Rooms were very nice and roomy. My wife and I have 3 girls. 11-7-1. It was very accommodating for us all. Kids loved the pool. Breakfast buffet was very nice. Saved me $100 on feed my little monsters lol. Staff was very friendly. Met a man named Dre. Didn’t get his last name. Very friendly. Very helpful. Gave us info on things to see. Where to go and what not to miss. Kids liked him a great deal. Made sure we said “bye” to him before we left. Highest recommendation and thank you for a pleasant stay. Go chiefs

reviews.title: Overall experience
reviews.text: People are nice and friendly, the bed was too hard and pillow on the soft side, absolutely loved the view of the mountains waking up in the morning. The breakfast was top notch, but the customer service from the employees especially Dre MIT  when we arrived and  throughout were exceptional. He was very friendly and extremely knowledgeable, definitely an asset to the establishment.

reviews.title: Great stay for a family in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Diondre was the highlight of our week he was accommodating.  Our checkin was not great.. delayed too long. The rooms are basic. And dated. The staff were great. A good walk to the strip. Great location just off the strip. Post super Bowl visit.

reviews.title: Birthday celebration
reviews.text: The hotel is nice and clean.My suite was spacious the bed was comfortable. Breakfast was delicious, although I didn't have any bacon the week I was here.Dre is awesome. He is always smiling and making the guest feel at home. Overall very pleased with my stay.

reviews.title: Stephanie is the best. Thank you for your hospitality.
reviews.text: Stephanie at the front desk made the stay the best one possible. Thank you Stephanie. Also the hotel was very clean and the breakfast was delicious. Always a pleasure staying at Hilton. Stephanie did go above and beyond on being a great host. 10 out of 10.

reviews.title: Best quality and service
reviews.text: Excellent customer service. One of the better hotels and very rare that you find the exceptional quality of people as you do here. It makes me smile just thinking about my experience. Angela and her team are phenomenal. Wouldn’t recommend another Hilton in the area.

reviews.title: Vegas visit with friends!
reviews.text: I would like to thank all the staff of the hotel especially Mya at the front desk. Mya is very welcoming and helpful upon checking in.  Also, Dre the hotel manager, was very approachable to all the guests during the breakfast. I would recommend this hotel to all visiting Vegas. So close to the strip and all the shopping places.

reviews.title: Excellent service i will higly recommend here to stay. And i look forward to stay here again.
reviews.text: The Mya receptionist is very welcoming, Dre the manager is very helpful. We are new in the city both give us very informative information even where to shop, clean place this hotel too. Food are great selection and the area is very close to every thing, and quiet.

reviews.title: Evening Social with Dre 😊
reviews.text: Oh!! My!! Goodness!! The salted caramel hot chocolate from evening social was amazing. I’m more of a tea gal but Dre’s warm and welcoming hospitality was just enough for me to not only try 1 cup but 2. His customer service is way beyond what I’ve ever seen before. What a great expirence. If you’re ever in Las Vegas checkout Homewood Suites City Center and look for Dre. He’s serving the best salted caramel hot chocolate in town.

reviews.title: Good customer service
reviews.text: Maria on the Front desk has been a wonderful person to work with. She helped me with all my needs, what a true pleasure to work with. She is a true team player, the Homewood suites is fortunate to have a person of this caliber.  I am a Hilton Diamond member and have been to many Hilton properties and have found Maria to be one of the knowledgeable person on the front desk.

reviews.title: Dining room experience
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel and very pleasant staff. We experienced an excellent encounter with your staff member DreWow, what an example of hospitality, he was not just kind and approachable but really went above and beyond his call of duty to help us in every possible way! Applause extended to you Dre, keep up the great work and may God bless you!

reviews.title: Perfect location and amazing staff
reviews.text: Our stay was perfect. The staff was kind and helpful. Our room was amazing, full kitchen, comfortable bed, nice soaps and lotion. The location is perfect, right off the busy strip still close enough to get there in just a couple minutes. Will absolutely come back 10/10 recommend!

reviews.title: Melissa is AMAZING
reviews.text: The customer service is top notch. Melissa made sure to take care of us and all of our needs. We were a big group and she made the necessary adjustments and suggestions in order to make our trip the best. We are so thankful for Melissa and all she did for us!

reviews.title: Outstanding Customer Service from Mya & Gabriella!
reviews.text: I received outstanding customer service and I’m a bit late in sharing my outstanding experience but I never forgot because it was such an amazing experience!! I wanted to give special thanks to Mya & Gabriella. Mya was the front desk agent when I checked in & was so welcoming & friendly. Gabriella was the agent I saw every night when I returned from Ces, exhausted from having walked around the entire day!! She also was the one who informed me that I had left my car lights on & made me aware that I had left it on. I’m very grateful for her invaluable assistance because the last thing I needed was to have a car with a dead battery!!! I will definitely stay here the next time I’m in Vegas & again, I just wanted to express how grateful I am for the assistance from those lovely staff members!!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I am incredibly disappointed with the service at Homewood Suites by Hilton Las Vegas City Center this weekend. We had unusual wait times, we were told incorrect information over the phone, and had unprofessional customer service. When we arrived to the hotel, we had trouble paying for our hotel reservation. We stood at the desk for at least five minutes before being seen by anyone. My mother called several hours earlier to change the payment card in advance. Over the phone she gave the staff the card number and information. However, when we arrived we had to use a different card because my mother did not have her physical card, but had it on her Iphone. I have never encountered a location that cannot take a card over the phone. I have worked in retail at too many locations to believe that their point of sales machine cannot take a manual entry.We called in advance to ask if they have an oven in the suite. The woman on the phone told us they did. When we arrived to our room, there are no ovens. When I asked Stephanie, the woman at the check in desk, about the oven and if there was possibly a communal option, she told me she was sorry, that there are no ovens and doesn't know who could have told us this. The manner in which she apologized was unprofessional. Considering she was the active manager at the time, I would expect a better explanation or experience.Stephanie did not hold herself or treat us with the high expectations that I have learned to rely on from staying at Homewood Suites. She did not attempt to correct any of our problems, offer alternative solutions, or ask how else she can help. We have never had a problem like this at a Hilton before. It also doesn't help that they only have one active elevator.I am disappointed with this trip to Homewood Suites by Hilton Las Vegas City Center and will not be staying here again.

reviews.title: A peaceful full nights rest.
reviews.text: Friendly staff took care of all our needs and were super helpful. The checking process was easy. Our room was large and welcoming. Walk-in shower. Beds were comfortable. Room was clean. We would definitely stay here again if passing through Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Clean, but used to be better
reviews.text: Clean, good continental breakfast…. But lumpy pillows, hard beds, toilet paper holder broken, water in shower wouldn’t get hot. There was a homeless man that went through the continental breakfast  and smelled strongly of urine.

reviews.title: Good value for money
reviews.text: Spacious apartment with all the facilities needed by family with small children. Reception stuff professional and friendly. Good value for money.Only con is breakfast where one day it was finish before closing time and hygiene standards are not good specially when is crowded.

reviews.title: Professional Staff
reviews.text: We traveled with a group of 15 and the experience was smooth and seamless. The staff were amazing, took care of my team and everything was very organized. The breakfast was a lifer saver for the group. Thanks and we look forward to returning.

reviews.title: Great Hotel for Vegas Visitor
reviews.text: I had the opportunity to spend 71 days working in Las Vegas over the last four months and Homewood Suites truly became my home away from home. The staff welcomed me like family every time I arrived and even made sure I had the same room for each visit. They could not have been more accommodating and were always willing to go the extra distance to make my stay as comfortable as possible. The room and facilities were spotless and the complementary breakfast was always the best way to kick start my day. 10 out of 10. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Home away from home.
reviews.text: Staying at the  Homewood Suites has been an excellent experience. The rooms are nice and the staff is amazing. Great hospitality. Great hot breakfast and out door fire pits at nighttime. Perfect home way from home.

reviews.title: Great experience essentially a great home away from home.
reviews.text: Very professional & friendly staff, we arrived early and they did their best accommodate us early. Rooms were clean & efficient. Tammy Carter walked us thru every step from booking & contracting to even meeting our basketball team the day we arrived to the hotel. We will most definitely be staying back here when we travel back to Las Vegas for basketball and even for leisure. Great location as well center to everything. Breakfast was also good and fully stocked even when it was a rush.

reviews.title: Unbelievable Noise!
reviews.text: Noisy noisy noisy …we read reviews tat said it was quiet. Don’t believe them. TWe asked for a quiet room but you can hear the highway…stay somewhere else! The woman who checked is in assured us it would be quiet…but it is NOT!You have to walk to through a filthy path to get to the strip

reviews.title: Hit or miss when it comes to customer service
reviews.text: I chose this place because of the multiple 5-star reviews. The hotel itself and the location is great! However, the staffing needs some serious work when it comes to customer service because they lack it!

reviews.title: This Hotel is Incredible!! #5Stars
reviews.text: My stay at the Homewood Suites by Hilton Las Vegas City Center was Incredible!! The room/suite was nice and clean, it was cute and cozy, and I felt right at home. There is a full size refrigerator, a dishwasher, a microwave, a toaster, coffee, pots and pans, dishes, etc; it's just like being at your own home. The Hotel itself is beautiful, the free breakfast was amazing, and the staff are Incredible!! The lady who did my check in and check out, Mya, was so nice and friendly, and made sure my stay was great!! One of the things I really loved is how they sent me text messages each day asking me how I was enjoying my stay and if I needed anything. And they replied to all of my text messages instantly. This Hotel is Amazing; I 100% recommend it to anyone looking for a good, nice hotel to stay at, whether it's just for a weekend or even a couple of weeks!!

reviews.title: Breakfast is the best!!
reviews.text: The breakfast was amazing!!!  Melissa does an amazing job :)  The facility has everything you wouod need for a comfortable stay...snacks, drinks, exercise room, great pool and breakfast!!  We loved it!

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is absolutely gorgeous. The staff and amenities are second to none. Big shout out to Melissa in the breakfast/reception area. Her courteous, approachable, and attentive nature made the start of a great vacation day. Her homemade cookies on Wednesday night are “the bomb”!! We will definitely be back as the pool is the best kept secret in Vegas. Please consider bringing back the shuttle to the strip as it’s been non existent since covid and the contract with the airlines (airline workers do get a shuttle).  Thank you Homewood Suites for a great vacation!

reviews.title: Bryan, where ever you are, thank you for making our Las Vegas stay epic!
reviews.text: We rode in on our motorcycles after a 600 plus mile ride. We were beat, exhausted from the heat and needed to get our rooms so we could rest up after a long journey. Bryan, the front desk manager took immediate action to make sure we were looked after. While booking our rooms he made sured we were hydrated and kept asking if we needed anything. He got us two great rooms that were just what we needed after our trip. Rooms were great, the experience in Vegas was great. We were most appreciative and grateful.

reviews.title: Good home near the Strip
reviews.text: Here for a conference and it was too expensive to stay on the Strip.  The hotel is conveniently located and parking is more than adequate (there is a daily charge though!).  Pool is nice--water was surprisingly not bath tub warm.  Staff is friendly, especially Melissa in the kitchen--she went the extra mile when I asked whether there was any salsa for the eggs and retrieved some from the back. :)

reviews.title: Nice hotel!
reviews.text: We’ll maintained hotel, staff was always cleaning!  Nice gym and pool.  Would be nice if there were more umbrellas for shade by loungers.  Good breakfast and very friendly staff!  Melissa always had a smile on her face and was running around to accommodate all requests! Would definitely come back!

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: The hotel staff has been great throughout my stay. Special shout out to Melissa for taking care of us every morning and throughout the day. Even the front desk staff is willing to help with anything that we need.

reviews.title: Mellissa (kitchen)
reviews.text: Hotel was clean, and the room was very comfortable. This review is really more focused on the breakfast. Mellissa was there every morning when I arrived downstairs. I arrived early, studying for work, and Mellissa was  quick to greet me with a smile and asking about my morning. Not sure how it works out, but Mellissa seemed to still be working the kitchen late into the afternoon, long after we had finished our day.No matter the time of day Mellissa was there, constantly working to make sure we had good food in a clean and friendly environment. Always greeting the guests, and taking time to  talk with each one she came across, and always with a big smile and kind word.Mellissa is clearly a dedicated and disciplined worker, but she also brings such a warm and happy vibe to your hotel. I can only hope she is recognized for her hard work and dedication!Sam C.

reviews.title: Breakfast
reviews.text: Enjoyed a delicious and hearty breakfast prior to starting my day. The service was excellent and the staff there was very helpful. The omelets and the grits were exceptional. Good job Homewood Suites keep up the good work.

reviews.title: A Really Good Option For Long Stays in Vegas
reviews.text: For our final night in Vegas we moved across the street (quite literally) to try the Home2Suites - a Hilton brand we hadn’t tried before. We received a very friendly welcome and the room size was excellent. Indeed we were quickly sad that we were only staying here for one night and seeing as how we had just had a four-night stay at the Hampton, the room facilities here (with a decent kitchen area) would have been useful.We didn’t have a chance to use the pool area, but it looks as though it may be very shaded for much of the day (not necessarily a bad thing in the Vegas heat). Breakfast was included and was fine, but not as varied as the selection at the Hampton. Again, as per the Hampton, I disapproved of the amount of waste created at breakfast time. It really shouldn’t be necessary to allow so much waste from one meal at one hotel.The area around the hotel is fine and it is easy to walk to the T-Mobile Arena and Allegiant Stadium, as well as to the bottom of the strip. We only used an Uber when we were in a rush once and to and from the airport, otherwise we walked everywhere during our stay.A pleasant stay and we would stay again.

reviews.title: Quiet, New, Great Location
reviews.text: I was here for a week for work - the hotel is newer and in walking distance to the strip, without being in the middle of all of the craziness. The windows and doors are soundproof which make it very quiet regardless of how noisy your neighbors are, even if you face the freeway, etc. Front desk was friendly and helpful. Parking is in a covered structure and $10 a night; you need your room key in order to enter, rather than using it to exit (kind of backwards) so you will need to awkwardly pull into the front of the hotel and check in to get your room key prior to parking your vehicle.

reviews.title: Great extended stay hotel!
reviews.text: This hotel is great, staff is amazing, always helpful and really doing their best so your stay is the best possible! Food is also good, they have free sancks every Wednesday! My stay is really being awesome, I don't have any complaints at all!

reviews.title: Nice hotel, good locaton
reviews.text: Nice hotel, quiet, good complimentary breakfast.  Note: there is no evening social Mon-Thur at this location as stated on website and app.  Can walk to strip in about 20 minutes.  Pillows to soft for me.

reviews.title: Great breakfast, clean hotel
reviews.text: The room air conditioner was crazy strong, but the room was clean and the hotel staff was polite.The shining star of this hotel is the delicious breakfast with tons of healthy (and unhealthy but tasty) options and wait staff that maintains the area in the morning! They work so hard to keep everything clean, stocked, and looking great for us guests. Precious and Melissa were the names of the morning crew and I had to give them a shout out for being such great employees.

reviews.title: Very good place but with some minor issues
reviews.text: Very nice interior but the room keys weren’t working and had to wait for my dad to open the door with the app. Once I walked into the room, it smelled like wet dog. Left for a while and came back  with both keys not working.

reviews.title: Clean, spacious room with outstanding service
reviews.text: This hotel was amazing from the arrival experience to breakfast the next morning.  I did not write down names but the young lady (who was pregnant) that checked us in was very nice and the breakfast attendants in the morning were exceptional.  For a busy breakfast, they kept everything in stock and the guests were never waiting.  The rooms were spacious and very clean, which I always appreciate.  I would highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.title: Great Attitude! Superb Customer Service.⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.text: Employee Melissa Webb was very professional, courteous and polite. Her hospitality and customer service is paramount! I thank the Hilton for providing employees who takes pride in the job that they perform and most importantly who takes pride in helping Hilton guest.

reviews.title: Jan 2023 Stay
reviews.text: We've stayed at the majority of Homewood Suites in Vegas and CA so I know the layout.  This particular stay had an issue with the elevators so stairs was the only option.  Yes, it was problem but this was out of the staffs control.  They did work on getting the issue resolved but no ETA.   Jules Reyes, the front office manager handled the issue for us and showed extreme care and support.  The rooms at Homewood are better than the other hilton brand hotels so that's why we opt for Homewood and this hotel was near perfect.  Will definitely stay again especially with the staff that works there.

reviews.title: WHAT A DUMP - Homewood Suites by Hilton Las Vegas City Center
reviews.text: AWFUL HOTEL. WORSE HILTON HOTEL I EVER STAYED IN. CHEAP CONSTRUCTION.STAYED 3 DAYS.  ALL 3 DAYS THE THE ONE ELEVATOR ( THEY HAD TWO) THAT WAS SUPPOSE TO BE WORKING WAS BROKE. WE WERE ON THE 5TH FLOOR. WALKING UP AND DOWN 5 FLIGHTS OF STAIRS WHEN YOU ARE 80 YEARS OLD IS NO FUN.THE BED SQUEAKED AND BANGED EVERY TIME YOU WOULD TURN OVER IN YOUR SLEEP.ASKED TO FIX THE NOISY BED. THEY NEVER DID. THE WALLS AND CEILING ARE MADE OF CARDBOARD SO DON'T EXPECT A QUIET NIGHTS SLEEP. THE STAFF WAS LESS THAN PROFESSIONAL. THEY TREAT THEIR HOTEL GUEST LIKE YOU ARE AN IMPOSITION.HAD A RUN-IN WITH THE MANAGER (JULIO ROJAS) WHO WAS LESS THAT PROFESSIONAL. (I.E. NEVER RAISE YOUR VOICE WHEN DEALING WITH A HOTEL GUESS). FILING A FORMAL COMPLAINT WITH HILTON HQ

reviews.title: Valerie was the best!
reviews.text: I will begin by saying that front desk receptionist Valerie "Val" was awesome and provided the best customer service I have experienced at a Las Vegas hotel. She was very accommodating and very, very friendly. I had a total of 3 rooms reserved and all rooms were ready and clean in a timely manner. I would 100% come back to this property and I highly recommend this if you want a hotel in Vegas away from the strip that is new and clean.

reviews.title: Standard Homewood Suites hotel with all of the expected amenities
reviews.text: My family and I stayed here for 1 night while we were passing through Las Vegas.  We found everything here that we normally expect at all of the other Homewood Suites we have stayed at in the past - pet friendly, a convenient location, a nice clean large comfortable room with a full kitchen, and a hot breakfast spread with many different choices.  The hotel location is across the freeway behind Aria hotel but we did not hear any noises from the freeway that kept us awake at night.  The parking fee was $10/day and a room key was required to access the parking garage and to enter the hotel lobby which gave us some sense of security although we didn't see anything alarming around the area during the brief time we stayed.  The pool and hot tub were outdoors so we did not try using it since we were there in Dec.  I would recommend this hotel to anyone looking to stay at a pet friendly hotel in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Off Strip Prices for the Same Distance
reviews.text: Great Staff, and convenient to a lot of places if you drive. Considering the distance from the strip and proximity to other areas. You really do need to drive in Las Vegas or Uber to save you a lot of trouble. People are extremely high maintenance these days which makes it hard on the staff. I always say the kinder you are to the people who help you the more you will receive. Mya was great at check-in as she asked what my preference was for the room location and upgraded us to Strip View. Jules was also very helpful by adding my secondary guest over text rather than have us come down again. The only annoying thing is the door locks no matter the time of day, and you will always have to ring the bell or have your room key. Thank you very much for a nice getaway.

reviews.title: Lumpy in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Needs renovation and staff training!!! Bed was hard as a rock with sink holes!  The social reception was only on Wednesday when they advertise it as if it’s everyday! Breakfast was late, and they packed up early!  You couldn’t walk anywhere, because it was close to the expressway, They only provided a shuttle for the airport for pilots and stewards/stewardesses. They need to get it together!

reviews.title: Great location with clean and modern rooms
reviews.text: I would recommend this hotel to both business and leisure travelers that are looking for a clean, quiet modern hotel. Non-smoking and no casino make it attractive to anyone with a family. Great location across the freeway from the strip.

reviews.title: Best of the Best
reviews.text: The staff at this hotel was the absolute best.  I stay in a lot of hotels, this one was a great experience.  From the arrival thru departure, always greeted with a genuine hello and a smile.  I was  on the road for business, and felt like a GUEST not a customer!

reviews.title: Thank You Staff!
reviews.text: The room was very clean. The hotel staff were extremely friendly & professional. A big compliment to your chefs, Cindy & Precious for the daily phenomenal breakfast, clean dining facility & customer service. P.S. The grits were my daily go to ad they were insanely delicious.👍🏾💞

reviews.title: Horrible service!!!!!
reviews.text: The morning staff was excellent! Breakfast was okay. The evening shift clerk (Jewels) was VERY VERY RUDE!!!! He was not helpful and he never offered any solutions., when asked about the area. I would not recommend this place if you’re looking for good ole CUSTOMER SERVICE! Save your money and go somewhere else!

reviews.title: Front desk manager like to lie
reviews.text: When I check in by the front desk manager, I inquired when did housekeeping occur with this propriety?  I was told I would get housekeeping on Saturday (I arrived Thursday) when Saturday came and no housekeeping occurred, I have to go back down and get new towel and shampoo, soap and the same front desk manager was working, I ask why my room wasn't clean and he told me housekeeping only occurs of stays 5 or longer. I then reminded him he promised Saturday housekeeping. He scheduled housekeeping for the next day. I then ask him to have the GM contact me and I am still waiting to be contacted.

reviews.title: Nice location ....SMELLY HALLWAY!!!!
reviews.text: Location was an excellent choice for us. A little over two miles from the strip.The front interior was very welcoming. It looks new and clean.  Breakfast is OK.Here's the bad part....the carpet particularly on the 6th floor from the moment you get out from the elevator you can already smell  bad odor in the hallway. I think it is coming from the carpet. It smells unclean, moldy and pet urine. We have to cover our nose every time we go.

reviews.title: Dangerous!  Unsanitary!  Unresponsive!  Untruthful!
reviews.text: DO NOT STAY IN THIS HOTEL!Dangerous, unsanitary and the management tells stories that are contradictory and untrue!On Friday, November 4th at 8:50 AM my partner was exiting the shower.  The shower handle knob broke off in his hand and shattering the glass door, and he fell onto the glass causing several gashes on his right leg.He called the front desk to tell them what happened.  They sent a maintenance man up to clean the glass.  He took pictures and sent them to his manager Patti.  She then called and asked if we wanted EMS.  We said yes as we could not stop the bleeding.  She (Patti) came up and also viewed the scene.EMS arrived and advised him to go to the hospital but by that time he had stopped bleeding  so they cleaned him up and bandaged him.   We rested and then went down to the lobby.I explained to the front desk woman that the room looked like a crime scene with blood  and glass everywhere.  I told her that the carpet needed to be cleaned because of the danger and the glass.  We left the hotel.  Donald returned soon after to rest and found the maid doing the "normal" vacuuming.I arrived back at the hotel at 5:00 PM and was appalled to find that the carpet still had blood spots and glass on it as well.  The shower door had not been replaced.  I spoke to the front desk manager and he told me that it would not be replaced during our stay because they didn't have any spares. And contrary to what the Engineer/Maintenance person said, that they never steam clean the carpets.  I asked for another room and he told me they were sold out.  I asked about other Hilton properties in Vegas and he said that they were not affiliated with any other hotel .  Each is a separate franchise,  He said he could move us in the morning.  I asked about our bloody clothing and he gave us $2 in quarters  for a coin laundry.  He said that they could not give us slippers even though there was still blood and glass on the carpet.I asked for a copy of the incident or accident report and was told that I was not allowed to see it and that the only documents we could see were the witness statements . There was only one witness, the victim, who did NOT write a statement.On Friday night I emailed the General Manager.  I have, to date, not received a reply to the email. On November 5th we returned to the hotel and the same night manager showed us to our new room.  While checking out the room, I found the same knob/handle to be loose in the shower of the new room and had him tighten it.On Sunday, November 6th Patti called to ask for biographical information for the insurance company.  I asked for a copy of the information and she said that she would provide it( contradicting what we had previously been told)..  She also informed me that the manager Ms. DeLa Paz would meet with us on Monday at 8:30 AMOn Sunday, we found that Donald's wounds were not looking good so we went to an Urgent Care facility.  The doctor said that because days had passed, she could not stitch him up and that he would be permanently scarred.  She gave him a tetanus shot and a course of anti-biotics.On Monday, the general manager did not show up for our appointment.  We give Patti the bill for Urgent Care and we discovered  that the Liberty Mutual claim is not available YET because it was just put in on Sunday (48 hours after incident)  Patti assures us that Ms. DeLa Paz will meet with us the next morning and that she knows all about our situationOn Tuesday, Patti tells us that Ms. DeLaPaz is not available until the afternoon.  I did not accept her answer and told her that I was tired of being lied to and strung along.  She told me to lower my voice.  Don tried to calm me down and I left the lobby.  I came back down to sit in the computer room and Ms. DeLaPaz arrives to chastise me for yelling at her employee.  She threatens to send us to another hotel to which we replied that it was our understanding that you had no  relationships with other hotels.  She also claims that she never read my original email from Friday night.She also claims that an engineer had been in our room before and after the incident.   I asked if he was in there, why would he leave glass in the shower. Why would he be in the room before the incident?The contradictions of individuals and between the staff compounded by the obfuscations about the contents of a claim is more than disconcerting.  The fact that they were representing Hilton, sullies a reputation. It is now a full 8 days after the incident and we have yet to receive a copy of the insurance claim, the general manager has not responded to any of my 3 emails.So I reiterate:  DO NOT STAY HERE! There is blood and glass still in room 205.  The manager, assistant manager and the front desk manager will tell you three different “policies” and “facts.”   My partner is still fighting the infection from the gashes on his leg.

reviews.title: Feels like home
reviews.text: Loving the stay at Homewood Suites just 15 mins off the Strip. The hospitality, genuine warmth of the staff and little nice touches such as Wednesday night socials were so appreciated. The room was very spacious and the bed provided for a great night's sleep. Definitely would recommend if you like to escape from the hustle of the Strip and don't mind the flyover walk for 15mins.

reviews.title: Fantastic Staff
reviews.text: I was there over the past Halloween weekend with my mother. The staff members JC and Larry were so amazing and helpful. Our experience was comfortable and amazing.  We felt like it was home and they were family to greet us.

reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: This hotel took such good care of our team! Amazing service. Everything is so clean and the people were helpful! Cindy and Brian were the best!  Thanks Larry as week for making sure everything was perfect!

reviews.title: Work training stay
reviews.text: The pillows was probably the worst part of the whole trip. Other than that, the room was clean and the service was good - especially Cindy and Precious! Very accommodating and cheerful - Def made you feel welcomed.

reviews.title: Did not disappointa!
reviews.text: Love this hotel! The rooms were spacious and clean and very updated and amazing. I loved the breakfast options. The kitchen crew Cindy and Precious were so kind, they kept things clean stocked. And they were very accommodating and helpful! This hotel is a great choice in Vegas! Close to the strip and most importantly they have the best customer service. IT was safe and clean and I will stay here again!

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: The hotel was clean and the people were very nice. The breakfast people, Cindy, Precious and Brian were WONDERFUL! They made the start of days even more enjoyable 😉 The desk people were very accommodating for extra things needed and directions etc

reviews.title: Las Vegas in October
reviews.text: This was one of the few times that we’ve visited Las Vegas and stayed off the strip but it was so worth it. The hotel was very well maintained and staffed. Cindy did an awesome job at breakfast and the GM Angela was absolutely the best! We’ll definitely be returning to this hotel!

reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: Great service given by Precious, Cindy and Valerie! They enhanced our stay at the Homewood Suites by Hilton Las Vegas City Center 4625 Dean Martin Drive. They were all very friendly and extremely friendly.

reviews.title: Amazing breakfast buffet!
reviews.text: Just had to give a shout-out to Cindy, Precious and Boyan on their amazing breakfast buffet spread and friendly and accommodating demeanor. The food was so yummy - grits, bacon, eggs, waffle station - all neatly presented and delicious. Thank you!!

reviews.title: Excellent customer and experience
reviews.text: This hotel gets 100 all across the board. From the time we walked in starting with Valerie at the front desk. Valerie took here time finding a room for early check in after our long flight. Everything about her customer service was awesome! The breakfast was hot ,delicious and on point daily. Cindy and Bryan was amazing with any questions that was asked we big smile. Last but not least the rooms, eating area, stairwells, and hotel grounds were exquisite. This will be our home away from home. Thank you to the entire staff.

reviews.title: Wonderful location and stay at affordable rates!
reviews.text: My family ended up here after a medical emergency on a work trip required us to be in Vegas for a week longer than planned. All of the front desk and housekeeping staff were wonderful. Cindy, Precious, and Bryan on the breakfast buffet served a variety of creative, satisfying dishes every morning. Everything was clean and well maintained. Given its central, but quiet location we were very pleased with the affordable rate. Would definitely recommend and stay here again.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Cindy Precious's food was above and beyond for our stay at the homewood. She was very friendly and accompanied everything as needed. Definitely booking our next stay at homewood when we return to Vegas because her breakfast was truly so great

reviews.title: Came to Vegas for a Wedding
reviews.text: We had an enjoyable time here in Vegas . We came to Vegas for a wedding and the two room suite we were in was amazing Valerie at the front desk was amazing We arrived early from Indiana and Valerie went out of her way to make us comfortable in the lobby and pool area 1hile housekeeping cleaned our room. The staff Cindy, Bryan, and Precious in the kitchen nailed the breakfast every morning with tasty food and exceptional customer service.  Thank you for the wonderful hospitality.

reviews.title: The service was awesome
reviews.text: We was show so much love when we arrive there. the staff was awesome. We was there for four days. It was our first time. And the breakfast was awesome. Precious and Cindy and byan show us much love.  The room was awesome and clean real good.

reviews.title: Great staff!
reviews.text: The bar staff is great! Love the housekeepers. I had an amazing experience every single night of the week and will happily come back. The breakfast is a wonderful spread of items that you can choose from.

reviews.title: Horrible Management
reviews.text: It seems like the management /supervisor staff cares about nothing.Grounds very dirty, sheet smelly andwhen you ask for an accommodationthey tell you they can't help becausethere is more guests to help but if youwant help it's going to cost hundredsmore. This is not a company you want tostay with. How they have more than 2star reviews is beyond me. STAY AWAY!

reviews.title: Great Breakfast Area and Attendants
reviews.text: Room was what you expect clean and nice and they provide everything you need for a kitchenette. love the en suite so somebody else can take a nap while you watch tv. great pool area. What I really loved was the breakfast attendants in the morning Cindy and Marlena were wonderful. Marlena helped me get perfect warm water for my baby's morning bottle and Cindy brought out some fresh coffee for all us to have. Fresh fruit and other breakfast items available even almond milk was an option which i love because i don't like regular milk. Thank you Cindy and Marlena for making our morning wonderful!

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Best stay ever and could never have asked more in a place to stay the breakfast was amazing and I would definitely come back over and over again. I will continue to come back and definitely tell all my friends and family about our wonderful day stay

reviews.title: Clean and Friendly
reviews.text: I've been staying at this hotel for business since 2018. Jules at the front desk always go above and beyond for the guest. Artis in housekeeping is another who goes out of his way to accommodate guest. The kitchens staff (all 3; 2 AA females and 1 W male) area wesome. I've noticed that the new kitchen staff serve a more variety and quality food. I will continue to stay here when on business.

reviews.title: Breakfast Crew
reviews.text: Precious, Cindy, & Marlena did an outstanding job going above & beyond while hosting breakfasts for all guest.  They all had a very personable, lively, vibrant, & welcoming spirit. They cracked jokes, was very responsive to needs with restocking food, & all having a great time.

reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: The staff here are one of a kind. I am a Diamond member who travels so much with Hilton exclusive and service like this hotel is why. The entire team including the front desk, bellman and the managers were exceptional. Front desk greeted me every time I walked in, Angela remembered me from last summer when I stayed and the bellman assisted when I dropped my entire case of water without me asking. Roy or Ray was his name. I will be back.

reviews.title: Kitchen staff
reviews.text: During our stay we went to eat breakfast in the lobby and my 7 year old who loves eggs was sad because he doesn’t like bell peppers in his eggs and that was the only type of eggs that were being served ,  Marlena, Cindy and Precious overheard and seen that as an opportunity to go above and beyond! Marlena whipped him up plain eggs and added cheese at his request. The kitchen staff also immediately make you feel welcome and like family. From greeting you upon entrance to the breakfast area and supervising the area to immediately meet all guest needs. They seem as if they love to be here and are happy the guest are here too! We happen to be locals here on a staycation and we have stayed at many hotels here over the years and this is definitely amongst the top three staff interactions we have ever encountered. This kitchen staff isn’t just serving up food, they are serving up exceptional, excellent and elevated service. I hope these women are recognized because they have created returning guest and I will be telling my family and friends who come to visit me here in vegas about this experience and Homewood suites Las Vegas city center.

reviews.title: Service and Hospitality
reviews.text: Desirey, and Mr. Reyes were extraordinary host.   Everyone on the team was fantastic but Desirey, and Mr. Reyes stand out for their knowledge, willingness, and personality.    Because our employer was paying for part of the trip, Mr. Reyes was instrumental in breaking up our bill so we could properly expense that portion of the trip. Desirey was   instrumental in printing several emails and faxing some documents. Neither one made excuses they were problem solvers. They are invaluable Hilton team members.

reviews.title: A great location off the strip
reviews.text: We booked this for our return journey to LA through Las Vegas.  The suite was perfect for our family of 5, with 2 queen beds in the bedroom and a sofa bed in the lounge.  It also had a kitchenette.  The one draw back is it is 20 minute walk to the strip, however,  having stayed on the Strip previously we were happy with the location.  Parking was very easy and $10 a night. Breakfast was excellent and the pool area large enough for 20-25 to enjoy, while still having space.  For dinner we drove to a restaurant away from the Strip and needless to say the cost was significantly less.  We arrived on a Wednesday night and were able to enjoy free snacks as part of their 5-6:30pm social night for guests.This hotel was easy to access from the freeway and we would definitely use it again, as you certainly get more for your dollar on Dean Martin Drive!

reviews.title: Amazing Stay, Great Staff
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at Homewood Suites. We visited Vegas for an AAU basketball tournament and all our families who stayed here were so happy and comfortable with the property. The location is awesome being just off the strip, where you can see it and get to it easily, but not be in the mix, especially with kids who are focused on basketball. No "casino," no smoke-smelling air, just a new, clean property easy to get in and out with a parking garage just steps away. The laundry facilities and free breakfast were key as we were on the go, also grabbed to go bites from the Garden Grille in the sister property next door, made it super easy and affordable food prices with an extra discount for being a guest at the hotel. The wifi was quick, beds comfortable and just overall great accommodations.Also, thanks to Adrian for the surprise snacks and goodies… my kids think it’s so cool. They also really like Larry who was very helpful after a long day of travel delays and issues, he turned our day around when we arrived. MY 9 year old says it was his favorite hotel and we must stay there for future Vegas trips and always a Hilton!

reviews.title: I can’t recommend this hotel and would not stay here again because there were just too many things that went wrong…
reviews.text: I can’t recommend this hotel and would not stay here again because there were just too many things that went wrong…

reviews.title: Basketball Tournament In Las Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed at the Homewood Suites by Hilton along with the rest of the team. I am so glad we stayed here. The rooms are so spacious, very clean, and the hospitality is exceptional! The breakfast delicious and Cindy who oversees it is awesome! Every morning she is greeting all the guest and has an amazing smile and upbeat attitude. We will definitely come back here next year.

reviews.title: A bit disappointed.
reviews.text: I was excited about this property due to all the reviews, but we were disappointed.The POSITIVES are the friendly front desk staff, proximity to the strip and freeway, and quiet rooms.The NEGATIVES first and foremost was the terrible breakfast. We were here on a Friday/Sat, and each time the free breakfast was disappointing. They served sausage with gravy. How sad. It felt like they were cutting  corners. They probably cut 3 pieces of sausage for the entire morning buffet. Why can't they serve sausage links, bacon, ham, or decent meat? The eggs were soggy and undercooked. We saw people come from their rooms, look at the breakfast, and then leave. It didn't look appetizing. How sad. For the price of the room, we could have stayed at a larger casino property. To top it all off, the lady cooking in the back responded angrily went people asked her to put out more food.Another disappointment was the lack of available free coffee in the lobby that we see with most Hilton properties. The only way to get coffee was with breakfast.This is a fairly newer property, so we were expecting a cleaner room. However, I would give it a 3.5. Some areas of the room already showing age and need better scrubbing.Very little area in the shower to place your shampoos, soap. The soap holder is so tiny. We had to place our toiletries on the floor!To make it all worse, I was missing one of my Victoria's Secret pajama tops when I got home. I never lose things, so that was weird. We didn't even request housekeeping during our short stay, so I hope someone did not go in our rooms anyway.When exiting this property, if you make a wrong turn, you will end up in the bad part of Vegas, with homeless people. So plot your route carefully.We wouldn't stay here again.

reviews.title: Wonderful, friendly, clean and my home base when in Vegas
reviews.text: I cant say enough wonderful things about this place that really expresses how incredibly thoughtful y’all are. We drove in from Ca for 1 day on our way home to Tx. Check in wasnt until 4, but at 11 I called to see if there were any rooms available to leave out stuff. My daughter is a Type 1 diabetic and her meds need to stay cool or they will be ruined as will her medical supplies. Gabriella took care of us and got us a room right away. It was clean, quiet, no highway noise, nice break to get off the strip. It fit my family of 6 well. When we came in at night, the 2 guys working the front desk were kind, friendly and prompt with addressing our presence. The parking lot is convenient and only $10. The pool looked really inviting. It wasnt crowded and chaotic. The freezer worked to keep my daughters ice pack frozen and meds cooled. I was really impressed with all of it and I think this is going to be my forever Vegas place to stay. In N Out is right down the street too!

reviews.title: Horrible unsafe place
reviews.text: Management left a new young front desk clerk all alone and as I'm dealing with check in issues that mgr Jules was off and said not to bother him a non-guest man from the computer room stormed directly at me pushed me around to tell me he was going to kill me. No one did Anything   No one called I had to call 911 but clerk told them no one was injured not to show up! Stay away from this place!

reviews.title: A Wonderful Hidden Gem
reviews.text: This hotel is a non-gaming hotel, near "the Las Vegas Strip" but not in the middle of all the bustle, traffic, and noise! The suite was very spacious, clean, and they offered an amazing breakfast. Even more important, the staff were exceptional. Two people who were especially helpful to me were Julio Reyes (front office manager) and Desirey. They really bent over backward to be helpful, point me in the right direction when I needed help, and even assisted me in locating a medical facility! I am a DIAMOND level Hilton member, and I often stay in more costly hotels, but I give this hotel the highest marks, and will make this my "home away from home" whenever I'm in Las Vegas! I'm looking forward to returning and look forward to seeing my new "friends" on my next visit!

reviews.title: Great off-strip hotel with late pool hours and spacious rooms
reviews.text: This is a great Hilton property located across the freeway from the center of the Las Vegas Strip. Self parking was affordable at $10/day, breakfast and evening snacks were free and the on-site restaurant was a welcome and affordable option (“16 pizza cost $14 whereas local restaurants would charge $23+). The front desk and breakfast staff were very pleasant and accommodating and I would definitely stay here again.We chose the hotel for three reasons:Swimming pool hoursDesire for an off-strip propertyRooms that could accommodate 5Pool hours: Most hotels in the strip close their pools at 5 or 6 pm. Since we planned activities on most days, we wanted the kids to be able to swim in the evenings and for some reason most of the resorts close their pools early (likely because it is more profitable to encourage parents to gamble than relax poolside).Off-strip location: the Las Vegas strip is not a kid-friendly environment. By staying off-strip you have more control over the content that your kids are exposed to. On our walk of the strip we saw a number of drugged out and often shirtless homeless men sitting on the sidewalk and either doing drugs or asking for money. Others would walk by hollering profanities at random people, to themselves, or yelling at the sky while rummaging from trash can to teach can. Then on top of that you have weirdos in costume and ladies in bra and underwear looking for tourists to take photos with (for a tip). Rooms that can accommodate 5:I searched a number of properties and the only rooms that would accommodate more than 4 guests were suites which were overpriced for what you got. In staying in a suite on the strip you would pay at minimum the price of two non-suite rooms and given the lack of space and amenities you would be better off just booking 2 rooms. I read a large number of reviews and it sounded as though many folks had trouble getting connecting rooms or even rooms close together as a large repost property isn’t suited to accommodating special requests.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Stay
reviews.text: We had a very good stay at this site.  Room was clean with a frig, stove, coffee maker and dishwasher.   This hotel was right next to highway 15 and you had to cross it to get  to the main casino area.  The complimentary breakfast was very good and one staff person, Latanya, stood out being so nice, friendly and making sure we had what we needed and wanted.

reviews.title: Rude and discourteous hotel and dirty rooms
reviews.text: We were treated with total and utter disregard and disrespect during check in.  The clerk, Deserey, who was at the front desk, would not look up from her computer screen to acknowledge our presence.  When we reported this to the on-duty manager, Jules, he responded by stating that he wasn't sure if the clerk treated us in this manner because he was not at the front desk at the time.  With no apologies offered, Jules then told us that housekeeping would not service our room during our visit.  He then assigned us to a room where the entire toilet seat dismantled when my husband lifted it. Also, the shower was not cleaned during our entire stay.  However, long blond hairs were on the shower floor when I took a shower the first night, and one made its way into my food while I was eating. Also, the bed sheets were on the bed inside-out, which means they may not have been changed before we checked in.  Maybe the housecleaning staff took a short cut and just flipped the sheets on the opposite side. Jules and the clerk would not honor the rate, which we had selected during the time we made our reservation. However, when I looked at our checking account the next morning, he had charged us nearly $1,000 for a three- night stay, that should have cost a little more than $560.00.
