Please know that it is highly unlikely that we will stay at another Hilton property because of the horrible experience we had at this property.

reviews.title: Great value, clean and spacious
reviews.text: Usually I stay across the parking lot at the Hilton Garden Inn, this weekend I booked a two queen suite. Really solid value for the money, it's is really nice having full living accommodations such as a full size fridge and living space.What kinda ruined the weekend was the fact none of the staff was visible at the pool area. So we had to deal with kids throwing footballs, jumping off the rocks throwing shoes at each other as well as eating in and around the pool while the parents sat their glued to their phone. Plenty of signage posted in and around the pool deck area of what is acceptable and what is not. Parents, read those rules, police your children and Hilton staff maybe walk through the pool area every so often to see what is going on.

reviews.title: Family Fun
reviews.text: Great location, the hotel was clean with a very friendly staff. The family suite was perfect for 5 adults. Everything was perfect except the quality of toilet paper and paper towels, they should be up graded for the price you pay per night.

reviews.title: Friendly, very clean, good fresh breakfast
reviews.text: This hotel is very clean, the rooms are very spacious and has literally everything for a family to be comfortable. Employees have great customer service and people skills, breakfast was fresh and good. I would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Awesome experience!!
reviews.text: One of the best hot breakfast I’ve have in a while!! I travel quite often, and this by far was a 10!! Fresh fruit, yogurt, and my personal favorite, ham & cheese omelettes. Friendly staff, very clean property. Latanya stood out the most with a genuine smile, great conversation, and attractive attitude! I’ll be staying there again for certain.

reviews.title: Amazing service and amenities!
reviews.text: The best hotel in Vegas! The service and amenities are amazing. Especially Latanya’s help and attitude! The breakfast was the best we’ve ever had in a Homewood too. If drinking and gambling are not activities you’re interested in, Homewood Suites is the best option in Vegas!

reviews.title: Best place to stay. Truly a home away from home.
reviews.text: I found the staff to be very pleasant and accommodating. I feel that Jules and Kristie in particular stood out amongst them because of their warm and inviting manner of being a guest host. Being away from home for extended periods of time can sometimes be difficult, However, the staff at the Las Vegas Homewood Suites gave me the feeling of being at home even away from home. Always greeted with a warm smile and a welcome back, made a difference each day and gave me a little something to look forward to… not to mention the very knowledgeable sharing  information regarding what to do for fun and relaxation, as well as, where to eat in the Las Vegas area was extremely helpful.

reviews.title: Loud dog barking thin walls
reviews.text: First night there was a dog barking so loudly for hours. I informed front desk and they said they tried to call the guest but the guest didn't answer. I had to be the one to ask if I could switch rooms. It was super inconvenient at 4am in the morning having to move all of our belongings.

reviews.title: Great hotel with amazing staff
reviews.text: During my stay in the Homewood Suites I always felt very welcomed by the staff of the hotel, from front desk to maintenance. Gabriela, Julio, Desiree, and Roy were amazing!! The ladies from the breakfast and evening social were very kind as well. I definitely recommend this hotel!!!

reviews.title: Clean place - Good food next door
reviews.text: Opened in '07, this place is very well kept.  Nicely appointed rooms and a good breakfast buffet.  The associated hotel, Hilton Garden Inn, serves good food and drinks at reduced prices (we rec'd 20%).Humbert runs the kitchen alone and the food didn't disappoint.  Try the pork chops or Monday special, fish/chips.Alexis severed us at the busy bar and was a delight.

reviews.title: Company event
reviews.text: We had a 3 week stay here for some company training.  Overall a great experience.  Location was great for our purposes.  Off the strip, but close enough for everything.  Hotel was very clean and the folks at the front desk were very polite and helpful.  A shout out to Adrian in the sales dept.  Whether it was booking add-ons or email requests from me, he was always very helpful and patient.  We will definitely use this hotel again.

reviews.title: How lucky we where
reviews.text: I travel al over and stayed at 5 stars fairmont and high end Hilton most of the time. The first step into the lobby I felt comfortable and WELCOME. Jules the front desk manager and Desirey made us fell like right at home, not only by there professional attitude. But by there warmth and genuine attitude to please their guests. Clean bright room located 1 block from the strip. If you don’t care about the bells and whistles stay at the homewood Las Vegas Center. As they say in Japanese there casa es tu casa

reviews.title: Run of the mill nothing special
reviews.text: The front desk was good and pleasant, rooms were just OK had to ask for extra bedding and coffee. They don't serve evening meals as other Homewood's do so that makes what we pay out of line, as it is more expensive than other hotels with Breakfast in the area. Charged for parking again not like other Homewood...The room wasn't ready until 4 PM not 3PM as advertised..

reviews.title: My Birthday in Vegas 2022
reviews.text: From The Minute I Walked Through The Door The Desk Person (Donovan) Was AWESOME He Was Very Welcoming Very Professional But Yet So Down to Earth And He Made us Feel Like We Were Royalty And The Maid Staff We So Helpful And The Morning Breakfast Wasn’t Like Just Crap Food it Was Great And The Hot Tub Was Great Along The Bar B Que Grills Were Awesome The Parking Was Close, I Started to stay at The Competition (Hyatt) But Got a Bad Taste in my Mouth From Their Business Practices And The Demeanor of Their Staff, So I Decided to Stay With The Best, Thank You Homewood Suites And Thank You Hilton, YOU ROCK !!!

reviews.title: Best Homewood Suites to Date!
reviews.text: This is truly the best Homewood Suites I have stayed at. They treat their Diamond members SO WELL. I appreciated the stream of text conversation from Gabriela and Destiny during my stay. They both checked on us several times a day and accommodated all of our needs. The cleaning staff were equally as kind. Rooms- very clean and, as always, the most comfortable beds and pillows. I LOVE having a ceiling fan in my hotel room. Suites contain a fridge, dishwasher, toaster, and coffee pot. Complimentary Breakfast- yogurt bar, oatmeal, cereal, juices, three hot choices, toast, bagels and coffee. An excellent selection for a complimentary breakfast. There is also a “snack bar” area with drinks, snacks, microwaveable items. As far as the proximity to the strip: I would not suggest staying here if you want easy walking access to the strip! We walked the first day and it was a trek. Walk out of the hotel and take a left, follow down in front of the Panorama buildings and take a left at the overpass back behind the buildings. You then have to cross the busy streets to get to the pedestrian side. It will take you to the Aria/Vdala/Cosmopolitan hotels. We ended up just using Lyft from that point. The walk back to the hotel at night feels a little unsafe. This is a perfect stay if you want to end your festivities in relaxation and quiet! I would absolutely stay here again. (I didn’t use the pool or hot tub, but it did look well maintained and not busy.)

reviews.title: disapointing stay - this location not up to Homewood Suites standards
reviews.text: Parking $10/carper night - ok.  No housekeeping - ok I can go down to the desk to get new towels.  No bedding for pull out sofa -ok I can go get that too.  Room was just a small hotel room (ok we got a studio suite for $250/night) what do you expect.  Breakfast was minimal - they did have cereal and 3 hot stations but no muffins/pastries or anything sweet - ok this is covid.  But I draw the line at NO WAFFLES.  How much money can the hotel save by not putting out waffle batter? They have two waffle machines and the server said they do not put out waffle batter on FRI, SAT, or SUN because it gets too busy,  WTF?  Too many folks like me expect a hot waffle when they come down to breakfast at Homewood Suites so this location won't put out the waffle batter because it gets too busy??  I say vote with your feet and AVOID this location.  Save your money - there are plenty of other hotels that are less expensive and you can buy yourself a nice breakfast with the savings.

reviews.title: Great Location & Reasonable Cost
reviews.text: First, let me just say that I love the Hilton brand and their consistency in stellar customer service and property maintenance. This property is located in a prime position near the strip, without the guest congestion and parking challenges/costs of a larger hotel. The rates are very reasonable, and the Hilton Points options are a major bonus. Plus, it is non-smoking (or smoke-free) property!!!!Upon entering the hotel, I was taken back by the receptionist who was not wearing a mask. Later that evening, I learned from the local news that Las Vegas had just lifted their mask mandate. Nonetheless, for business employees who interact with a large population of people, wearing a mask should be required to protect the employee, as well as the public. Yet, I appreciated his friendly demeanor and efficiency.Due to the pandemic, the hotel does not offer housekeeping services unless the guests stay is three days or more.  When I requested additional towels and garbage bags, a friendly staff member arrived within 10-15. I really appreciated their efficiency; therefore, a generous tip was provided.The parking was great, and the Hilton sister hotel next door was a bonus if traveling with a large group. Regarding my hotel room, I would recommend replacing the sofa which was worn. The other issue is that I had dirty dishes in the cabinets/drawers. All of the dishes (plates, knives, spoons, forks, bowls and saucers) were dirty. Based on the food residual, they were either not washed at all or possibly just soaked in water, dried and placed back in the cabinets. This health hazard was very disappointing and alarming.Despite the issue with the dirty dishes, I would definitely stay at the Homewood Suites again. It is a wonderful hotel for family and group travels.

reviews.title: 10 out of 10 would recommend.
reviews.text: Simply amazing ! All the employees were Extra friendly ! Every dingoes day I was there Berenice texted me with compassion and a smile . I can be a lot to handle and she did it with Grace ! She had the most exceptional white glove service I’ve ever seen ! Please keep up the great work ! I just merry stay here every-time I come up Vegas !!! Thank you !

reviews.title: 3 Month Stay
reviews.text: This hotel is in a great location being a short walk or ride to the strip. I enjoyed my time here and your staff helped make this feel like a home away from home. The front desk staff, especially Berenice, Jules, Preston, and Gabriela always had a smile on asking how my day was going. The van drivers are all very professional and punctual as well keeping an on time schedule. It’s been a nice change up to be valued as a customer unlike many other hotels these days. I would highly recommend staying here!

reviews.title: Best Hotel Off the Strip
reviews.text: Homewood Suites Las Vegas City Center have the best location off the strip.  Rooms spacious and clean but there staff is Outstanding Front Desk, Housekeeping and breakfast made feel like home.  Will be back for sure.

reviews.title: Filthy dirty
reviews.text: My family’s feet were black. My baby’s knees, hands, tops and bottoms of feet were black within minutes of roaming around the room. Hand sanitizer stations were empty and not refilled during my one night stay. I felt the continental breakfast offer good food options but was a breeding ground for Covid with no hand sanitizer available. Oh FYI the company has decided on a ‘No Waffle Friday’. But yet they keep the station out to annoy you and taunt you on. Friday morning. My whole family slept good so that is a win. We felt paying a little extra for this hotel would be worth it but it was not. We will not be back.

reviews.title: Homewood
reviews.text: Great rooms, great location, felt secure. Donovan was awesome. Pool was great, even when it got cold they keep the pool warm. Nice hot tub. Free breakfast was nice just wish they had bacon! The food at the Hilton next door was nice.

reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: Love staying off strip but not far off from it. Perfect location. The complimentary breakfast was awesome and full of variety. Latanya and Dre did an excellent job with the buffet. So glad they have it available. One bedroom suite was perfect for our family of 5. Easy parking. Will visit again!

reviews.title: Peaceful stay
reviews.text: Hotel is not too busy and not crowded. Close proximity to the strip. Hot breakfast is delicious. The suites are very spacious. Parking is convenient. The staff are accommodating. Overall it’s a very pleasant experience.

reviews.title: Great service at Breakfast by Dre & Latanya. Disappointing female Receptionist professionalism.
reviews.text: Comfortable, reasonable price, walking distance to the Strip.We were satisfied with the service at breakfast, staff like Latanya & Dre are very friendly, helpful and professional. We stayed from 15 to 19 November 2021, with the kitchen staff's friendliness, the simple (but good) breakfast had extra impact to boost the energy for the day.Unfortunately, professionalism at the reception needs an upgrade. I came from europe, my childhood friend took me to stay at this hotel. In the evening of 16 Nov 2021,  I asked for converter plug for US socket to the receptionist on duty, so I can use my laptop - the answer was just a cold 'no, we don't have it' - the receptionist did not even try to look for it, she just stood there not moving, nor giving any advice to solve my problem. Overall the staff were good. Just the receptionist's attitude could have been better.

reviews.title: OUTSTANDING HOTEL
reviews.text: I travel a lot and this time I was able get my GF to Vegas for a week . I am a long time Hilton Diamond member We book at the Hilton Grand Vacations at the end of the strip . This was the one next to circus circus It was ok , not even close to Grand !This property was TRULY GRAND !The service was top notch . I was also greeted when I walked into the lobby . The staff had a very upbeat can do attitude . The pool and hot tub were great . Lots of outdoor seating and outside fire pit . The breakfast rotated different food every day . The property shares with a Hilton Garden Inn that has a full restaurant for breakfast and dinner I will always stay here when in Vegas !

reviews.title: Will be back!!
reviews.text: We book this hotel last minute due to a change of plans, And we were so pleasantly surprised! The breakfast was amazing, we better than I can make myself!! Different choices every day, all delicious! The staff texted daily to see if we needed anything, and to ask how we were enjoying our stay.  I enjoyed that communication! They were quick to bring anything additional that we needed. Berenice at the front was so friendly and helpful upon checkin. Latanya and Dre at breakfast helped make it feel like we were at home, so friendly and cheerful in the early morning. Hands down the best hotel we’ve ever stayed at, and we’ve been to dozens. Impressed with the quality of their staff when many other hotels are understaffed at the moment, so we were pleasantly surprised. I like that it’s not a casino, we had non-smoking floor, and it was very peaceful and quiet. A nice comfortable getaway for our business trip but would also definitely book here for a family trip in the future

reviews.title: Awful management
reviews.text: We stayed here and had an awful time. We were in a 2bedroom suite, which fit our needs. There was a family above us that acted like a pack of wild elephants at 5 am every morning. I brought this to the attention of the manager, who offered lip service. He basically did nothing. I made sure everyone knew. The night auditor actually filed a report and had security talk to these inconsiderate guests. They proceeded to ruin our vacation. For 1800 for 4 nights you would think management would have been sympathetic. The breakfast was ok but not very diabetic friendly. We had to purchase our own sugar free syrup. Dre was one of the best employees. He cared about our situation, brought it to his boss. He also made sure there was decaf coffee for the mother in law.

reviews.title: DISPLACEMENT MADE EASIER
reviews.text: My family and I were relocated to this hotel, by our home owners insurance, during the construction and repairs being done to our home. We were there here for 60 days. My family consists of my 90 year old grandma, my son, his wife, 3 yr old and 9 month old grandsons and myself. the 2 bedroom suite was roomy enough for all of us and very clean. The entire property was clean and well maintained. The staff was beyond kind and helpful. The breakfast was more than we expected it to be, in particular to 1 employee named Latanya who went out of her way to make every morning she was on duty a pleasant experience and took time to acknowledge and greet us personally. I would definately stay at this propery again for a stay cation  if I ever do 1.

reviews.title: A bit of a walk away from the strip which is good and bad
reviews.text: The hotel is located on the other side of the highway so accessing the strip by foot is not the easiest or shortest thing possible.  It is quiet though and not far from other fast food stops which our family enjoyed (ie In N Out).  THe hotel feels very new and I found it to be spacious and well appointed.  The parking structure is directly across from the hotel which is convenient as its not a far walk at all.  Overall our family of 5 was happy with our stay, the breakfast offering in the morning (standard Homewood Suite menu) and the location was convenient for our needs.  I'd certainly consider staying here again as an alternative to the crazy prices the hotels on the strip can charge at times.

reviews.title: Very nice staff
reviews.text: This is a very nice hotel. Clean and comfortable.  Bonnie was very helpful with my stay and highly recommend.  The hotel is close to the strip as well as other casinos and restaurants. Great value for the stay.

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: Very affordable and the staff was very pleasant. Able to provide me with excellent service and accommodations while I was with them for almost a months time. On top of it all they were able to provide these accommodations for me on such a short notice given the room booking and check in were within an hour of eachother.

reviews.title: 11/10 Highly Recommend
reviews.text: Excellent hotel overall. Stayed here in September 2021 for business. Service was perfect; receptionist(s) were always friendly and attentive, and housekeeping provided by Eva (usually) was outstanding. I'd stay here again if work takes me to LV in the future.

reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: After reading the reviews, we decided to stay here. Very convenient location. Rooms are quiet, clean. Staff are all friendly and professional. Walking distance the next Hilton Garden in. They share the same parking garage, parking was free with you room key. Our room service was M W F, no issues. Happy with your stay

reviews.title: Needed quiet time
reviews.text: I stayed at the Homewood Suites for three day Sept. 8-10. The room they gave we was very clean. The bed was comfortable. And most importantly it was quiet so I could study my company business. From the desk to housekeeping they were professional. When I was checking out, I missed the airport van by a minute. The Manager (Angela) assured me they would take me to the airport quickly. She found a driver and he took me to catch my light. Wonderful. I ask the manager if she was at the Hilton next door the night before helping the staff clean up the bar/restaurant? She was there late working at the Hilton and the next morning assisted me at the Homewood Suites.  Thank you Hilton for hiring caring and professional staff. We at Spirit Airlines appreciate your services,  Don Mac

reviews.title: Homewood Suites is the place to stay- Excellent staff and very clean!!!
reviews.text: I could write a book based on my 2 week stay. Nicholas, Donovan, Bernice you'll find greeting you with a smile and offer any assistance you'll need. House-keeping do the best job. Have breakfast and you'll find Jo Jo and Claudette working their tails off to ensure you have a wonderful breakfast. They are quick to refill the coffee and warming trays. Anthony I found to be the Adhoc gentlement. Besides driving the shuttle, he helped out the front desk, cleaning...you name it, he was their go to guy. Same with the front desk manager, Nicholas. I would see him cleaning, driving the shuttle doing whatever was needed. Donovan as well. Bottom line, the staff at Homewood Suites makes the trip well worth it. Another benefit is the hotel has parking and is off the main strip. Much more quiet and easy access. You're a short drive to the strip. Nice pool and hot tub to relax at in the evenings. I'll be back no doubt.

reviews.title: The Hotel to Travel To While in Vegas!
reviews.text: Went to Vegas to celebrate my birthday. Donovan and Nicholas were there to greet me with a smile! I was a single girl traveling with a married couple, so space was needed. They were able to get me upgraded to a 2 room suite for a great price and it was beautiful. At breakfast, JoJo was super personable and made sure we were happy. The property was clean and well kept. The market was fully stocked with late light snacks and things you may have left behind. Great people, great hotel, great location, amazing views! This is the hotel to travel too!

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Donavan and Anthony at the front desk was just amazing.I appreciate great guest service and just kind people. I felt at home from the moment of check in and throughout my stay. I’ll definitely be back.

reviews.title: Great friendly staff
reviews.text: Great hotel friendly staff, clean great location close the strip without all the strip drama. The hotel staff went above and beyond by brining some items to my wife from the lobby since our baby was a sleep and I was away and she could not leave the room.

reviews.title: Everything but the breakfast was great
reviews.text: It was very thrown together with the most basic breakfast foods available the rooms however were great I would stay at this hotel again with a kitchen to cook my own meals to get the best quality breakfast I like the staff were all great and friendly

reviews.title: Thank you GM and team members
reviews.text: My family and I had the chance to visit Homewood Suites Center City in Las Vegas.  What could have easily been a two or three star visit is a five star visit because of the level of customer service exhibited by the general manager and team members at this hotel.  There were minor issues when we arrived, such as room not quite ready, Internet not working with room number, and more importantly the air conditioning not working properly.  Unfortunately, there was not another room available like the one we had booked as the hotel was extremely full.  We were concerned that we would have to either sleep in a room with the temperature rising in Nevada or move to another hotel when the general manager came up with a solution.  Thank you to the general manager and team members at Homewood suites Center City Las Vegas your customer service which led to an enjoyable stay for me and my family. Also breakfast is excellent with many choices and the team members in the breakfast area are phenomenal.

reviews.title: Fantastic time in Vegas
reviews.text: My stay was fantastic will recommend this hotel and location to all of my friends and colleagues. Who are visiting Vegas whether for business or leisure. The breakfast was fantastic and wished they served a small dinner meal/ grab and go style for those who wish to enjoy the outside pool or before venturing out into the city

reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text: I stayed at the Homewood Suites for 135 days due to work, from the staff to the rooms this hotel is hands down one of the best I’ve stayed! Such a kind caring staff. During Covid times they all took precautions to ensure everyone’s safety and one of the cleanest hotels I’ve stayed. Hands down the Best

reviews.title: Homewood Suites by Hilton Las Vegas City Center IS PRETTY TERRIFIC!
reviews.text: Nice, clean property. Well maintained, excellent adjacent parking structure. Workout room was more than adequate.NICK the Quick at the front desk went MacGyver on us and fixed something mechanical I broke by accident. What a dude!And LUIS at breakfast buffet was on point!Highly recommend this joint if you want to be away from The Strip, but near LOTS of eateries.

reviews.title: Clean, spacious, friendly staff.
reviews.text: The hotel overall appeared clean. My room was what I’ve grown to expect from this brand, but the staff really seemed to go above and beyond. They were ALL very friendly and courteous, which seems to be a rare find these days.

reviews.title: One week stop over on our Westward bound trip to California
reviews.text: The staff at the Homewood Suites here on Dean Martin Blvd were nothing but exceptional.  We were treated as if we were family members.  Always a smiling welcome every time we came back to the Suites.  Angela is the General Manager and she exemplifies the friendly, exceptional staff.  Luis did a fantastic job of overseeing the breakfast facilities and ensured everything was fresh and well stocked.  Nick and Miguel were assistant managers who managed the front desk.  They also were instrumental in helping out with the breakfasts in the morning.  When the guests were at the peak time of breakfast visits, they chipped in and helped  Luis provide and clean and safe environment for the guests.  The facilities were sparkling clean and well maintained.  The suites were very clean and by far the best of our trip (so far we have been on the road for two weeks).  We intend to make reservations for our return trip in August, so we will see their smiling and welcoming faces once again.  I am a frequent user of Wyndham facilities, but this hotel has convinced me to change my affiliation to Hilton.  Kudos for a job well done folks!  If you couldn't tell by my write up, I highly encourage everyone to consider the Homewood Suites on Dean Martin Blvd for you next visit to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Amazing staff and extremely clean rooms!
reviews.text: Best hotel we have ever stayed at! From the staff to the cleanliness of the rooms. As soon we checked in we were greeted with a warm welcome from one of the managers that was at the front desk. When we arrived in our  room, it was completely spotless and smelled cleaned. We loved staying here and would recommend it 100% amazing staff and extremely clean hotel!

reviews.title: Nice hotel, close to the strip for the convince but far enough to avoid the chaos.
reviews.text: This is an inexpensive hotel but very nice and clean. I am a Honors Diamond member and have visited quite a few hotels and this was one of the better ones.  Close enough to the strip to get there easily but removed so none of the chaos. Easy on, easy out, free parking. And the restaurant is open.And  we had an issue with the shade being broken. Edwardo arrived promptly,  discovered that is was not the easy fix he anticipated. He stayed, was very polite and friendly and fixed it perfectly. Cudos to Ed.

reviews.title: Clean and Friendly Service
reviews.text: We recently stayed two nights on our family vacation and the room was clean and the employees were all friendly.  The pool was clean, there were plenty of pool towels, and food options in close proximity.

reviews.title: Off the beaten track
reviews.text: I wanted a quiet hotel and found it here. However, it was often difficult to do anything on the strip as it was a bit of a walk to just get to the strip. Great place if you’re not wanting to do much on the strip.

reviews.title: Blew My Expectations
reviews.text: my girlfriend and i needed an affordable yet reasonable place to stay for the 4th of July. Room prices skyrocketed. We knew we would only be spending the night and then leaving back home. with that said i stumbled upon this hotel and i’m glad i did. this place is clean and immaculate. i got the king size bed suite. it was so spacious with a microwave and fridge. the shower was very clean and organized. flat screen tvs. My girlfriend was impressed and i usually suck at booking  things. LOL. Patricia was  very  nice. gave us pool keys while we waited for our room. Nicholas was extremely helpful and easy to talk to. Room service was quick!!! there was a lot of people staying. here and room service came within minutes for whatever we requested. they have free breakfast in the morning. perfect for those who need a morning pick me up. coffee, orange juice, water, cereal toast bagels. biscuits and gravy; a lot of variety. plentiful parking. very nice pool with plenty of seating and towels. spacious. away from the crowded strip, but only a 5 or 7 minute ride away. Heck if your up to it, it’s about a 25-30 minute walk to the strip. no crowded lobby area. none of that strip traffic. This place will most likely be our go to place from now on. Thank you so much.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: This room was great, i enjoyed my stay!Breakfast was great and the room was comfortable. The staff was friendly and the fitness room was also pretty good. Thanks and I’d love to be back for a second trip!

reviews.title: Best Place Ever
reviews.text: Everything was perfect , every single staff member made my stay very comfortable!! I will always recommend this place for every one I come across… I was there for over two months and it felt like a home away from home.

reviews.title: I've stayed three months. Staff made it bearable.
reviews.text: I've been staying at the Homewood Suites City Center for the past three months for my work. I am a novice at traveling. Truth is that this is the first time I've ever had an extended stay at a hotel. The staff here are what has made my stay bearable. It can be very tough, alone in a strange city, but they have made me feel at home. Nick at the front desk has been particularly helpful and friendly, as well as all of the staff.The Homewood shares a property with "The Garden", another Hilton hotel. Here they have a restaurant and bar. Svetlana, Alexis and Ashley always made me feel welcome and had a friendly face for me in Las Vegas. I have no doubt that I will be visiting them in the future.There have been minor issues, as is always the case. The elevator was down for a time, for example, but these problems always stayed minor and were solved promptly.I will certainly be staying again in the future.

reviews.title: Great place for families!
reviews.text: Best hotel of our trip.  I cannot say enough about this hotel.  It was like a home away from home.  Our family of 6 had space to stretch out in the living/kitchen and bedroom.  We didn’t use the stove or dishwasher, but the fridge and microwave were great.  The table and desk held our stuff and let the kids have a space to do online work for school.  The pool was great.  (Although there were no clean towels while we were there and the door wouldn’t open with my digital key).  Anyways, the staff was helpful.  The manager Angela was talking to people like they were family giving them ideas of places to eat.  At breakfast I saw her cleaning and restocking with two other workers for a seamless meal and no lines.  There was plenty of seating and clean tables.  The parking garage had plenty of space.  The location is close to the strip, but also away enough that you can do other things.

reviews.title: Very nice cancellation hotel
reviews.text: Very nice hotel. Our flight got canceled and The airline gave us voucher for this hotel. It was very nice. Rooms were excellent and the included  breakfast was a nice plus . Great Televisions in both den and bedroom. Loved all the space , plus kitchen !!

reviews.title: Comfortable, quiet stay
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay here.  A nice comfortable, restful stay in Las Vegas at the end of a whirlwind trip.  Not on the strip or downtown, so off the beaten path, which is what we wanted.  Well worth it.  Will remember it for next time I need a relaxing stay in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: 10 Day Family Vacation
reviews.text: This Homewood Suites is a beautiful  property directly off the strip behind the Aria Hotel (it's only a 15 minute walk to the Aria Hotel). Ask Miguel at the front desk for any needs as he was our "go to" for Vegas information, hotel amenities, and any essential room needs. We appreciated his service and willingness to go the extra mile to make our trip an enjoyable experience. Bravo Miguel! Here is a quick run down of where this property is currently at in the later stages of our pandemic.-Currently they offer a full service breakfast with all boxes checked for hot and cold items.-The pool is open for longer hours (close to 9pm) and it's outstanding and gorgeous to use.-Currently no reception for evening drinks and snacks.-Currently housekeeping is done on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays once three consecutive days have occurred. -The Hilton Garden Inn is footsteps away and they have a restaurant and bar that has nightly dinner specials that Homewood guests get 20% off your bill. We ate here 4 nights and it is absolutely delicious. -Currently no water is offered during the day or evening but you can buy water at the front desk.-Currently NO shuttle service for guests to the strip or to the airport as Spirit airlines is using this hotel and they get all shuttles exclusively for their pilots and attendants.-The staff here is very accommodating and we watched them help us and everyone with breakfast, room needs, pool needs, and general information.Thank you Homewood Inn and Suites for a great family vacation!

reviews.title: Awesome staff
reviews.text: The staff was very professional and welcoming. They made my stay away from home very comfortable. The breakfast was good. The hotel was very clean and had a nice outside area to sit and relax. Can’t wait to stay again.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Service was good. The hotel was clean. I really like that there is a kitchen in the room. There is stove, full size fridge, microwave etc. We really enjoyed our stay there and would recommend this hotel

reviews.title: Clean and close to The Strip.
reviews.text: The hotel is clean, they are nice to the guests. Easy walk to The Strip. Can be noisy from the highway though but I always use a white noise app(forgot the first night)and that helps. Pre-pandemic the breakfast choices were great, hopefully back to that soon.

reviews.title: Above and Beyond
reviews.text: Great location, clean and quiet rooms.  Friendly and helpful staff that went above and beyond. We realized we left our prescription glasses in the room after we flew home. Bobbi went above and beyond to immediately locate our glasses and consistently communicated with me until our glasses were safely delivered.   We enjoyed the hotel’s close proximity to the Strip, (especially In ‘n Out), yet far enough away for a quiet retreat.  Well organized during this time of Covid and warm breakfast was a welcome treat every morning.  Especially appreciated Claudette’s kind greeting every morning as she served breakfast. Will be our “go to” hotel when we stay in Vegas.

reviews.title: Breakfast is lackluster
reviews.text: Called around to look for places with a good breakfast since that’s my barometer. Stayed here for 3 nights. They say they switch up the breakfast so there’s always something new but of the 3 breakfasts I had, 2 days were biscuits and gravy and a granola bar. Weak.

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Very happy to had chosen this hotel. Excellent location and very good service from the staff. Clean   and comfortable. We had a great time using all the facilities, especially the pool. 100% recommended!

reviews.title: Excellent hotel 💕
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, delicious food and friendly staff. 100% recommended. I’m sure that we will return soon! Excelente hotel, comida deliciosa y el personal muy amigable. Recomendado 100%. Estoy segura que regresaremos pronto!

reviews.title: Overall a good stay
reviews.text: Overall a pretty good stay. Location is excellent on the other side of the Strip but without all of the traffic. I always enjoy Hilton properties. Beds are pretty firm, but the rooms are clean and the kitchen is very convenient.

reviews.title: Great service.
reviews.text: Nick at the front counter is fantastic.  The staff as a whole is amazing.  The room was spotless, and comfortable.  I love the location to the strip.  I will stay here every time I am in town for work. Love it here

reviews.title: Extended Stay
reviews.text: I spent almost an entire month at the Homewood Suites. The staff was very professional, helpful, and friendly. They would often recommend places to see, events, and places to eat at. The food and drink services offered were good and priced fairly as well.

reviews.title: Great place to stay!!
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, the pool is amazing, the sitting areas, inside & outside, are large and comfy, and the room was perfect. The staff is friendly and very accommodating!  Patricia, at the front desk, went above & beyond for us!!  Donovan & Miguel also did us some solids :)  Jackie, our shuttle driver went out of her way as well, she is a hoot!!I can't wait to come back here!Sheila Gritzinger

reviews.title: Quiet and convenient
reviews.text: Located right by Interstate 15 across from Aria, this hotel is central yet quiet, The suite is modern, spacious, clean, and well equipped for simple cooking. Breakfast offers one hot item and good coffee.  If there is anything to improve, it will be the low-hanging light right above the desk, which tends to hit people’s head if they are not careful.

reviews.title: We weren't given the opportunity to stay
reviews.text: Very poor service. Hilton properties really dropped the ball. The general manager Angela DeLapaz canceled our reservation and moved us to a different property at the last minute, and without any notice. When I opened a case number with corporate and requested she call me, guess what? She didn't return my call. I called the Westgate and explained my problem and with very short notice they gave us a comparable room and beat the price. Very disappointed with Hilton Properties and won't be using them anymore. Spent many nights at Homewood Suites or Embassy, especially traveling for work with the government. Won't ever risk it again, given that had I not checked, we wouldn't have found out until we arrived, and only had 2 days to find another comparable room.

reviews.title: Don't expect to get something you leave in the room back.
reviews.text: Great suite.  Good location just behind the Strip. Great stay expect very disappointed   that I couldn't get my boots back.  Just make sure you don't leave anything behind.  I left a pair of slouch boots in the room and I called twice hoping my son or daughter-in-law could pick them up.  They told me they would call if they found them and I never heard from them.  So I'm out my favorite pair of shoes.  Review written by Gail P.

reviews.title: Great hotel near strip
reviews.text: Had a great visit to this Homewood Suites. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Close to airport and the strip but far enough away for some quiet. COVID breakfast was served to you and was set up very well. This hotel is only a few years old from what I can tell, so that is a plus. We got a room upgrade as we are gold members so we had a nice king bedroom suite. Free parking in their covered garage was another plus. You can’t go wrong staying here! I recommend.

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: Would definitely stay here again.  Especially during these sensitive times.  Walking in one could tell that all safety measures were in place, and the staff is very friendly.  Next business trip, definitely booking here again.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: I've stayed here a couple times, but most recently was on a work trip in Nov 2020.  They have really adapted well to all the COVID restrictions.  The gym is still available, but just capacity limited.  And they are still serving at least some hot breakfast items, along with some packaged stuff.  Parking is free.  I come out to Vegas at least once a year for work and will definitely return to this property.  And it's very close to the strip!

reviews.title: Get a room a way from the freeway; Bfast and coffee is over at 8:30
reviews.text: The hotel was nice and clean, I've stayed at maybe 15 Homewood Suites - this was the only one where the room wasn't a suite - but one undivided room, but it was ok.  Originally my room was right near the 15 freeway, the traffic is really loud and the floor and bed even vibrate...  I was grateful to have them switch me to a room in the back.  I'm Diamond and travel a lot, especially during COVID - they could have done a lot better than just two hours before closing up breakfast and coffee, seems a bit lazy compared to other hotels especially for bagged breakfast.  It closes at 8:30, which seem VERY early especially for Las Vegas.  The Hampton, HI Express and Home2Suites of Trop are much more isolated from the freeway noise - so will stay at one of those next time.

reviews.title: Clean, Comfortable and smoke free environment
reviews.text: If you would like to stay close to the strip but yet OFF it and away from the smoke and craziness, this property is a great choice. The parking is free, yet gated so you don't need to worry about non-guests taking up spaces that should not be there. I did not deduct from the review for missing amenities due to Covid. There is no social hour in the evening and breakfast will be a grab and go bag. Not their fault so I felt unfair to deduct. For any of the reviewers complaining about those issues, it was very clearly stated on the Hilton site when reserving so should not have been a surprise.Yes, it is only 1/2 mile from the strip (as the crow flies). If you wish to walk to the Strip you will need to go a bit out of the way up and around Harmon since the I-15 interstate separates you from Las Vegas Blvd. It was also suggested to us by front desk staff to NOT walk it if returning very late and to opt for Uber. (around $8). I did not feel the area was unsafe at all, but tourists are probably targets trying to walk back to property late at night.Room was very clean and there were a few disinfecting wipes for use if you did not pack your own.I would certainly stay at this Homewood next time in Vegas as we normally do not come here for the casinos but normally to meet up with friends or family when they are in town.

reviews.title: Comfortable stay with excellent breakfast
reviews.text: Its hard to move away from the bustling vegas when u have to travel with the family and diet restrictions. We searched for a place with kitchenette and away from the street to accommodate our accompanying family. Homewood suites proved to be the best choice hands down. Excellent  breakfast, on-site laundry facility, separate living room from the bedrooms, everything was good. We parked onsite and was able to access it easily from our room via the other doors. Overall, we had a very comfortable stay.

reviews.title: Not Great
reviews.text: We just stayed at Homewood Suites Las Vegas City Center. The rooms were large and comfortable. It allowed my family if 4 with teenagers to spread out a bit. The employees who we had contact with were pleasant.Unfortunately, that is it as far as positives for this hotel. There is a horrible strong stench that begins as soon as you enter the lobby door and lasts until you exit the elevator on your floor. Due to Covid19 excuses, services are limited. Rooms were only cleaned 3 times during our week stay. We had to go ask for TP, coffee, creamer, trash bags...Breakfast is to go only. You bag your own choosing from fruit, yogurt, milk, granola bar, and oatmeal packets. Our biggest complaint was that the pool could only be used if you signed up for one of the 10 slots available for each 2 hour session. The pool is shared with the Hilton Garden Inn next door. They get 10 of the slots as well. They refuse to allow you to sign up the day before, so you must get up very early on your vacation to try to get one of the spots. In our 6 night stay, we never got one. It would have been nice if management had been considerate enough to at least update their Facebook page with their specific restrictions!!!! I stayed at other Hilton brand hotels during this trip and had much better service!

reviews.title: Always a pleasure
reviews.text: As a frequent visitor to Vegas since the mid 80's I've stayed at the typical resorts found on the strip and dealt with the default customer service these resorts offer. This hotel is different; it's quiet, smoke free and very friendly staff.  I have now found, quite literally, my home away from home.

reviews.title: Disingenuous and Fraudulent! BEWARE! DO NOT STAY!
reviews.text: Please save yourself from the danger of this hotel! They WILL defraud you. Despite Hilton's (Homewood's parent company) current cancellation policy under the COVID, this Homewood location is refusing to honor it. After being repeatedly told my card would not be charged for the forced COVID cancellation, the Homewood charged my card over $200 for the stay anyway--a stay that never happened due to COVID restrictions (Stay was cancelled over two weeks in advance.) This is a disgusting abuse of a crisis and direction violation of a publicized policy that is clearly shown in the attached photo. Clearly, the greedy and deceptive Homewood Suite in Vegas does not know the definition of "ALL" and WILL steal your money. BEWARE!!

reviews.title: Best hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The hotel is wonderful with an excellent shuttle service to the strip. It is also a fairly close walk to the strip as well. The breakfast is excellent and we greatly enjoyed the evening social and often ate on the patio. The pool was nice as well. The staff is extremely polite and housekeeping was wonderful. The beds and rooms are comfortable and clean with enough dishes in the kitchen.

reviews.title: Clean, new designs, and an open feel.
reviews.text: Hotel was incredibly clean, shower had great water pressure, the rooms were spacious and met all our needs. Very helpful and friendly staff. Breakfast was great. Close to everything and major road access. Parking garage was easy and close. Pool was nice.  Would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Elevator was broken
reviews.text: Elevator was broken and was a huge inconvenience for me due to the fact that I am disabled with a bad back. Other than that the stay was good and the room and facilities where very clean and well taken care of

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Well maintained facilities. Clean. Beautiful inside and outside. Beautiful outside lounge and pool area. Close to the strip and airport. Friendly, professional and helpful staff! Looking forward to staying here again!

reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: We asked for the bed covers for the sofa bed at 9:30, it never came. Made a follow up call... still nothing. 12:00 midnight made a call at the receptionist only to be told that nobody can bring it to us so we have to go down and pick it up! My husband went down at 12:30AM to pick up. We barely had enough sleep because of this! I reported this to the corporate office, they contacted the hotel about it but the crew never told the manager!!!! I will never come back to this hotel.

reviews.title: One of the worst Homewood properties
reviews.text: In this property nearly everything underperforms. The internet is a disaster, the personal performs poor, one of the worst breakfasts I ever received at Homewood. Just put it simple: That's not a Homewood, that's a Las Vegas ripoff.

reviews.title: Family oriented
reviews.text: This hotel was nothing but perfect for families, considering the types of hotels in Las Vegas, highly recommended for families with little kids.Good breakfast and snacks in the evening, friendly staff and reasonably priced.

reviews.title: Super Bowl Weekend
reviews.text: Great location. Within walking distance to the strip or less than ten dollar cab/Uber. Cleanly accommodations, kind staff. Very accommodating. Tucked away from it all but just a hop skip and a jump to get to it.

reviews.title: Quiet Night in Vegas
reviews.text: Clean and quiet -- away from strip but "near enough".  If you are in Vegas ands want a good night's rest and convenience to airport an Interstate 15 for travel to surrounding area, this is a great place to stay.

reviews.title: Thank you Homewood!!
reviews.text: As a Hilton Honors member, I assumed any Hilton hotel I chose would be a nice comfortable stay. Unfortunately the Tropicana was everything but that and left my friend and I to change hotels 10 min after check in.  (Staff was great...rooms were awful!). We were then booked at the Homewood Suites.  Thank you to the wonderful staff that greeted us as we arrived and ensured we were taken care of. From the moment we checked in, both Tanesha and Anthony made sure all of our needs were met and were so friendly and understanding of the inconveniences we had previously faced.  We stayed for 2 nights and every time we saw each of them, they greeted us with a smile and made us feel like we were at home; so easy to have a conversation with also. Also had a lovely experience with Alex late one evening when he noticed my friend and I were catching up in the lobby for a couple hours, he let us know he brewed a fresh pot of coffee for us to enjoy.  Thank you. Had a wonderful stay at this Homewood location the last couple days. Everyone we encountered made us feel right at home! I will be back!!

reviews.title: Friendly staff
reviews.text: My family needed a little more space when traveling for a soccer tournament.  Happy we chose this hotel right next door to the team hotel. The staff was always helpful and friendly.  Shuttle to/from the strip was the same as Hilton Garden Inn where our team was staying, and the staff made sure we made it to and from.

reviews.title: Exceptional Homewood Experience
reviews.text: Great location and quiet rooms.  Good breakfast, evening social and nice fitness center.  Outdoor pool not used due to weather but there was comfortable seating areas.  Courtesy van was helpful but had only two dropoff points on the strip.  Staff helpful and proactive. Will stay here again.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The staff and facilities are high rate. The breakfast was delicious and the social events a great touch. The room was without fault and I would strongly consider staying again. Offers a pool, spa and gym.

reviews.title: Best employees
reviews.text: Came for a weekend trip and had the best front desk employee Tanisha. She was so helpful, patient and kind person. Helped us with dinner, things to do around town and best places to go. She made our trip!

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: This is a great hotel located close to the Strip with a parking garage with easy access! We loved the room, the staff and the breakfast. We would definitely stay here again since it was so close to everything that we wanted to see.

reviews.title: New hotel with friendly staff
reviews.text: Stayed in a double queen bed suite with a full kitchen - rooms/amenities were clean, staff was so nice, and the outdoor pool was heated in December!  Afternoon snacks and hot breakfast daily were great for hungry kids. Only complaints are slow elevator and lack of sound proofing between floors.

reviews.title: Excellent clean hotel
reviews.text: Excellent clean hotel! If you are looking for a reasonable place to stay that is newer and very clean with the staff of friendly people, this is the place to stay! Very accommodating and money left over in the budget for your own enjoyment!

reviews.title: Stay at Las Vegas
reviews.text: Enjoyed staying at the property, its proximity to the strip and its family friendliness was amazing.  We definitely would revisit this property again. Would recommend giving equal options to vegetarians.  Christmas evening social spread was amazing, but couldn't enjoy the main entrees as there was not much for vegetarians.

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: I called the hotel on the day of arrival before checking in to request my rooms are placed on the same floor. I was promised an early checkin owing to my Hilton honors gold status and that my rooms will be place on the same floor. However when we checked in at the hotel (around 1:30pm), it took more than 30 mins for the front desk to place our rooms on the same floor despite the fact that I called in beforehand about the request. After more than 30 mins waiting at the checkin, I was told that only one room was ready and we needed to wait for the other two rooms. We decided to leave our luggage at the hotel and got back to hotel when the rooms are ready. However when we got back to the hotel around 6:30pm, we were told that our rooms cannot be placed on the same floor and they eventually put my family on two different floor. I felt that The hotel did not keep its promise, and I received a penalty as being a Hilton gold member instead of receiving benefits. The hotel manager called me the second day just to give me an excuse for why they broke promise and placed my family on different floors. His excuse was that after they gave me three rooms on the same floor when I checked in, one of the rooms’ guests changed their mind and extended their stay. But the hotel should have given me a call to explain the situation and offer me a chance to move to a different Hilton hotel. The way my family was treated by this hotel is not acceptable to any hotel guest nor a Hilton Gold member!!!!!

reviews.title: Friendly Staff
reviews.text: Amazing from check in to check out. Very new hotel and all of the staff were helpful and kind. Nice breakfast area and the evening light dinner is a nice touch.  Will definitely come again when I visit Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Quiet Space
reviews.text: Made a quick overnight trip with my family to LV this weekend to see a live show and wanted to stay in a quiet home like hotel without all the bling and casino noise and traffic. The Homewood Suites was the perfect alternative to the typical LV hotel environment. Close by all attractions but conveniently tucked away. Beds were comfy and rooms and hotel were nice and clean.

reviews.title: Great choice for family visit to Vegas
reviews.text: Very recent build (less than 2 years).  Nice clean. smoke-free property with good security, free parking (garage), and amenities.  Good location is basically mid-strip but just across I-15 (so about a block off the middle of the strip).  Much quieter and less hectic than the strip, but still only a 2 minute drive away.  Ideal for a family.

reviews.title: Excellent value, accommodations, and service
reviews.text: Homewood Suites may be my go-to hotel for travel accommodations moving forward. The staff was extremely welcoming and accommodating. The room was very clean and exceeded my expectations. I had realized when i arrived at the airport that i left a personal item at the hotel after checkout. The staff was extremely helpful in locating and shipping the item to my out-of-state home address, which i was very thankful for. The location is about a 10 minute walk to the Aria Casino and Resort, Vdara hotel, Belagio, and Cosmopolitan Casino. The hotel does offer a complimentary shuttle service which was always on-time. This trip was for business, but the Homewood will be my first choice when i return for pleasure. They will also be on my recommendation list to friends traveling to Vegas.

reviews.title: Oustanding Stay Just Off The Strip
reviews.text: Outstanding stay just off the strip. T hotel is very convenient to the airport and just a very short shuttle ride to multiple locations on the strip. Parking is included at no additional fee. The hotel is nice and offers many competitive amenities. The hotel, room, and bathroom were very clean. The staff were courteous and very helpful. The complimentary breakfasts were decent and the complimentary evening meals were better. Great stay for the price!

reviews.title: Incredible service
reviews.text: Family friendly, not too far from the strip. Great shuttle service, friendly staff. The breakfast and social service were also great. The staff was helpful and friendly. Patrick from the front desk was absolutely wonderful.

reviews.title: Nice hotel, excellent staff!
reviews.text: Hotel staff is very helpful and accommodating. I interacted with Patricia who was kind enough to give me the option of a very early check-in. when I found the room to be closer to the main road she offered to find a quieter one as fast as she could. I had breakfast while I waited. I hadn't finished my breakfast and she found me a room that I could rest in before heading out for the conference. The hotel was sold out because of multiple conferences so it would have been tough to find a quieter room for an early checkin. Rooms are very spacious and the beds are very comfortable too. Breakfast is the regular fare. I find regular hotels like this better than the casino ones while staying for a conference.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Amazing atmosphere, friendly staff!They have complimentary breakfast and evening reception.The room is comfortable, clean, with Neutrogena amenities, the Housekeeping staff was very friendly, always prepared to help!Definitely a wonderful place to stay, and just 5 minutes from the Strip (with complimentary shuttle to the Aria Hotel every 30 minutes).

reviews.title: Recent business stay
reviews.text: I was in town on business and my company booked this hotel.  I was very pleased with the stay - room was clean and well appointed, location was convenient and staff was very friendly.  I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Good sleep no distractions(casino)
reviews.text: I always like a stay that includes breakfast. Their bed makes me sleep soundly every night. After a restful night, having a full complete breakfast (not just  a sweet and coffee) make me start my day fresh. Their evening social is a plus if I don’t like to eat out for dinner.

reviews.title: Great Staff
reviews.text: Nice Hotel, clean well maintained.  The manager Patrick was so helpful and kind during our stay.  Patrick called a taxi service that was ADA compliant and had the shuttle from the hotel follow behind to our destination.  Our shuttle driver Craig was also so helpful and informative.  He came to pick us up quickly and and was so friendly, he made us all feel great.  This is the first review I've ever given on Trip Advisor.  They really deserve a top rating!

reviews.title: Excellent Service and Staff
reviews.text: We stayed here for the weekend.  Arrived late and Kenneth who was at the front desk was extremely helpful.  Free breakfast is excellent!  We intentionally selected a suite/hotel off the strip and this is very conveniently located.  Shuttle is available to the strip. It's clean and staff is wonderful.  Would definitely stay here again with family and friend!

reviews.title: Traci
reviews.text: It is a wonderful hotel. Loved are greeting from Patrick. Made us feel right at home. The breakfast was delicious. Everything was hot and prepared well. Our room was very clean and comfortable. As an honors member we appreciated the free parking and waters. Thanks.

reviews.title: Best Value in Vegas
reviews.text: Free breakfast, no resort fees, no deposit and evening dinner socials. Where else can you get that in Las Vegas? No where. The staff here at Homewood is great and they are the best. There is no other place to stay in Vegas with the value it has and what you get. It is unmatched anywhere in Vegas. Mere minutes from everything on the strip.

reviews.title: A Definite Yes
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a affordable room and don’t need to have the lights and bling of being right on the strip to make you feel you’re in Vegas, I highly recommend the Homewood City Center.  The hotel is located a short distance away from the strip and offers a lot. Rooms with fold out couch beds, studio or separate bedrooms, cooking facilities, plenty of interior space along with breakfast daily and dinner most evenings.  Prices are reasonable and we were not charged the local resort fee you get hit with at strip hotels.  However there is a nightly parking fee.  Again, if you want a fair priced room and don’t care about bells chiming in the background this is a place to consider - Travlin Matt

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: Hotel Staff was super friendly. Rooms were comfortable. Pull out bed good addition. Had five people stay in suite so excellent value.  Hot breakfast included! Hot tub and pool are basic but nice.  Away from the Strip but not far away.

reviews.title: Perfect overnight trip
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for the night while visiting to see a show. Since we were tight on time the online check in was perfect to save time. I also downloaded the digital key so I never had to stop at the front desk. The room was very clean and spacious. It was just across the freeway from the strip so getting to and from was very quick and easy with Uber/cab and skipping town on Sunday was as easy as it gets

reviews.title: Great service, fantastic amenities, fabulous
reviews.text: We stayed here for a week, somewhere off the main strip that had a breakfasts option and was within walking distance. The staff here were great, coffee available most of the day for free and a delightful, uncrowded pool that captures the sun from 0900 to 1800.The shuttle was available to go the the strip every hour, but we simply walked and it was blissful. One slight drawback was the loud Aircon fans from the towers next door that started at 0500. The air ducts in our room meant this increase in noise risked waking us, so ask for a number less than 24 to stay away from those. Great place.

reviews.title: Amazing Staff
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for a week. The breakfast and evening social hour with snacks/meals made this visit very economical for meals. We thought the rooms could be slightly cleaner but we are pretty picky about that kind of thing. Craig our driver was really helpful with tips both for pleasure and safety. He was so personable and extremely respectful. Pat at the front desk was also amazing and welcomed us “home”every time we came back from an outing. He was always quick with wit and couldn’t help us enough. He remembered our names and used them to greet us. Very nice hotel to stay at for peace and quiet after a busy day on the strip. Shuttle was convenient and necessary since the hotel is across the highway from the strip. It may be walkable for some who are in shape and young but no so much for others with health issues or aging body;). I would stay here again. The smoke free hotel and ability to wind down at the end of the day made this appealing for us.

reviews.title: The best Homewood Suites I’ve stayed at
reviews.text: I’m a Hilton girl, and have stayed at just about every kind of Hilton including many Homewood suites. This was by far the best one so far. The staff was incredibly friendly, I loved the personal touches and decorations. Breakfast was clean and well done considering how busy it was. It was odd, but a smart business model to be co-located with a Hilton Garden Inn which had a nice bar that served food as well and the shared pool was lovely. All in all, a smart, wonderful stay. Easy to get on and off the freeway, close to the strip and within reach of everything!

reviews.title: Great place.
reviews.text: We are six friends since high school, celebrating 50 years of friendship.  Homewood was a great place to stay!  The staff is friendly, the place is very clean, the location is excellent.  The breakfasts are decent and if you are lucky, Patricia (front desk) will be working and will share her homemade cookies with you.  They are amazing!!  Thank you, Patricia.  Talk about going the extra mile!!

reviews.title: Comfortable Accomodations
reviews.text: Great place to stay off the strip.  Close to restaurants and an easy walk to the strip, or you can take the complimentary shuttle.  I loved being able to get away from the noise, crowds and smoke of the strip. The breakfast offered enough variety that everyone in the family was satisfied.  The staff was always courteous and accomodating.

reviews.title: Thomas
reviews.text: We just got here and already feel very comfortable. They have a shuttle that takes you to the strip and can set it up to pick you back up. The room is great and very comfortable. They have free parking and the garage seems to be very secure

reviews.title: Homewood Suites Las Vegas City Center
reviews.text: Great stay, nice hotel, family friendly, courteous and helpful staff.  Breakfast was a big plus for our family and it was very good also.  Away from the strip but close to In-n-Out. hehe  Would stay here again.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Love the environment. Staff is very friendly and professional. Parking lot very well located. Hotel location is awesome. Like to have shuttle available. Room is very clean. Breakfast very good. We will stay again when visiting Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Fantastic Trip to Vegas
reviews.text: This trip has been Fantastic! We had a great time in Vegas and the Homewood Suites couldn't have been more accomadating! Would definitely stay here again! The rooms are very clean and the housekeeping staff is wonderful!

reviews.title: Great for families
reviews.text: We have a family of 5. Nice, clean amenities. Very conveniently located to strip and airport. Breakfast and small plate dinners were great for long days out exploring. Parking very convenient. Happy with our stay!

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: The motel was clean,had friendly staff and easy access to airport and rental car return. Only complaint, although Homewood Suites is very close to the strip, it is not accessible by foot. Major highways and no walkways in that area.

reviews.title: Business Location Choice
reviews.text: Homewood Hilton Suites was s great choice for our small board meeting.  More importantly our suite was perfect to host our small group to cook them all a hold made breakfast before starting our meeting.  The president of our board was actually thankful he was able to experience a home cooked meal and was surprised Hilton had rooms as these to do so.  As he taxied from the Aria and after eating in restaurants for days he was impressed.  Our bedroom was quite large enough adjacent to the living room and kitchen.  Room was quiet from sounds of the outside and hallway.  Always clean, bed was comfortable unfortunately there was no protective liner from the mattress which concerned me a little.  Pool was never crowded hot tub was a great size.  Evening complimentary food could of had more selection.  We hope there is a shuttle service from the airport next time we stay!  Overall a good place to choose if your traveling on business less distraction more time to rest and be successful.

reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text: Check in was easy and felt welcomed. Everyone was very helpful and willing to help.  Room was great and well stocked. Complementary breakfast and shuttle to the strip were great.Thank you for making our visit enjoyable!

reviews.title: Great hotel! Highly recommend!
reviews.text: I loved that everything I needed they had. Kitchen in the room, complimentary breakfast, shuttle to the strip, plus the size of the room was great compared to the more expensive hotels around. I always keep coming back.

reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel
reviews.text: Check in was easy and felt welcomed.  Location made it easy to walk to and from the Vegas strip.  Rooms are big, clean and well stocked.  We enjoyed the variety available for breakfast and will defiantly stay there again when visiting.

reviews.title: Dietary Restrictions
reviews.text: We had called 2 weeks before to tell the Hotel that our daughter was dairy and gluten free. When we checked in they were aware of her dietary restrictions and let us know that had food for her. Thank you for making our visit so enjoyable. Everyone was very helpful and willing to help you with what you needed. We were in room 612 which was a suite which was very clean and always stocked with plenty of amenities.Leasa

reviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: We were meeting friends in from Germany and this hotel was recommended by a mutual friend who travels on business a lot.  Everything was exceptional.   They offer free parking,  a snack supper during the week, a shuttle service to and from the strip and a fantastic breakfast.   That doesn't even include the wonderful suite.  I will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay!!  Loved the 2 bedroom/2bath suite.
reviews.text: Located close to the strip. Not in walking distance. Easy in and out. Must have transportation back and forth. I used hotel shuttle and Uber. Taxi drivers ripped me off twice. The kitchen and living area was nice. also the 3 TVs. Nice location for a family.

reviews.title: Wish It Was Closer, Customer Service Was Lacking
reviews.text: This hotel was clean and new. Beyond that, I wish we had stayed somewhere else. We booked a suite for the seven of us and when we checked in they said they were getting our room ready and would call us. When we checked back with them HOURS later, they apologized that they forgot to call AND ALSO THEY GAVE OUR ROOM AWAY. So, with five small kids, they split us between two rooms far apart on the same hall. I couldn't believe it. I asked them to adjust our charge and they said they would do that, but then they didn't adjust it at all. We were booked the full price for two separate rooms that we didn't even want. There is a shuttle from the hotel to the Strip and that was nice, but the schedule was a little tricky and we didn't find it that convenient. I really thought that we would be able to walk from the hotel and we definitely could not do that. We always stay at Hilton properties. I wish I had picked a different one. I would not recommend this one for families.

reviews.title: Lovely place.
reviews.text: Super clean, quiet, delicious breakfast, up to date, newer furnishings, friendly hotel staff, convenient shuttle to the Aria which has access to the Las Vegas Blvd.  I would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: So much value for what you get.  Pleasantly surprised with all of the amenities that are included.  I will definitely stay at this location again.  Thank you for making this a memorable vacation for myself and my friends.

reviews.title: Great staff, clean and comfortable
reviews.text: I really liked my stay here. I came for a couple weeks and got to know the staff, who would say hello to me by name and give me the greeting “Welcome Home” when I came in from being outside. Nice pool, not too crowded, easy proximity to the strip-though I didn’t bother using the shuttle van. Ubers were super easy to go anywhere in Vegas, probably easier to pickup there than in the strip hotels. The spot is very new, so the hotel is very clean and nothing looks worn-in. I also appreciated the breakfast, there were lots of people down to eat but they worked very hard to keep the food stocked and make everyone comfortable. I chose to take my food outside and eat by the pool in the mornings. I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Enjoyed our stay at this hotel. Staff was very friendly and accomodating.  Great customer service. The hotel was very clean. Enjoyed the pool and hot tub. Would stay at this hotel again for future travel.

reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: From the moment when I checkin in I was met by Alex he let me felt at home, he is very high spirited, top notch customer service skill, and very knowledgeable about the hotel and surrounding areas. Honestly customer service cannot be thought and I give credit where credit is due. You going far places young man keep that smile going. Overall property was great, room was very spacious and clean with kitchenette.Anderson Family 💪🏼

reviews.title: Lovely Vacation
reviews.text: Friendly & efficient staffs! Hotel is clean & inviting. I highly recommend it! They serve complimentary breakfast every morning. And yeah they’re close to everything shops, restaurants & the strip of course.

reviews.title: Viva Las Vegas@
reviews.text: Comfortable, clean, friendly staff, breakfast and lite dinners ++.  Nice pool.  Near Vegas strip, yet a step away from all the lights and noise.  Free parking within ft. from entrance.  Great stay!  Great experience!

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Nice hilton hotel. Great for people with kids. They have free breakfast.  U can even check out games etc. Its really close to the strip but not on the strip. Its literally only a block away. Free parking which says a lot in vegas.

reviews.title: Awesome Hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Best hotel in Las vegas with all amenities included and very closer to Begas strip. The suite is equipped with full kitchen. Staff were awesome and complimentary Parking, breakfast, evening social, shuttle to vegas strip and internet made our stay memorable.The prices were very reasonable.

reviews.title: A stay at homewoodsuites not so great
reviews.text: bad experience, staff not attentive. Interaction was a challenge. Shuttle to the strip booked up most of the time so we ended up using taxis. Breakfast choices very limited. Rooms were clean though. Not as good as other hiltons I have been to.

reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: My family and I really enjoyed our stay at this homewood suites. From the moment we set foot in the hotel, we were greeted with a smile. Breakfast was great too! I've stayed at several hotels in vegas, but from this day forward, we are only staying here.

reviews.title: Nice off vegas strip hotel!
reviews.text: Very nice clean hotel with a beautiful pool area! The pool is shared with the Hilton Garden Inn next to it. The complimentary breakfast has many hot and cold options! The staff was also very friendly!

reviews.title: Loved it.
reviews.text: Three of us checked in last Tuesday for two nights.  It is a great property.  Very clean and well maintained. Staff was very accomodating...one young employee even began an impromptu dance party with a few guests to the music that was playing in the reception area and said "I love our guests!!!"  Very cool.  Also, breakfast was great, evening reception was good, too. I have to say that the shuttle was an amazing perk.  We left our vehicle in the complimentary ramp the whole time.  The shuttle is very easy to arrange for, to the strip and back.  Very timely with friendly drivers.  Loved it and highly recommend. You won't have any trouble using the shutle service!

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Great stay for the price. Just hoping they won’t charge for parking in the future. The breakfast is good, place is always clean. Rooms are clean and smells new. Didn’t get to go to the pool area but it looked nice.

reviews.title: Best family hotel, just 5 mins away from the strip
reviews.text: I stayed here twice till now. I and my family always had great time in this family friendly hotel. Shuttle service provided to and from Strip is one of the best amenities of this hotel.  Staff is very helpful and accommodative. We will come back again soon to stay in this hotel.

reviews.title: Start of family vacation
reviews.text: Arrived early in Las Vegas for the start of our family vacation & we were very pleased to get checked in to our room early! Hotel was very clean! We are a family of 5 so we need plenty of room.   Our room had a kitchenette & sofa area which was separated by a door with the other room having the 2 beds & bathroom.  This worked out well for us. The pool was nice although it was quite windy the day we were there & the one umbrella at the pool did not have a latch to lock it in place & was blowing over. It was really hot so it didn’t help that we could not sue the umbrella for shade.We enjoyed the constant supply of lemon water in the lobby!The only issue we had was we did not realize that the bedding for the sofa bed was not in the room until we were ready to go to bed. You would assume if you book a room for 5 people that the extra bedding would be in the room.  I called to have it brought up & it took 50 minutes to receive it.  I was told that there was only 1 person to make the deliveries to the room & it would take sometime - so that was not good!  My son fell asleep while waiting for the bedding..

reviews.title: Generally satisfied
reviews.text: We are generally very satisfied with the hotel. We had the only suboptimal experience with the check in. The staff was a bit grumpy and not really helpful ( the lady  at the reception didn't found our reservation and almost sent us away).

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Great stay! Would recommend this hotel to family and friends! Breakfast and evening social was greatly appreciated. Friendliness and attentiveness of the staff was noticed and necessary in the hospitality business!

reviews.title: Flight cancelled allocated this hotel by airline.
reviews.text: Excellent hotel with fully equipped kitchen. Extremely clean and the staff are brilliant. We stayed at the Excalibur Hotel for our trip and they could learn a lot from this hotel. No extra charges for all the basic everyday essentials. The pool provides sun parasols free of charge. The staff saw how distressed we were when we arrived and immediately got us a drink of water FREE. The staff went out of their way to help us. Well done Hilton. I would have no hesitation recommending this hotel.

reviews.title: Excellent hotel, clean and close to Casinos
reviews.text: We had a great experience at this hotel.  We were in a one bedroom suite.  The room was spacious and very clean.  Breakfast was very nice.  I liked it that we were able to check out board games during our stay; that was a nice touch.  The hotel offers rides to the Fashion Show Mall and a couple of the casinos.  For the most part, we took Lyft however.  Great hotel.  I highly recommend.

reviews.title: Good stay as family
