reviews.text: swimming pool with towels was great; breakfast changed every day during our three days there; enough space available for five; kitchenette a bit small but sufficent; shuttle bus to the Strip very helpful

reviews.title: Bad experience, won't stay there again
reviews.text: Overall we had a bad experience. 1. The shuttle service to take us to the Las Vegas Strip was not available for two days due to the driver calling in sick?! Don't you have other staff that can drive the shuttle? What is the backup plan?2. We were missing the hot breakfast for two days because the cooking equipment was down?! We asked the manager Tavia Dalton for use of the Hilton Garden breakfast (next door to this property). He said ok but never returned to give us passes. You should consider catering food in if the equipment is down (we heard for three days)I am very disappointed in Hilton. We will probably stay elsewhere next time.

reviews.title: Returning customer
reviews.text: Always a pleasure to stay . Close to the strip with out all the traffic . Good breakfast and some time a good social when they do it . Needs more options for both . Rooms are great and big . Never feel cramped and the pool is awesome

reviews.title: Team stay
reviews.text: Book your rooms with Ashley. She was amazing! Rooms were big and clean! Free breakfast is convenient. Pool needs more shade but it's nice. Lots of sitting area around hotel. Covered parking is awesome in Vegas heat!

reviews.title: July Vacation
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Homewood Suites in July 2019 based on the recommendation of a friend. The hotel provides free breakfast, however, the food is not well stocked so if you don't eat early enough they run out of items. The food provided at the evening social was of poor quality. One day my room was not cleaned and when I told hotel staff about it, they didn't apologize or really seem to care. My friend had the same experience with her room not being cleaned, and also on the first day one of the beds was made without a fitted sheet. When I told staff that I needed extra bath towels, they said they would send someone to my room but never did.  This hotel is across the freeway from the casinos and in a decent location, but there was a security guard outside at night which made me wonder about overall safety. In terms of a family suite hotel, I was not impressed with this location and would probably not stay at a Homewood Suites again.

reviews.title: Convenient
reviews.text: For the family, the location and facilities were ideal. As I had a 5 year old we were close enough but yet had the benefit of a quieter location. The room was suitable and comfortable for the family. Would consider staying there again if I visit Las Vegas again.

reviews.title: Stayeds for AAU Basketball Tournament
reviews.text: Stayed her for a Basketball tournament.  Place is good especially if you are with your Basketball team and their families.  Saved us money on food.  Family friendly hotel.  We used the pool and the barbecue area which allowed us to socialize with everybody.

reviews.title: Do yourself a favor and don't check #1 hotel in Las Vegas on tripadvisor-stay here instead!
reviews.text: We vacated the #1 hotel on TripAdvisor in Las Vegas after a terrible experience with dirty rooms and non functioning showers. Came here spur of the moment on our last night before flying back out and it was wonderful. Beds were great and the room was clean-no nasty dog hair like the previously mentioned hotel! Morning breakfast was fantastic. We had an early morning flight and the girls worked diligently to get the food ready for us before we had to leave. Do yourself a favor and just stay here!

reviews.title: Love Homewood Suites!
reviews.text: Perfect room accommodations, friendly staff, excellent hot breakfast, evening social is a great way to relax with complimentary beverages and snacks.  I will always stay at Homewood Suites whenever I’m on vacation!!

reviews.title: Quiet comfort in the heart of Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed here as a family of 5 (4 adults, 1 teen) and were very pleased with our choice.  The room was clean and spacious and a kitchenette is always a plus when you travel as a family. There was always fruit infused water upfront and smiling/helpful staff.  What was a real treat was being picked up from the Aria by their shuttle and being offered water.  This was desperately needed as we Floridians had not yet adjusted to the dry desert air! The location was close enough to the strip but still far enough if you know what I mean :-) My husband and I took advantage of a quick dip in the pool one evening.  It was a bit chilly but then we warmed right up in the hot tub.  Also a nice feature is that there are showers located outside in the bathrooms to rinse off the chlorine.  They have a covered parking garage shared with their sister hotel next door so no parking charge for our rental. Great stay.

reviews.title: Las Vegas stop on Utah trip
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel before our flight back home as part of a trip to Utah. Hotel location is good, there is a hotel to and from the strip which is handy. You can also walk to the strip if you would like but using the shuttle is probably the better option. Hotel premises are in good shape, we did not use pool area but it looked in good order. Need to use parking ramp but it is very close by and you can get in with your hotel key.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Perfect hotel for our stay on Vegas!!! It was slightly off the strip, so there were less "partiers", yet close enough to uber or walk if desired. The staff was great, as were the amenities. Will definitely stay there again when we return.

reviews.title: Very nice!
reviews.text: After staying in a noisy Homewood Suites in Avondale that was full of noisy youth ball  teams and barking dogs this Homewood was a breath of fresh air!  Number 1 other than a bit of freeway noise it was quiet,  we got some great sleep!  Second it's not brand new but it's newer, very clean and all the facilities are nice.  The only knock I'll give this Homewood is no yogurt available for breakfast.   I've probably stayed in over a dozen different Homewood or Hampton properties by Hilton and this is just the second one that doesn't offer the tiny little cups of yogurt.

reviews.title: Convenient and yet quiet
reviews.text: Homewood suites is close to the Main strip but far enough away to be insulated from the City Centre noise.The hotel has a secured parking garage.the suites are spacious and well-appointed and the hotel provides a decent breakfast.  there is also an outdoor pool for guest use.Staff were friendly and efficient, and we particularly appreciated the help of the (female) security guard, who helped us with a belligerent taxi driver!!  Well done, Her.

reviews.title: hotel is fantastic but....
reviews.text: Same 3 Teslas 2 model 3 and 1 model S were parking at the charging spot after fully charged. same 3 cars parked there for my 3 days period. Hotel should do something about this. Either give them a warning or citation. Also any customer who use the charger should be registered at the lobby.

reviews.title: Very clean and spacious!
reviews.text: Very nice and spacious.  Super clean! We had a good night sleep, the beds are very comfortable. The staff was great! It was 5 minutes away from the strip. We are definitely going to stay here again. Thank you!

reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: This hotel was really nice. They provide a free shuttle to the Aria on the strip. Rooms were clean and the kitchen had everything we needed. The free breakfast was really good with different food items each day, wand a good selection of hot and cold foods.

reviews.title: Amazing Value, Quiet Place to stay!
reviews.text: We stayed here for our one night in Vegas.  We are not a loud casino type, and were passing through Vegas on way to Grand Canyon - this place was perfect!  We had a two bedroom suite that was so roomy, well appointed and just perfect for us.  The breakfast was really amazing and included in the price.  The staff were so welcoming and friendly.  It was just a short walk to the strip for a photo opp and a view of the lights.  Thanks for welcoming us home!

reviews.title: Great hotel off of the strip.
reviews.text: I really enjoyed this hotel. The room are super clean and the staff were extremely friendly and helpful. The hotel also has complimentary breakfast , shuttle and free parking. I will definitely book this hotel next time I visit Vegas.

reviews.title: Perfect short, even better long term stay
reviews.text: Perfect hotel for Las Vegas. Grounds, common areas, rooms are in perfect and new condition. Coffee available 24/7, breakfast served every morning , and dinner Monday -Thursday for no charge as well, buffet style. Service was excellent. Best hotel experience I’ve actually ever had. Definitely will book again. NO parking or resort fees = winner already.

reviews.title: Home. Away from home!!
reviews.text: You will be hard pressed to find another hotel providing the level of great service this hotel provides! Next door is Hilton Garden. There is free parking, also!! The breakfast is awesome, and the evening social is well worth checking out!

reviews.title: Memorial Day family trip
reviews.text: Overall, I had a good to fair experience. The fact it is fairly new hotel, it made me try it out. I will consider a 5 star one at a next stay. There are some recommendations I suggested on survey. Thank you .

reviews.title: Extraordinary service, genuinely awesome place to stay!
reviews.text: The staff and management of this hotel go above and beyond to make every person feel valuable. The front desk staff helped me with a printing need and a small issue - they went way beyond any expectation I had. I was truly impressed with the professionalism and genuine kindness displayed to me during my stay. I love staying here! I won't stay anywhere else when traveling on business in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Homewood Suites
reviews.text: I stayed in this Homewood Suites for just one night but would stay much longer!  The rooms were spacious and the bed was very comfortable.  The breakfast had many options and the food was actually very tasty! I highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: EDC 2019
reviews.text: This hotel was perfect. It was quiet and clean. We went for EDC and were extremely satisfied with the service. The shuttle to the Aria was perfect. I would come back again. The breakfast was awesome I have zero complaints.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Great place near everything and clean. Love that it was not to crowded and it was very friendly place to stay. The breakfast and the social food was good. The rooms where big and clean. Super place to stay

reviews.title: Outstanding experience and great staff service
reviews.text: We enjoyed the stay in this property. Comfortable room, great staff service, and great breakfast. We were positively impressed with the staff service, We enjoyed the room very much. I recommend this property without a doubt.

reviews.title: Good location, just off the Strip
reviews.text: This is a really nice Homewood Suites. Staff are friendly and helpful. Furnishings are very comfortable. You can walk to the Strip in about 15 - 20 minutes. There is a shuttle bus also. The hotel shares a nice parking garage with the Hilton Garden Inn. they also share the outdoor pool. The breakfast was laid out nicely. The evening reception is perfectly fine. The beds are very comfortable. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: I'll be a return guest for sure!
reviews.text: I am a long term visitor to Las Vegas and I travel there at least once a year. I would like to thank your staff for giving me such a wonderful stay while in Las Vegas this time. I stayed at your hotel for 2 weeks while I went to the tapings of Penn & Teller Fool Us.  What a joy it was to come down to breakfast each morning and be greeted with a "good morning" from staff and then to tuck into a nice fresh breakfast.  After arriving back to the hotel at night, after a long day, it was lovely to be greeted with a "welcome back" as I entered the lobby.  It's the personal touch that means a lot. The hotel is surprisingly quiet being so close to the I-15. The rooms are clean and spacious and the kitchenette's are well equipped if you want to cook yourself something and stay in for the night. I look forward to coming back next year and spending more time there.

reviews.title: Best place to stay!
reviews.text: If you like the access to the strip, but don't like the noise, confusion, and pricing, this is the best place to stay.   It is perfect for the business traveler and vacationer alike.  Great staff, great rooms, great food, and free wi-fi and they provide shuttles to the strip!

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: As I was visiting Las Vegas with children, this hotel provided the  perfect location. Close enough to the strip to be convenient for child friendly activities, but far enough away that it was away from the noise and bright lights at night.The room was spacious and clean, with a lovely, well-kept pool

reviews.title: Cleanliness Hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: Best hotel stay ever! Wonderful caring staff!  Anytime in Las Vegas,  we will stay at this location.  The rooms are very spacious and extremely clean.  The included breakfast was awesome! The breakfast was better than meals purchased out in town.

reviews.title: Homewood Suites
reviews.text: Homewood Suites was excellent and is the greated value in Las Vegas due to no resort fees, free breakfast and free parking. This cannot be beat anywhere in all of Las Vegas. Location, location, location.

reviews.title: Fabulous Stay
reviews.text: This was a great stay my kids loved it and so did we. We are planning a trip soon and we will differently stay hear again. This trip was great and we left very happy and will be back again. Thank everyone for the wonderful stay we had.

reviews.title: Suites n Sync!
reviews.text: I am moving to Las Vegas via a job transfer. Though Vegas is a very exciting city, I needed a temporary quite place to call home while house hunting. I couldn't have been more impressed with this hotel. At check-in we were greeted with a smile by Shayla at the front desk she made us feel right at home. Then there was Anthony he gets you to and from the strip with ease. Alex the late auditor has to be one of the best night personnel  I've ever met. He's literally kind to everyone even the hotel staff agrees. If I had to score him he'd get a 10 for sure. A big congrats to the management staff for hiring such a great team.  This Homewood Suite has it all in sync. B Vann

reviews.title: My stay
reviews.text: My stay @ Homewood Suites by Hilton was stellar.  I loved there was breakfast and dinner served.  My room was clean, and the hotel was full but it was very quiet there.  I already have 3 more trips planned and will be staying at this hotel.  Patrick at the front desk made my experience even more memorable!!  Thank you

reviews.title: Don't bother with the shuttle!
reviews.text: Shuttle runs an hour or more late, and some of the desk staff are unpleasant! Hot tub and pool area was very nice. Breakfast was ok but always low on items. Evening social is a waste of time. Qorste Homewood suits I have been to by far. But ut is giod for off the strip with little kids

reviews.title: Don’t bother staying on the strip
reviews.text: It’s way too expensive and no one gives you free breakfast. This place is less expensive, quieter, cleaner, gives you food and has a free shuttle to multiple strip locations. Way more convenient and better for the price. Save your money and stay with these guys!

reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: Clean and spacious room . Free shuttle to the strip just reserve ahead at front desk . Safe and quiet location for families . There are some restaurants within walking distance. Free ice cold water 24/7 at front desk .

reviews.title: Couldnt tell I was in Las Vegas
reviews.text: For anyone like myself who cringes at the thought of a visit to Las Vegas, this place is a gem.  On a map, it looks like it could be walking distance to the strip, however becuase of the ramp access to the road that crosses the freeway, it is a bit farther than it looks.  It is however only about 4 minutes by Uber. With no casino and no smoking on the property, it feels, sounds and smells completely removed.

reviews.title: Vacation with Grandkids
reviews.text: Overall I would have to say this was a GREAT find as far as Hotels in Vegas are concerned. There was a great assortment of breakfast items, from cereal to sausage to fruit and yogurt (it helps out alot when you have a picky 4 year old with you) The swimming pool was kid-friendly (and there was Alot of kids) the towels were always well stocked and the hotel lobby and pool were clean. It was off the busy strip but not so far that it was inconvenient (Short Taxi or Uber ride) I did NOT give it a 5 due to the fact that the front desk staff was less than inviting, they Barely looked up from their phone/computer. On one of the days housekeeping Totally forgot about us and when I called to ask for towels the front desk clerk seemed VERY IRRITATED. The groundskeepers were friendlier than the 2 female desk clerks, however, on the bright side, parking was FREE and abundant. I would stay here again when traveling with children, I just think Management might want to better train the staff on how to treat Guests.

reviews.title: Never, Ever, Ever, EVER Again!
reviews.text: Trying my best to summarize, but it's still a long read:Booked a 2 bedroom suite (paid more money for that versus 2 studios) and a 1 bedroom suite (also paid more for this than a studio) under one reservation.Had to change the departure dates on one of the rooms, so called the hotel directly and Madyson [sic] was very helpful, and split it into 2 reservations. Received a confirmation e-mail that we were 'all set', and provided a new confirmation number for the second room. Arrived at the hotel. Long story short, they canceled the 1-bedroom (the new reservation mentioned above). Said it was "YOUR FAULT" because we didn't give a credit card number. Ummmmm, I really don't think the onus was on us to make sure the details were covered--I called the hotel directly to make the change--there was no mention of needing a new, second credit card! David, the FD clerk lied and said, "We tried to contact you, but in addition to no credit card in your HiltonHonors (HH) profile, there's no phone number to contact you either". Both are ABSOLUTE lies. You don't spend hundreds of nights at HH properties without a credit card number or phone number in your profile (both were confirmed later by HH customer service). David said he was 'doing us a favor' by reinstating the other room, but would only give us a studio suite. We were charged the rate for a 1-bedroom. On to the second reservation, which was intact, this rude, unapologetic desk agent advised us that they had no 2 bedroom suites available. So, we were given 2 studio suites, on different floors, both about as far from the elevators as possible. No attempt was made to even get us close together...Again, it was a 'big favor' that we even had rooms. I'm not one to throw status around, but I'm a Hilton Diamond, and about 40 nights away from lifetime Diamond...Which means I've spent almost 1000 nights just at Hilton properties in my life. This was by far the rudest, most condescending and off-putting treatment I've ever received. It's not like I was looking for an upgrade...I was looking just to get what we booked.The property never adjusted our rate, nor did they even offer a simple "we're sorry"...Again, everything was our fault. This David guy who handled us--I hope he's gone and out of the hospitality business, because there was NO HOSPITALITY whatsoever.The hotel did nothing to rectify the situation, even when I wrote Hilton Diamond Customer Service after the stay. Finally, Hilton corporate stepped in and gave 2 of us a total of 80,000 HH points and 2 "Be Our Guest" nights (a 'golden ticket' so-to-speak valid for 2 nights anytime, anywhere). Both agents I dealt with at HH corporate said the hotel was out of line, but there wasn't much more they could do themselves, that the onus is on the hotel to make it right. It's a shame, we spent 20+ room-nights there last year, another 20-some this year, and had hoped to go back--we used to like this place--rooms were decent--I even wrote a positive review last yearI also wrote a letter to a VP at Hilton, sending them canceled reservations I had for another 10 nights in April alone around the world, actually--I canceled reservations in Chicago, Philadelphia and in China because I contacted Marriott Bonvoy and am in a Platinum challenge with them, and plan on moving most of my stays to Marriott simply because of this property's drekky customer service. Garbage treatment, and no attempt to rectify by the hotel...You'd be surprised how far a simple "We're sorry" could go, but again, everything was "our fault". But it will be a cold day in he-- before I'd ever consider this property again. I also plan on writing the franchisee's corporate office (Tharldson) that I'll be avoiding ALL of their holdings, regardless of brand/portfolio.

reviews.title: Great New Hotel
reviews.text: I received one of their one bedroom suites. Amazingly clean. Huge tv in living room. Awesome to have a fridge. Bed was more comfortable than the Palazzo. Also cleaner and smelled better than the Palazzo. No smoke coming from the vents like Caesars Palace. No resort fees. I love staying in new hotels and this did not disappoint. Very clean nice bathroom. Some problems with the thermostat, and it was so cold in Vegas when I was there. This was effectively taken care of by compensating appropriately. Great management here, who really care about the guests. I will stay again in the future.

reviews.title: Quiet hotel close to the strip
reviews.text: This hotel is in a really nice place - in a walking distance to the strip and yet far from its noise and action. Pretty much everything in this hotel is complimentary - breakfast, parking, evening snacks, water etc. The rooms are new and clean. Unlike strip hotels it's not crowded so it is definitely much quieter. Breakfast is really good for a North American Hotel, but one day we only had half of the usual assortment - I hope it was not normal. Overall great experience!

reviews.title: Alex is the man
reviews.text: 100% of the time Alex has had our back (nth°) we are really starting to like this place. Thanks for the extreme hospitality! You are making this month long stay feal more like home. I cant wait till later this month to see what else you do!

reviews.title: Best for families with kids
reviews.text: Overall the stay was pretty good. Only request to management is to have both elevators working in peak time. Very convenient for families and close to the casinos, have shuttle to Casinos. breakfast buffet spread was good but gets over fast and refills take a while. Outdoor heated pool is a good.

reviews.title: Perfect for our family
reviews.text: Newer hotel in a great location right off of the strip.  We stayed in a 2-bedroom, 2-bath suite, from Dec. 1-3, 2018.  Room was clean.  In N Out Burger down the street.  Breakfast was ok and the seating area was huge compared to other Homewood Suites we have stayed at.  All employees we encountered were friendly and helpful.  There was plenty of parking and it was free!  No resort fees either.  Did not use their shuttle service.  Overall an excellent stay and will definitely be staying here again next time we are in Vegas.

reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: Enjoyed our overnight stay.  One bedroom suite was comfortable and spacious.  Staff very pleasant and helpful.  Variety of options for breakfast.  Pool appears to be shared with adjoining property.  Pool area and fire pit looks inviting.

reviews.title: Vegas Vacay
reviews.text: This hotel is in a prime location. They offer shuttle service to the Strip and Mall and their shuttle drivers are very informative. Breakfast is complimentary which is great by the way and the staff is the BOMB!!

reviews.title: Perfect Home Away From Home - with an even better breakfast!
reviews.text: This hotel is exceptional! The hot breakfast is delicious and has a great variety. The rooms are thoughtfully appointed and functional for business and personal travel. Shower is hot with good pressure and the kitchen is stocked with all the essentials.

reviews.title: Great for price and accessibility
reviews.text: The hotel was clean and staff was very accessible.  Shuttle provided to the Strip. No hotel pick up from Airport.  Uber and Lyft friendly. Do not take metered taxi from the Airport (almost 2x as much as Uber).

reviews.title: A great non-Strip option in Vegas
reviews.text: We deliberately chose a place away from the Strip, and were so glad we did. Just a little less traffic and a lot less foot traffic. It was still only a 10 minute walk over to the Aria. Getting in and out of the place was much easier too!Our room was quite a hike from the lift, but no matter. The room was clean and very comfortable on all levels. We had easy access to the guest laundry. Breakfast facilities were good and adjacent to the lobby. The hotel put on a icebreaker event a few nights per week around 5pm, which was popular, and this area was also popular with groups catching a football game on the big screen.Car parking was free immediately outside the front door.Only problem we had was the housekeeping seemed to be overworked. We would return from a day walking Vegas wanting a rest around 5pm, only to find our room (and many others) hadn't been cleaned yet. So we had to go out again to give her a free run at the room.

reviews.title: Extremely Satisfied
reviews.text: People, services, and process were great. My stayed 16 days long. They definitely made the stay very comfortable and made my business trip much easier. I will definitely use the same place for any personal trips.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: This has to be one of the best hotels I have stayed at, especially in Las Vegas. It was very clean and the staff was friendly and helpful. I will definitely stay here again when I return to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Viva Las Vegas!
reviews.text: I am always excited to travel to Las Vegas. Homewood offered me a home away from home. The room was exceptionally clean and quiet. I slept great and enjoyed a delicious complimentary breakfast on-site. Good location with great amenities. Loved my stay!

reviews.title: Awesome Hotel!
reviews.text: This Hotel was a great place to stay.The staff was great! Everyone made sure my stay was satisfied.The Ladies, that are in charge of the breakfast were fabulous!!!.Alex....at the Front Desk was fantastic, I loved his friendliness and pleasant smile.I loved the local places he recommended to visit with my friends....and they were great!!....thanks.

reviews.title: Spacious, clean and good service
reviews.text: This is ideal for friends or family sharing. The separate living room with eating area and kitchen is a great convenience, especially if you don't want to eat out all the time. There is also a second TV in the living room, with a multitude of channels available. They serve a nice breakfast buffet, which is included in the room rate. The only issue to be aware of is that to get to the Strip you need to use their free shuttle, which leaves every 30 minutes on request. They will even arrange a shuttle to pick you up after a show from various locations. If you like to walk, it takes about 15 minutes across one of the two bridges nearby. Overall, a good choice if you don't want to pay exorbitant rates on the Strip and still enjoy a decent and spacious accommodation.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Convenient location, away from the noise and high prices, the staybfelt restful. Free frequent shuttle service to Aria, complementary breakfast and social hour. Close to the airport and a variety of food selections.

reviews.title: Friendly Staff!!
reviews.text: We were a little late for breakfast but Cindy in the breakfast area was super friendly and got us some plates of food anyway.  She was very friendly, smiley and helpful!! Accommodations are great for spending time with friends for a girls weekend away.

reviews.title: Friendly, clean, affordable.
reviews.text: Phil was excellent at checking us in and was quick. He let us know of the rides they offer to and from the Aria. The location was perfect, right near the T-Mobile Arena. We did not have to drive far and there was a near Denny's.

reviews.title: Slendiferous Stay In Las Vegas
reviews.text: Impeccable service staff with interpersonal people skills. The residency trip was "Phenomenal." The geographic location is convenient to the Las Vegas Strip...I look forward towards an encore trip to "Let's Do It Again...!

reviews.title: A gem close to strip, convenient, smoke free, no resort fees, free parking.
reviews.text: I stayed here for one night recently with my family and had a great experience.  This is a fine choice if you're like me and don't necessarily want or need to have a casino or bar at your hotel and you don't like walking a mile from the lobby to your room.  I was with my wife and kids and so this was an added plus.  I'm not against casinos, but having a quiet and smoke free place to retreat from the craziness of the strip is a relief.  If you want to go to the strip, it is super easy.  I could about throw a rock to the Aria from where we were. Upon request, free shuttles run every half hour to a couple of places.  You could of course take Uber or taxi as well.  We didn't even bother and walked with our two young kids from the hotel to the Aria and Bellagio in about 10 minutes (took a taxi back to the hotel after everyone wore down).  Very convenient.   This hotel opened in Nov 2017 so everything is new and clean.  We also stayed here for less than cost at one of the big strip hotels and they don't charge the sometimes outrageous resort fees.  We also rented a car at the airport and parking was free and steps away from the lobby in a small parking garage.  Very easy to get luggage to our room.  Added bonus is an in-and-out Burger just a few blocks away.Also, like other Homewood Suites they offer free breakfast and a light dinner most nights.  This can be a huge money saver if you're traveling with your family.  On that point, they have a few different types of rooms.  We were able to get a two bedroom two bath suite with a living area.  The room was very large and comfortable.  One bedroom had a king bed and the other bedroom had two queen beds.  You won't find this type of room on the strip without paying a king's ransom for a penthouse suite of some sort.  Staff at this hotel was also friendly, available and accommodating.  ZERO line to check in or out.  Again, not what you would find at a strip hotelThis was a great stay and would highly recommend to anyone.

reviews.title: Amazing Staff!
reviews.text: This is a great hotel: the rooms are spacious, it's not right on the strip but close enough to walk or take a shuttle, complementary breakfast and evening reception, and every member of staff was SO friendly and welcoming! Especially Shayla at the desk.After a wild night on the town it's nice to come back to something quiet and out of the way. I'll definitely be staying here again.

reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.text: I always stay at stay at HS everywhere I go and we always loved it. Breakfast is always great except the 2  times we stayed in Vegas the food was just ok. First we stayed at the one by the airport and this time at this one and same thing.

reviews.title: BEWARE: Reservation Does NOT Equal a Room!
reviews.text: I had a confirmed reservation, but upon arrival was told they did NOT have a room!  That's right. This hotel improperly gave my room away before I arrived. They claimed they ran a pre-check earlier in the day that determined my credit card was invalid.  What?  I have stellar credit and use that card everywhere. This is impossible. Now my daughter and I are standing tired and with our suitcases, holding a "reservation" that means nothing.  We have no place to stay on a busy holiday weekend in Las Vegas.  Calls were made to numerous other hotels -- No vacancies!  They finally found us a room but at a much pricier hotel chain.  We had never planned for this added expense.  Once we got home I contacted hotel management for an explanation.  They tried to push this off on the credit card company.  Well, get this.  I then phoned the credit card company for an explanation.  OMG!  According to the credit card company, their records indicate SOMEONE AT THE HOTEL had punched one number incorrectly in the expiration date, which is why my card pinged back as "invalid".  This HOTEL ERROR triggered this mess.  I have contacted Homewood Suites and Hilton Corporate and they are refusing to own up to what they did.  Reservation now equals nightmare.  Picture this: You're exhausted from a long flight/drive and have the door shut in our face for something SOMEONE ELSE did.  I understand that mistakes can be made, but their response tells you everything.

reviews.title: 30th Anniversary
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel to celebrate our 30th anniversary. When I called to make the reservation, Alex handled the call. It was because of him that we booked our delightful stay here. On arrival, he presented us with a beautiful arrangement of treats including ice cream, snacks. He is truly an outstanding team member. The breakfast was great, I especially loved the yogurt cups that Cindy made. Cindy made us oatmeal herself one day when they ran out. Two exemplary employees. I loved the pool area and the hot tub. Parking is free and very convenient. The rooms are well appointed, super clean and very spacious. The female hotel manager (sorry I forgot your name) was very generous and excellent at resolving any issues we had. Great hotel. Highly recommend

reviews.title: Beautiful New Homewood
reviews.text: Beautiful new Homewood Suites in Las Vegas, just off the Strip on Dean Martin. Very close to the huge Inn-n-Out Burger on Tropicana Avenue.This hotel will be a great place to stay when the new Raiders stadium is complete. Hotel has free wifi, free breakfast, fitness center, free parking, and free evenning reception. (Sadly they are not allowed to serve beer and wine at this Homewood location)

reviews.title: Run away
reviews.text: Runaway as fast as you can if they try the time where Hilton thing. Talk about high price high pressure sales this is it. Just stay at the Flamingo better location and better food  parking is also a problem so check before you book

reviews.title: Fantastic Leadership and Awesome Teamwork
reviews.text: As good as the entire experience was, the best part was the Homewood Suite Management team led by Monay Asuncion and Asst. operations manager Beverly. Their associates include the following: Kesha, Claudette, Cindy, Dominique, Novel, Josh, Ashley, Shayla, & Brijette. In addition to this team providing us with the best treatment and service we ever received in over 40 years of vacationing in Las Vegas (and we've stayed at the Aria, Palazzo/Venetian, Wynn, Bellagio and many others), their warm family like hospitality is key to the Homewood Suite current & continue success. The hotel's location is ideal and their facilities are second to none!  We loved the kitchen setup, bedroom, bathroom, and living room with two TV's. On top of that, their free daily breakfast and regular social hour food was beautiful.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: I prefer this hotel over the resorts. The rooms are lovely and set up like an apartment in which I adore. Also the hotel was nice clean well taken care better then any hotel I stayed at  for vacation  . Next visit my family and I will be selecting this hotel to stay.

reviews.title: best new hotel
reviews.text: the hotel is very clean and good location. the staff are very friendly and helpful. nice pool and great complimentary breakfast.  there is a shuttle to take you to the Aria hotel, which is very nice.will stay here again.

reviews.title: Unresponsive Staff
reviews.text: There were noisy guests in the room above us.  It was a room of unsupervised kids whose folks must have gone out for the night.  We had a baby with us who could not sleep due to the noise. We called the front desk 3 times and they did nothing.  I had to go up at midnight and knock on the door to tell them to quiet down.  Same thing occurred the next night and my wife went up at 1 AM to quiet them down.  We contacted the front desk multiple times and they did absolutely nothing to address the problem.  I would expect this at a Motel 6 , not at a Hilton property.

reviews.title: Well-designed and classy.  Excellent outdoor pool and hot tub.  Good breakfast.
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for 4 nights in October 2018.  We enjoyed it very much.  It was our first visit to Vegas and we also went to the Grand Canyon. Unfortunately we were given a room with no view (window facing a blank wall nearby) and after checking in, I was too lazy to go back and ask for a different room.  The room, advertised as a suite, was smaller than expected.  It was an L-shaped room with kitchen, but it seemed to be not much bigger than a standard room at most hotels.  The clothes closet felt cramped and difficult to get to, due the layout of the room.  However, the room was well-appointed and attractive.  Bathroom was good.  The free breakfast was much better than average, and included waffle maker, pancake machine, eggs and meats.... and the breakfast seating area was pleasant and spacious.  We often go to outside restaurants for breakfast, especially if there is a Waffle House nearby, but here, we really wanted to eat at the hotel.  The outdoor pool and hot tub are beautiful, partly because the whole complex is brand-spanking-new.  The development consists of 2 hotels and a parking garage, with the parking garage situated in such a way as to reduce the noise from the elevated interstate highway located just across the street.  Clever design.  The parking garage is free to hotel guests, and it's convenient (no long walks).  The outdoor pool is shared by the 2 hotels.  I recommend this place and would stay here again.  Cost is approx. $125 per night.  Added bonus: just a quarter mile down the road, there is a "In-And-Out Burger" fast food restaurant, with gift shop!!

reviews.title: Not getting better
reviews.text: I got to the hotel at 5:15 had to beg to get my room done that should have been done at 3 I waited till 6:30 all they wanted to do was give me a smaller room that was clean never offer to upgrade on my health ins on remember and it didn't seem to matter with them this isn't the first time that I've been there in the rooms haven't been ready haven't been clean or I worked all day came back to my room and still had to wait for the rooms to be cleaned also the food in the restaurant the quality is very poor most of the time it's hard and cold I keep staying here because it's close to where I need to be but I'll probably reconsider that on my next day this is the third time that I've stayed and all three times I've had some sort of problem

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: The hotel was amazing. It was in a great location, close to the strip (driving distance).  Rooms are super clean, fantastic breakfast, great staff. I didn't use the pool but it looked nice and had a small waterfall and there was a hot tub.  The staff were all very nice and helpful.  They have a shuttle that takes you to the Aria which is nice also.  They don't have alcohol so if you are interested in having alcohol at the hotel they have a Hilton Garden in next door that does have happy hour.

reviews.title: Great place to stay for soccer tournament
reviews.text: We stayed over the weekend for a soccer tournament.   Great location, not on the strip with free parking and no resort fees!  The breakfast was the best we've ever had at a hotel.  The rooms were spacious for our family of 6 too.  Staff went above and beyond with all our teams needs.  Highly recommend!!

reviews.title: Wonderful Time
reviews.text: We got in Friday evening and left by Sunday morning. We requested extra towels, blankets, and pillows, all of which were brought in what felt like less than 5 minutes. Staff was amazing. Super professional, friendly, and information of what was nearby. Will definitely be staying again.

reviews.title: Vegas gem.
reviews.text: Very close to the strip, but without all the traffic & noise. Hotel is around the corner from the new Arena. Shuttle service is handy to the strip and back, a short 5 minute ride. Great nights sleep! Good breakfast. Hot tub is a bonus after walking all day.

reviews.title: A Gem off the Strip
reviews.text: Three generations stayed for 3 nights at this hotel to see Vegas and attend an event at the T-Mobile center.1) The staff is always friendly and knowledgeable - they go out of their way to make you feel comfortable and welcome.  Managers, front desk, room service folks and the 'breakfast ladies' are all really wonderful.2) Rooms are CLEAN -- well stocked, and beds are very comfortable.  We had a suite that had a TV in the main living area and also one in the bedroom. 3) Shuttle - the shuttle runs every 30 minutes to the Aria Hotel and Casino.  From there you can easily walk to the strip, the T Mobile events center (inside thru the casinos!)  Easy to arrange - call the front desk and let them know when you need the shuttle.  We found this very convenient and easy to use.4) With kids along, it was nice to stay in a comfortable, roomy hotel without a casino and lots of people wandering around.  We all enjoyed the pool, the (free) breakfast and (free) managers reception in the evenings.  Not only was the food delicious, the menu changed each day and it certainly saved us $$ after eating at other Vegas restaurants.  THANKS HOMEWOOD SUITES!!

reviews.title: Horrible Experience
reviews.text: The hotel is about a mile away from the strip, which is good distance.  The hotel has the worst staff.  The staff is rude and undertrained. Managers do not have a good work ethic.  The front desk girl Jes adds things to the bill which she shouldn't.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: Staff was delightful. Greeted everyone with a smile. Food was fantastic.  Could not get a better location for the price. I would recommend this hotel for a great stay, good location, friendly staff, and great breakfast.

reviews.title: Great hotel for family and double dates!
reviews.text: Their two bedroom suite is perfect for couples we go on double dates in Vegas! As soon as we walked into our suite, we felt comfortable and at ease. The location is also not far from the strip, and their shuttle service made it convenient to travel between the stripe and hotel!

reviews.title: Homewood on Dean Martin, off the Vegas strip
reviews.text: This Hotel was the best rate on a busy weekend, the staff was extremely helpful, free breakfast unlike most casinos, very close to the strip so cheaper Ubers, and the facility was very clean and new.  I will be staying here everytime im in Vegas!

reviews.title: Great place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: I wisely chose Homewood Suites instead of staying at the Aria for my conference.  My bill is half of the Aria without losing any amenities.  Aria is only 8 min away using the complimentary shuttle.  I'll stay here again for business or pleasure travel to Vegas.

reviews.title: Great service staff
reviews.text: Complementary breakfast was good, o the higher end of free / already paid for meals.  But, the thing that most impressed me was Cindy.  For the first time in my nearly 50 years of hotel stays, she was the first to ever politely warn us (well in advance) that they would soon be closing ... and that we were welcome to fill up as much as we like.Rock my world?  No.  But her simple considerate act made my family feel valued imstead of the typical 'get out of my way so I can clean up' that occurs as they approach .  She made us smile.Similarly,  when asking transportation questions at front desk, the staff went out of their way to ask about my family's needs and make sure I understood all the options.  Again... they made us feel like valued guests instead of 'customers'.

reviews.title: GREAT PRICE, VERY CLEAN, AND FREE PARKING
reviews.text: My family and I had a very pleasant stay at the Homewood Suites City Center. We chose this hotel because of the price and because the room could accommodate the 6 of us in one suite. Check in was easy and the room was very clean. Parking was free, unlike many of the hotels on the Strip, and they offered a free shuttle to the Strip with drop off and pickup at the Aria hotel. One morning, we went down late for the free breakfast. I misheard that it ended at 10:30am (it actually ends at 9:30am M-F). There was still food left, but employee Cindy graciously offered us the leftover sausage and biscuits with gravy from the kitchen. The food didn't go to waste, and we had some hot entrees in our bellies. The hotel was also quiet, which I enjoyed. If you have time, hop in their pool, which was virtually empty during our visit. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: 1st time in Vegas
reviews.text: 1st time in Vegas we booked this hotel as an extension of our trip. We had a rental car so the location was perfect. A little off the strip but centrally located and free parking at the mall. Easy access to all the freeways. Check in was quick and easy and the staff at the desk were more than helpful. All the staff we dealt with were very friendly and went out of there was to help us out. The room was perfect as all the Homewood Suites usually are and the price was very reasonable. Would definitely stay again

reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.text: Excellent location and great value. They offer full breakfast every day and evening social Monday -Thursday. Shuttle service to Aria with a little walk to the Cosmopolitan and on to the Las Vegas Strip.

reviews.title: Not bad
reviews.text: Stay away from any room near elevator or rooms above the outside designated smoking area. Each rooms have some type of air vents, I guess for the AC unit. These vents allows smoke from outside to come into your room. I was on the 3rd floor room 319 and could smell it every day. Luckily I spent alot of time away from the room but when I was there it was annoying, and they did not have any other rooms available.

reviews.title: Great hotel in a great location!
reviews.text: Great hotel! Convenient, safe location. Very clean, appears to be relatively new property. Friendly, very accommodating staff. Free shuttle service to and from Aria property. Free complimentary  breakfast including eggs, bacon or sausage, Belgian waffle station, fruit, yogurt, cereals, bread, bagels, pastries, juices, coffee and tea!

reviews.title: Okayy
reviews.text: First let me say the hotel is wonderful for a getaway.. the staff was nice and friendly even down the maintenance... however it’s not a place you stay if you want to be close to the strip... you’ll have to drive or Uber to the middle of the strip cost about $10 per trip.. and you also have to travel to and from airport... the best part about the hotel is there’s no resort fees, they do not ask for a payment upfront and it’s peaceful from all the mayhem going on the strip!

reviews.title: Great vacation/business trip
reviews.text: Had to stay here a month, stay was good except for the noisy people in the room above us. Breakfast was awesome, evening social needs more variety, each week they served the same thing but food  was good either way

reviews.title: What a relief...
reviews.text: Due to a mix-up, my business trip started out as a nightmare when I could not get into the hotel where my company had made my reservation. The company had to find another hotel for me right away.I was able to get into the Homewood Suites. I was grateful. This is the 3rd time I've stayed at  a Homewood Suites in various cities and have always been extremely happy with my stay. From the staff to the rooms to the amenities, it met my needs quite well.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: I stay here when I'm in town for work and it's a great home away from home. Great staff, free hot breakfast, well-equipped gym and the suites have nice little mini-kitchens. I've tried a couple of hotels in the area for business travel and this is far and away my favorite in this price range.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel because we were going to Vegas for a wedding and family time.  We were not going to gamble or hang out on the strip.  However, you can get the best of both worlds by staying here.  It is relatively new, it's clean and the staff is friendly.  All rooms are suites so you can maximize space per dollar.  The great thing is that you are not much more than walking distance from the strip, the mall, and other attractions.  Parking is easy in the on site garage and there is no traffic in the area.  It's a great place to stay.

reviews.title: Sleepless in Las Vegas
reviews.text: This hotel is less than 1 year old. Looked very nice and clean inside. Thought it would be a great experience,  HA HA, BEDS so UNCOMFORTABLE,  could not sleep.  We were a family of 2 adults  and 4 kids, nowhere else to stay this last weekend.  Then the breakfast that was included was not fit to eat. We went out for breakfast instead. But nice pool for the kids to enjoy. Definitely will not be staying here again.

reviews.title: Hiton
reviews.text: Being a Hilton Team Member, plus never ever stayed at a Homewood suites. I needed a 1 night stay since my hot water tank back at my apartment decided to go out. My apartment complex gave me $200 to get a hotel for the night. I knew that I wouldn’t even have to spend no more then $35 since I get discounted rates. During check in the nice lady welcomed me and asked what Hilton do I work at. We begin talking and she got me checked in to room 405. She explained how the breakfast worked and that there’s an on-site restaurant at the holiday inn next door. I told her I will be missing breakfast since I have to be at work by 5am the next day. She said well let us know if u need anything during your stay. I then headed to my room 405. As I usually like to check-in on the Hilton app, but I had problems saying I still need to stop by the front desk. Which is no issue on my end. Upon walking into room 405, I was amazed to see a fully stocked kitchen with your electric strobe, full fridge/freezer, sink, dish washer. Then you have your living room with a pull out couch and a chair. Going on into the main bedroom which you have your 2 queen beds and connected is the bathroom with a separate area for the toilet & shower. The one complaint I do have but it really didn’t bother me was the size of the closet. You have you barn closet doors but only one side opened up making it hard to get the iron board out to iron my clothes for work the next day. I’m not sure if this is just a problem in my room or what. I also had another complaint is the light switch in the bedroom only runs the ceiling fan. To me, the ceiling fan should also have a light on it or put in another light switch for the bed lamp between the beds. No big issue, but if you are coming in late at night from the strip you want to just turn on the lights and get ready for bed. Overall, I really enjoyed my stay at the Homewood Suites Las Vegas City Center. I will differently stay here if I ever need another room.

reviews.title: LAS VEGAS HOMEWOOD SUITES IS GREAT
reviews.text: A comfortable stay very close to the strip.  Very quite and well appointed rooms.  Complimentary breakfast and evening social (Non-alcoholic).  The elevators are clean, quick, and large.  I really enjoyed my stay in this Las Vegas property.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel, great staff
reviews.text: This is a clean, nice hotel.  The suites are very nice and comfortable.  The staff were very nice and extremely helpful and caring.  Breakfast was good and the staff made sure that we were happy with the food.  The hotel was very clean and stylish.

reviews.title: Wonderful new hotel
reviews.text: We loved this new hotel just a block or so off the strip, which made it quiet.  The shuttle was available to take you and pick you up, and we didn't have to wait long.  When we had trouble getting a shuttle ride we had prebooked from the airport, they called the hotel, and the manager, who was just getting off his shift, came and transported us.  The staff was very helpful.  We loved the pool and hot tub area, and used it almost every day.  There were nice places to sit outside.  Breakfast was very good and so was the social hour - enough food for a dinner for us.  Only disappointment was that the hotel didn't have a liquor license, so there was no wine and beer as advertised.  We had been counting on that.  Don't hesitate to stay off the strip and skip the crowds.

reviews.title: Great New Location
reviews.text: This Homewood Suites is right off the freeway and right across from the T Mobile Arena, took less than 5 minutes to get there and back for a concert.  The two room suite slept 6 of us very comfortably.  Will stay there again!

reviews.title: Quiet, Clean, Reasonable Rates, Friendly Staff
reviews.text: I stayed there for a week in August. The room was immaculate, spacious, quiet, and appeared to be new. The room was much nicer than those of high-rise hotels I've stayed at along the Vegas Strip in the past. The bed was super comfortable. Very friendly staff. The continental breakfast was better than what I usually experience at other hotels. They offer a free shuttle service to the Vegas Strip (although I chose the ten minute walk every day, just for the exercise).  I definitely recommend Homewood Suites, especially for those looking to stay a walking distance away from the hustle and bustle.

reviews.title: This is a really great hotel for the family if you want a little peace and quiet from he strip.
reviews.text: Close enough to the strip to be handy, far enough away to get some peace and quiet. A group of 6, all ages were there for 9 days for various basketball tournaments and this was a fantastic place to stay. Clean, small, great staff, and central to everywhere we needed to be. Also fantastic is there are no resort fees that you have to pay on the strip at their hotels and then never use. We will be staying there everytime we come to Vegas.

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Stayed here for 4 nights in June whilst using Vegas on a road trip to California. I couldn't fault the hotel in anyway what so ever. So close to strip the free was very handy but only $6-7 in cab. The free breakfast was an added bonus - will definately return and stay for 10 days when I  visit Vegas next year.100% value for money

reviews.title: walk up.
reviews.text: walked in without reservation, wonderful experience checking in later at night. I typically stay at Homewood Suites in Vegas as it's a non gaming hotel and with the same price a nicer overall experience than other brands.

reviews.title: Nice Hotel for Family
reviews.text: Great free breakfast and complimentary evening social. Availability of the shuttle service is nice. There is a mini-market in the hotel. That comes very handy to us. A full kitchen is in the suite. Some staff are not friendly. The pool is a little small.

reviews.title: Still has that brand new feeling but poor breakfast and terrible dinner
reviews.text: Still has that brand new feeling, the staff was very friendly and helpful but the breakfast was pretty poor and the dinner awful. Would be happy to pay for a decent dinner since there is nothing in the neighborhood. The rooms are nice and large.

reviews.title: Great Staff, Location & Hotel
reviews.text: If you are looking for a hotel that is off the strip but still close enough to the strip - this is the hotel for you.  The staff was very friendly and helpful whenever we asked for directions or their opinion on something!!  We used the shuttle service every day to get to the strip and they were always prompt and friendly.  There is an evening social and a free breakfast buffet - only complaint was they were not quick to replenish when the food was out.  Overall a very nice stay.

reviews.title: Peaceful Retreat
reviews.text: But oh so close to the Strip! Super clean suite with super friendly staff. Free breakfast, evening social, parking as well as the free shuttle to the Aria with the coolest driver, Dominique! Shout out to Kevin for making it all work!

reviews.title: Nice staff but.....
reviews.text: Rooms size didn't match the price and breakfast is horrible.  I definitely enjoyed my previous stay at the Hilton next to the westgate 100 x's better.   Better pool, recreation room for kids and my suite was much bigger and I've never spent more than 160 per bought there.

reviews.title: Family Stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Great place to stay for a family with kids who want to swim.  Complimentary breakfast is a plus, felt safe to let kids go eat on their own (unlike a casino). Shuttle over to Aria was nice when you want to go over to strip.  We had dinner delivered by a local restaurant that was convenient and inexpensive.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: This place was by and far the most outstanding venue I have ever stayed at. The staff work extremely hard and it shows. The staff go well above to insure that you have a great experience. There is a beautiful pool with supplied towels and a rock waterfall. Breakfast and supper are served and it is delicious. All staff are personable and seem happy to be there and to help. This place is definitely a gem of the Hilton family. If someone there reads this they will remember me as the guy that was up earlly and telling them how happy I was with their service!

reviews.title: Great value for money and suitable to families.
reviews.text: Great value for money and very suitable to families. Thanks for being helpful and relaxing atmosphere. For sure will recommend to friends and family.           Great location and friendly management. No issues has been faced during the overall visit time.      I

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Free food in morning and evening cheap drinks awesome pool and luxurious roomsThe air gets super cold pool has waterfall effect and the location is very quiet I highly recommend this location to anyone

reviews.title: This is the place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: We loved staying here!  It was close to the strip but not on it so it was quiet and peaceful for a good nights rest.  We were greeted by Alex, the front desk agent, on arrival.  He was friendly and cheerful and made us feel like long lost friends coming to visit.  Every time we saw him during our stay, he made sure he greeted us and asked how we were doing.  Hilton’s lucky to have him.  The motel itself was spacious and very clean.  There were a lot of items in their little guest store.  The breakfast area was clean and well organized and the breakfast items provided were fine.  Housekeeping was also friendly and accommodating.  We didn’t use the pool but a lot of people did.  It also looked well maintained and was a very pretty area.  This will be our go-to lodging in Las Vegas from now on!  Good job, all!

reviews.title: Clean Hotel
reviews.text: Very clean nice hotel. Room was spacious and had a nice shower. Kitchenette had a electric stove.  My only complaint was the breakfast. They only had apple juice and water available to drink. Oatmeal was empty and they didn't refill.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: The rooms were comfortable and had plenty of space.  The salt water pool was excellent.  The quantity of complimentary food was great!  We will definately be staying there again.  It's right off the strip so it's quiet but close to the action.

reviews.title: Full size fridge with a proper freezer!
reviews.text: Close to the strip but far enough away to be nice and quiet. Cooktop, microwave, and a full size fridge makes it easy to do your own thing for food when you're either tired of eating out or when you want to save a bit of money. The free breakfast is pretty good, but the best I can say about the happy hour food is that it's free.

reviews.title: Excellent value just off the strip
reviews.text: Our family, with two teenage boys stayed 5 nights and loved it. The facility is updated, clean and convenient. The breakfast and evening social were awesome. The parking facility is convenient and the staff is great. Convenient to the strip with a car. Shuttle runs on the half hour but you need to reserve it. Would gladly stay again.

reviews.title: I Expected Much Better Especially For A New Hotel
reviews.text: At check in, we found numerous fingernail clippings all over the window sill and floor next to a bed, gross!! The breakfast staff did an extremely poor job keeping up with food in the mornings. Everything kept running out causing long waits for food. We eventually gave up on multiple mornings! Fire alarm went off around 6am one morning waking everyone after a late night, false alarm!

reviews.title: Overall good experience
reviews.text: We enjoyed the Free shuttle the location and the cleanliness of the hotel. The complimentary breakfast was great,  and the service was good also. The rooms were a decent size and very clean, we will definitely return.

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: The hotel is fine primarily because it's brand new and modern.  I was a little surprised at some of the prices in the little market place in comparison to the pricing at the Hilton Garden Inn right next-door. The prices here were so much higher .The parking garage is fine it is shared with the Hilton Garden Inn. Staff is friendly. The gym had the potential to be amazing but there was no attention put into it the night before. For example when I went to the gym very early in the morning there were no Lysol wipes left in the container.  Also, one of the machines had a couple of loose screws .  Overall this place is fine. If pricing is equal and you don't care about breakfast then I would stay at the Hilton Garden Inn next-door as it is just a little bit nicer.

reviews.title: Very Clean & Comfortable
reviews.text: Very nice hotel.  Rooms were spacious & clean. Very close to the strip but away from the lights and immediate action. Close to food and immediate needs.  The kitchenette area was very useful. Perfect location. Will stay again.

reviews.title: Great Off-Strip Location
reviews.text: I was able to walk to the Luxor to catch a show in about thirty minutes from this hotel. It is located on the other side of interstate highway but one can take the Tropicana Ave. to go to the other side. The property is clean, quiet and roomy. I was able to checked in early and leave late. The staff was very friendly. The complimentary breakfast was a little above average. I experienced a minor issue with their AC on the sixth floor. The AC did not seem to be able to pull temperature down below 76F while the outside temperature approaching 110F. I think all the rising hot air was just too much. The climate control should be much better at lower floor. It also happened that the elevators broke for a few hours during my stay. Fortunately, I did not need to run up and down during that time.

reviews.title: Great 1st Stay for family 6+1 Nephew
reviews.text: 2 bedroom/2 bath suite was perfect for my family. Spacious and super clean everyday with housekeeping. Room smelled brand new when entered. Ages ranged from 48 to 17 for all 7 of us and we had no issues with space even with luggage with the 2 bedroom.  Close enough to strip but not to walk. Take free hotel shuttle to Aria hotel if not driving. Loved the more calmer environment to take break from strip action with kids. Definitely family friendly but not over run with children.Free hot breakfast downstairs was not hectic and more than enough for everyone. Free covered parking garage shaded my car from that Vegas heat and quiet hallways made for good sleep.No SMOKING anywhere inside yes!! Kitchen had all the essentials utensils and appliances  stocked. All you need is to buy your groceries. Felt safe coming back in late evenings. Don't miss social hours. No alcohol served but good munchies and refreshing beverages free to guests.Going to Vegas as a couple I would prefer to stay on the strip but bringing the whole family for a quick vacay it was a oasis for us and we will return.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Beautiful rooms, extremely clean and well kept. Enjoyed the pool and fitness center. Complimentary breakfast had many options  however too many guests to accommodate everyone,  not a big deal for us...as long as we had our coffee and we did. We will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Really great
reviews.text: A great hostel which is so close to the strip with free shuttle. The staff is really good with us and available for all.The only small thing is to cross the highway to go to the other side, the one which is to make some stuff and playing in casino. It's not so far away, but by walk it's boring with the weather's heat ;) no matters, our room was clean, with air conditioning, and the cleanliness is high. The rooms aren't noisy, we can't ear our neighbour's. And for the rest it's quite important. The food is excellent and various, and breakfast are changing every day. Really appreciable of course. If I come back one day, I hope to return here, it's not expensive if you're some guys.You have my own 5 stars! Karl, the bearded guy. See you soon

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: Lovely new hotel with nice employees and a great breakfast.  We enjoyed the pool and location.  Highly recommend!!! Very pleased with our choice in Las Vegas.  I have never had a hotel room with a ceiling fan and FULL kitchen.

reviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL STAY!
reviews.text: Great new hotel, comfy beds, very clean suite & bathroom, felt safe day and night (walked to strip the night we arrived around midnight & it took about 15-20 mins to walk there), breakfast just ok(they ran out of food & staff refused to make more). Not a problem..caught Uber later that night to Albertsons & bought breakfast items for the duration of our stay and I cooked for the ladies each morning in that wonderful full kitchen of ours & it was much better than hotel breakfast anyway...problem solved! Free shuttle service  from airport great..shout out to Anthony!!! They do not offer free shuttle service to or from airport anymore and that started on June 1, 2018. Nobody told us this and we did not know this until we checked out of the hotel and needed to get back to the airport to go home. The guy at the front desk on that Sunday morning was not very accommodating to that mishap and did not handle us properly but eventually a cab was called and we ended our trip on a sour note. I called the hotel the next day which was first thing Monday morning and spoke with the manager Kevin Hill. He was so nice, understanding and was very apologetic for how we were mishandled on Sunday by his employee. He made it right and I'm forever grateful! Thanks Kevin! Free shuttle to & from strip was great! Be sure to reserve shuttle service the night before with the front desk for the next day. If for any reason you have to catch Uber or a cab to the aria on the strip it's only $5.97. We were in a hurry and excited to hit the strip and didn't want to wait on our free shuttle so that was on us lol. Our suite was cleaned daily and always had plenty of towels for 6 people. Overall, this was an exceptional hotel less than a mile from the strip! You will NOT regret staying here! Book it today! We will DEFINITELY be back! We enjoyed Vegas!#GIRLSTRIP2018

reviews.title: Great Tour Guide
reviews.text: It was a really nice trip. The hotel was nice and the room is lovely for me and my family. I'm happy we were just a couple a mile away from the strip. I love how the city light up at night, it like a big bulb. Plus the tour guide for the Gray Line bus was excellent driver. The bus driver Devin Jones tell us everything about Las Vegas, Boulder City, Hoover Dam, Grand Crayon AZ, and Los Angles CA. He also told us to the Pacific bay to see the Pacific ocean, it was wonderful. Devin Jones is a great person. My family experiences a lot on the western section of the state. I hope next time we visit the hotel again.

reviews.title: Week of beauty!
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful! Very clean ! I loved the breakfast every morning and the social every eve!!! I would definitely come back here for  trip!  It was a very convenient hotel to stay in due to it being right next to the strip! Wonderful place to stay for vacation or business!

reviews.title: A home outside of home
reviews.text: Flew in from Melbourne and shall be staying for 17 days. Had to write this review after our 6th day stay.This hotel is not rated 5 star but the service certainly is more than 5 star.Reception - 24 hours and everyone was friendly and helpfulkitchen - free good selection of breakfast and the big bonus is their social evening where they serve light meals. Cindy was excellent she came up to us almost everyday to ask if everything was alrightshuttle bus - not on the strip but the shuttle service was great. it is near enough that if you uber it wont cost you muchlaundry facilities with dryereven the housekeeping ladies were warm and always have a smile for us. Lori took care of our section but the other girl was also super helpfulthe hotel even do our groceries for us at cost. we just have to give them a grocery list. Can you get that in the 5 STAR hotel????We are in Vegas for 45 days. We had to stay near to Rio for the most part of our stay due to WSOP tournament. Managed to find this gem accidentally...but glad I did. Will come back again for more days next year. The owners have their mission right. The management team is also commendable as all your employees top to bottom embraces the mission. Love the rooms, amenities, buffet breakfast, social evenings, just about everything that you offer. Last but not least it is the employees who made the difference. KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: Hotel is new. Location is convenient. Hotel is in the opposite side of the highway from the strip, but only about a mile from the strip. We didn't mind because we preferred a quiet area and we had a car. Hotel is mostly clean but the carpet needs attention/cleaning. The room is mostly fine - the bed and sofa are comfortable, the kitchen is well stocked, and bathroom is clean. Our biggest complaints are the poor service and elevators breaking down two days in a row. Our room did not get cleaned two days in a row, despite the fact that we left our room before 12:30 pm each day, did not leave the do not disturb tag on the door when we left, and we informed two different staff that our room was not cleaned the day before (first day) and that we wanted our room cleaned (second day). When we asked to submit a complaint that our room did not get cleaned for two days, despite personally requesting to have our room cleaned with two staff, front desk told us that our do not disturb tag was found on the door (absolutely not true) and  they did not give us the paperwork to submit a complaint.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel.  Broken elevators made for less than ideal stay.
reviews.text: This is a newer hotel just off the strip.  When I arrived, I was told the elevators were broken.  No offer of assistance for my luggage was offered.  I was told my room was on the 4th floor and I would have to use the stairs.  I was told I could leave my luggage in the lobby if I wanted to.  The elevators remained broken and nonfunctional for 2 full days.  This is in Las Vegas which has countless buildings with elevators, leaving me to believe there must be a 24/7 elevator repair company, and the hotel just didn't bother contacting someone who could service the broken elevators on the weekend.  Now for the positives.   My room was great.  The bed was comfortable, internet fast, and room quiet.  It is tastefully decorated and immaculately clean.  Parking in the adjacent ramp was free and always had plenty of empty spots.   Had the elevators worked properly, I would have given this hotel 5 stars.   I just feel that management could have tried harder to fix the elevators in a timely fashion.  Guests with any kind of disability would have had to find another hotel to stay in if they had not been able to have had a room on the first floor for those two days.  The upper floors were completely not ADA accessible during this time.

reviews.title: Love This Hotel!
reviews.text: I have nothing bad to say about this property.  Check-in was fast and easy, and I LOVE the digital key feature.  It was just so convenient to have instead of having a keycard.  From the time we got there, the staff was extremely friendly and welcoming.  They were helpful at all times of the nights that we were there.  We came in late after the clubs and of course, you work up an appetite and the little store they have sells frozen pizzas and the front desk was there to help in a quickness!  I thought it was going to be really difficult to get around because this is a bit off the strip but honestly it wasn’t close to being bad at all.  The shuttle takes you to the Aria every 30 minutes and the walk there isn’t bad either.  The room was perfect in size and obviously very clean because this is a new property.  Free breakfast was also a huge plus, just wish we got there earlier to beat the crowd but it was MDW so it was expected.  I will definitely be booking to stay here again.  I love that it’s away from all of the craziness of the strip but that it’s also easy to get to the strip as well. Thanks to all of the staff!

reviews.title: New hotel off the Las Vegas strip
reviews.text: We were able to book a room for one night due to sudden change in our trip. The hotel is new and the service was very good. There is a shared shuttle between the Hampton and the Hilton Garden Inn. It runs on the 1/2 hour until 11:00 at night leaving you off at the Aria Hotel. . It was a great help as both properties are away from the Las Vegas Strip.

reviews.title: It has everything!
reviews.text: We stayed for 4 days and had very few issues.  The rooms are large and comfortable, with a kitchen that is stocked with basics.  The breakfast was wonderful and they had something different every morning.  The staff are awesome and very responsive and helpful!  It's not right on the strip, but the shuttle helps with getting you over there.  We will definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: This hotel delivers, spacious rooms!
reviews.text: We spent two nights in Vegas at the end of a national park trip in Utah; the suite was very spacious and the kitchen area was well equipped.  There were some maintenance issues with one of the elevators and the breakfast area was slammed with the staff finding it hard to keep up.  The shuttle to the Strip is very handy as the hotel is located adjacent to I-15; it would be a tough walk since the traffic is crazy busy--as other reviewers noted, you do need to be patient on the shuttle. The room next to ours was clearly having a party on the first night but the hotel staff quickly addressed.  The hotel staff was very accommodating to questions and helped with recommendations; would definitely stay here again; appreciated the non-smoking/no casino lobby!  Free parking is great, too.

reviews.title: Great Hotel & Location
reviews.text: Based on the Trip Advisor reviews of this hotel and our past experience with the Hilton brand we selected this hotel as the place to stay while we were in Los Vegas. Our stay here was very enjoyable.  The staff was very friendly and helpful. The facility including the room was new and spotless.  The location for us was great as it was close enough to the strip but away from all the anxiety of the Strip.  The breakfast and social was adequate and typical hotel. If we cameback to Las Vegas we would definitely stay at this Homewood Suites.

reviews.title: Well Worth it!
reviews.text: This trip was a gift for my mom. She's never been to Las Vegas before and my sister and I just wanted to find a hotel that was close to the strip. not only is this hotel close to the strip, but there is a shuttle and on top of that the staff was excellent. We would happily stay here again!

reviews.title: Could be a great place
reviews.text: The staff didn't seem to be engaged in their jobs. The breakfast was OK. On a couple of days the staff was late in setting out the food. This can be frustrating when you have an early meeting. The quality was very inconsistent.

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: Read all the reviews before I booked this property. Reviews were spot on ! This hotel is a great find let me repeat a great fine. Good locations and quiet. Breakfast was good plenty of food during my stay. Room clean and efficient. I refused to pay resorts fee in Vegas really 😑this hotel great price no resort fees 🤗 Staff professional and friendly.  Will definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Good Location & Reliable Product
reviews.text: Good location, just off the strip.  Successful with fulfilling Brands mission.  Perfect for a good nights rest and to take on the days Las Vegas Activites.  Good parking facilities and refreshing pool and hot tub.

reviews.title: New property, free breakfast a mess.
reviews.text: New property close to the action, but clean and quiet.  Free parking and free breakfast.  They COMPLETELY ran out of food Saturday and was told 15-20 minute wait, then manager on duty didn't care/couldn't help.  Next manager Lucas took care of it, but Sunday was almost as bad.

reviews.title: BREAKFAST FOOD RAN OUT!
reviews.text: The breakfast food was all out by 9 am on a Saturday. When questioned why the staff had no idea. It was a major fail by the kitchen staff. The serving area both days was absolutely filthy. Management needs to take notice of the weekend staff.Also stay in rooms 1-10 on all floors. Rooms 11- on have terrible freeway noise.

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Clean and nice. Not too far from strip. First time staying here and it was great. Shuttle and breakfast was great to have. Staff was super nice and helpful. Suite was big and quiet. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Don't miss this hotel!!!
reviews.text: this hotel is at a great location , breakfast is included and it is amazing delicious!, shutte takes you to the strip at a designated location, shuttle drivers are very friendly , the social events are impressive!

reviews.title: Walk or shuttle?
reviews.text: Hotel is clean and quiet with great staff.  Going to the strip was inconvenient and the shuttle service only brings you to the Aria valet on Harmon street.  You can walk that in 15 minutes if you don't want to wait on the shuttle.  Walk north and you'll see an alley to the Harmon street bridge.  Stay on the north side for easier access to the strip.  Homewood shares the shuttle with the Garden Inn next door and pick up starts at the Garden Inn.  You have to give a 30 minute notice to take the shuttle.
