We gave a 15 minute notice and they denied us and then we watched a half empty van drive away.  The shuttle also rarely left on time or picked you up on time.  Kudos to Jackie though as she was great and very helpful.

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: This site has only been open for a few months so it was very clean and all the staff were friendly and helpful. The suite was spacious and the bed was comfortable. Both the breakfast and afternoon reception foods were tasty and there was a decent variety from day to day.

reviews.title: Worth the stay
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay and would have no problem staying there again. The staff was great the place was very clean and the overall service was great. The hotel is not that far from the main strip but allows some peace from all the fan fair which makes the stay more enjoyable. In addition, I was surprise that they also offered an evening meal at no charge.

reviews.title: Needs Some Improvement and Not Really in "City Center"
reviews.text: Spent a seven nights here last month. I stay about 100 nights/year in hotels, about 30 of those in other Homewoods around the country. I am a HH Diamond member.The property itself is beautiful, brand new construction with a modern, chic feel to it. Rooms very clean, fresh and comfy. My sales team had a total of 2 rooms, a 1BR suite and a 2BR suite. Both were well appointed and of decent size.The 'soft product' is where I think the hotel came up short. First and only Homewood (out of maybe a dozen visited in the last 2 years) to not have any alcohol as part of their evening reception. No beer and wine? Vegas? Really? The evening food was slightly below average from what I've experienced elsewhere (see my review of the Homewood in Newtown, PA and their awesome food). Breakfast wasn't really any better, but very typical of Homewoods--powdered eggs, some fresh fruit, a waffle iron and oatmeal are the highlights, very dry, overcooked meats on days they featured 'meat'. My biggest gripe was their description of calling the hotel "City Center". I don't fathom how they could remotely call this a City Center  hotel. It is across a 10-lane interstate highway from City Center, and it's not like there's a walkway outside of the hotel's door to get to City Center either. (For those that don't know, "City Center" is a very specific part of The Strip that is home to such places as Aria, Vdara, Mandarin Oriental Hotel and other upscale Vegas hotels, shops and condos). To me it's as disingenuous as saying "Oh, San Diego is just a block down the road from Los Angeles". I guess it would take a half hour to walk to the Mandarin Oriental. There was a pretty good, not-very-expensive restaurant nearby called the Blind Pig, about 2 blocks north of the hotel...That was definitely walking distance. Good food, eclectic menu and good service, drinks and specials. We ate there twice.Finally, while this is MY FAULT--I admit, but I'm disappointed in the result. On the last night, I moved from my 1BR suite to the 2nd bedroom of the 2BR suite when one of my team members went home. I know right where I left my sort-of-expensive hoodie, draped over the chair in the kitchen of the 1BR suite I vacated. But in the scramble of moving my luggage over that morning before heading out to work, the hoodie remained in the vacated room and I didn't realize it until 12 hours later when we returned back that evening. (And no, I'd have no reason to have taken it with me to work that day--I was dressed in a suit). Anyway, housekeeping either threw it away or kept it. Nothing returned that night to lost-and-found nor in the subsequent week or so when I continued contact with the hotel.Not sure if I'd return. Tried this place over the much more convenient Embassy Suites next to the Convention Center or the one on Swenson. Again, the hard product was great (room, bedding, lobby, decor), but the soft product left a lot to be desired, especially given the premium they command for rooms over the Embassy Suites in the area.

reviews.title: Location, Relaxation, and Celebration
reviews.text: New hotel that has just recently opened a month or so before my arrival. Location to the Vegas strip was excellent, whether it was a shuttle bus to the Aria, or a short walk across Tropicana Avenue, or a quick Uber pickup. Breakfast was phenomenal each morning. Lounging out by the pool with a place to grill or just relax in the spa were nice additions. Beautiful decor in the entrance and free parking for Hhonors guests. Wi-Fi and full kitchenettes in each room. Very spacious and well maintained. Management was present every day in the lobby or just on deck if needed. One quarter of a mile from the hotel are restaurants or convenience stores.  This stay was very well worth my retirement vacation. My family of 10 were impressed. I am an Hhonors Loyalty Member, so I always review any Hhonors brand before choosing anyplace to stay while traveling. Felt like a resort but minus the resort fees from all of the hotels on the strip. You can take a short walk in either direction to get to the Vegas strip. New parking garage accommodates those with vehicles.  Wi-Fi setup was complimentary and well worth it. Full kitchenettes in each room. Bed was extremely comfortable.  Didn't hear any noise in the hallways during the nights. Spa was very relaxing. Whether you are going to Vegas just for business or leisure or for any celebration, this hotel will not disappoint.

reviews.title: LOVE-LOVE-LOVE
reviews.text: Great price, free parking, delicious free breakfast, great facilities, nice super clean rooms, and AMAZING CUSTOMER SERVICE with free shuttle to the Aria Casino. Did I mention a nice Evening Social?  What else can I say? If I ever go back to Vegas I will stay here again. I requested late check out and the option to leave our vehicle in their parking lot after we checked out  just in case we wanted to explore the city a bit longer. Don't hesitate to book! MY family and I were super pleased! Everybody at the front desk were super attentive, cordial, and  helpful.

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: Pleasant small hotel right off the Strip.  Included parking, wifi and decent breakfast.  Quiet, clean, comfortable and convenient. Very good value.  Staff were terrific.  Nice swimming pool, business computer and printer, snack shop.  Most convenient to have  real refrigerator, sink and microwave in the kitchen.

reviews.title: Perfectly comfortable room, beautiful hotel COLD breakfast
reviews.text: We were very disappointed that breakfast (eggs, meat and potatoes) were stone cold both mornings we stayed. Otherwise it was a wonderfully suited breakfast but cold (not just lukewarm) eggs were very unpleasant. The pool was smaller than expected but the hot tub spacious. Both were pleasant. The lobby and room were both nicely suited. We were surprised there was not a safe in the room for my husbands medication.

reviews.title: You MUST stay here!
reviews.text: Just the perfect spot and perfect amenities. ...complimentary breakfast and evening social add to the experience. The Pool is clear and clean. The suites have all the comforts of home. Top notch staff.

reviews.title: Wonderful Staff
reviews.text: First off let me say that I would have given this hotel a 5 if we didn't have trouble with the cleaning staff on the last night of our stay.  This hotel is situated across the highway from the strip...only a 5 minute shuttle ride to the Aria and the north strip.  The hotel truly is a perfect location if you do not want to be on the strip, in a casino, or in the hustle and bustle of LV.  Pros:close to stripwonderful breakfast(kiddos to Cindy and the weekday breakfast crew)ceiling fan in the roomswonderful desk staff(dealt with most of them...they were all wonderful!)great evening receptionfree shuttle to the stripfree parkingclean and cozynewer hotelcentrally located to various restaurants, LV strip, and shoppingCons:-cleaning crew was subpar---we had to ask EVERYDAY for towels, washcloths,and face towels---we were always short at least two of these daily-on our last evening in LV, when we returned from our excursion, we came back to an unclean room....trash not emptied, towels still in a pile on the floor to be changed out, beds not made or changed, kitchen towels not replaced etc.----This incident is truly our only complaint.  We would not have even complained about the room not being cleaned had it not been for the towels not being replaced and still on the floor and trash not emptied.  We always try to keep the rooms picked up and clean(just practicing home habits), but dirty towels and trash were just not acceptable considering we had been gone since 8:30 in the morning and did not return until after 8:00 that night.We did speak with the night manager and he said he would take care of making the situation right. So other than the last incident, our stay was wonderful and the hotel was great.  I would still recommend this property to anyone to stay!!! This is truly a wonderful  place for families!!

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: I stayed here for a business trip. I am in town pretty often and will likely stay here again even though it is kinda out of my way. This is an excellent hotel. It is very clean, and the rooms are spacious as well.  I love the complimentary breakfast and evening social! The food is good too! The bed was comfortable. The air conditioner worked great! (A good A/C is very important to me). Even the shower has good water pressure. The one thing that really makes this hotel stand out to me is the manager.  He was so friendly and helpful, very informative and attentive!

reviews.title: Very pleased
reviews.text: We stayed here with my daughter's soccer team for a tournament. The hotel staff was very courteous and helpful. The hotel and our room were extremely clean and looked/smelled like they had just recently been upgraded/remodeled. The bed and pillows were very comfortable, and the shower was great. We didn't want to be staying near the hustle and bustle of the strip, so this was a great location. It was only about 5 minutes away via a side street, so close enough, but not noisy. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel
reviews.text: Brand new hotel. Large parking garage on site. Beautifully decorated with numerous lounge areas outside. Staff is kind, friendly and quite attentive. The rooms are comfortable. Breakfast in the morning was your typical fare but very nicely served with a large seating area. Will definitely be back next time in town.

reviews.title: NOT in or at City Center
reviews.text: This property overlooks City Center from across the highway, but it is not located in or at City Center. Shares a nice pool with it's sister property.  Has adequate free parking.   It's a decent newer property, but it's located on Dean Martin (fka Industrial) so other then the a bar and grill a couple doors down, your really on an island unless you cab or rideshare.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: The service was great. Nicole at the front desk is friendly and makes you feel right at home. We had a great experience. Plus saved money by not having to buy breakfast. It's definitely worth the price.

reviews.title: Nice convenient alternative hotel
reviews.text: We stayed here in december and boy did they treat you nice!They were very attentive with us, we got delivered alot of packages, i mean alot, and they were so worried that when we got there for check in, the packages were at the room waiting for us!This hotel is off the strip but a 2 minute drive, took care of that.Good breakfast, and always a hilton room guarantee I will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: You can’t go wrong  with Hilton’s Homewood Suites. This is a new hotel, about a $10 dollar uber ride to the strip but they do have a shuttle van ghat makes runs but ends at 10pm.  Indoor parking garage is free and not very full, Nothing really you can walk too, but just a clean and you rally cant beat the quality of these suites for the price.

reviews.title: Lovely new hotel
reviews.text: If you don't feel the need to be on the strip, then this is an excellent choice for a LV hotel.We like the Hilton brand (booked this one using our HH points), and the layout of the Homewood Suites rooms is excellent.Rooms are large, beds are comfortable, showers are great, and there's a fully equipped kitchen. Check in as smooth and all the staff we encountered were friendly and knowledgeable.We didn't eat breakfast but presumably it would be the same sugary, bland food that most of these hotels have. For us it's not a deal breaker.Also, we find it strange that there are no safes in the room to lock up valuables- so maybe that's something that could be added.Other than that- highly recommend.

reviews.title: Vegas experience
reviews.text: The hotel was clean and staff was friendly and very helpful.. The room was very clean and was perfect for the price.  I would recommend the hotel to family and friends. The hotel provide a shuttle to and from the strip.

reviews.title: Best new surprise and value in Las Vegas
reviews.text: When considering future travel and leisure accommodations in Las Vegas, Homewood Suites by Hilton Las Vegas City Center should be given very consideration. We highly recommend this new facility and have already referenced it to friends, family, and business colleagues.

reviews.title: Quiet near Vegas strip
reviews.text: Great Hilton brand hotel. We stayed in one bedroom suite and it was roomy, private and quiet. Staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Very clean. M-Th they have complimentary snacks. The complimentary hot breakfast was satisfactory (eggs, sausage, waffles, breads, cereals and muffins) but nothing special. Overall a great hotel experience! Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Unprofessional/trained staff
reviews.text: Although the hotel is very new some of the staff is extremely unprofessional and unaware of the high standards that the Hilton brand holds. Never greeted or acknowledged as a member none of the items were given that was supposed to be as a rewards member. The check in took about 8-10 minutes my husband and I was the only ones at the counter during that time. The clerk had taken my ID and CC in the back several times because she didn’t know what to do. Shortly after a guy walked in I had to ask the clerk to turn my CC over as she had my personal information exposed he was looking over the counter, she was unfamiliar with BMG certificates attempted to charge me the full rate until I explained to her the process. They cleaned the room never replenished the towels after taking the old ones and no bathroom tissue. Took the pack and play then when I called once we returned for one they had been given out. There was no utensils for breakfast, cereal no milk and guest just should have to keep asking for things. I can only hope that they get will train their staff better but this was a overall bad experience for me

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: New Hotel that is spacious and within walking distance to most everything.  Great breakfast and nice managers reception.  Convenient to airport.  Staff was very friendly and everything was soooo clean!  Uber was 6 dollars from airport!

reviews.title: Very Good Hilton Stay
reviews.text: Very good and clean hotel. Staff are helpful and accommodating.  Complimentary breakfast and evening social is very helpful esp if you have kids. .  Shuttle services prompt and accommodating.  Director of Sales very warm and gracious.  I will go back fo future stay.

reviews.title: NEW NOV 2017
reviews.text: Hilton did good on this one. Mike the airport shuttle driver is great just call 1st to arrange and the top of the hour drop off / pick up at the Vdara makes the strip ez. Nichole at the front desk is the best at check in. Being new they still need to get breakfast prep worked out but overall one of the best Hilton properties yet.

reviews.title: Extremely poor Breakfast
reviews.text: The complimentary breakfast was horrible. The food, coffee was gross. The eggs and bread were tasteless. The croissants were bitter. The orange juice was very dilute. I have visited many Hilton hotels throughout the country but never had such a horrible experience of breakfast!!

reviews.title: Love Hilton properties...
reviews.text: Loving Hilton properties the always make me and my family feel welcome.We stayed in one of the new properties in Las Vegas call the Homewood suites  it was beautiful ,clean and thr pool was heated with a nice size hot tub. Thanks ladies for the great service.

reviews.title: Phenomenal
reviews.text: This new hotel's appearance is just as stock photos show. The hotel staff are phenomenal and work very hard to do all they can to ensure you have a pleasant stay. I am very picky about appearance and cleanliness of the room and hotel common areas; both of which exceeded my high standards. You will not be disappointed with your stay here. We are very familiar with Las Vegas and do not have a problem being away from the strip; we always rent a car, so this new hotel was exactly what we wanted. We did try the complimentary breakfast while we were here; staff were very helpful and accommodating but breakfast food temperature of hot bar items could use some tweaking; not very hot. Enjoy your stay here.

reviews.title: Fantastic People
reviews.text: This hotel has the nicest people I have ever experienced in all of my travels. Brand new facility and very close to the Strip. The free shuttle service was great and you never have to leave the free parking. We will stay here every time we come to Vegas.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is very nice and new.  It is located right off the strip but the hotel has a shuttle that will take you on the strip.  Also they have shuttle to the airport which is awesome.  All of the staff were very friendly and helpful.  Would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Nice hotel HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!!!
reviews.text: Hotel was nice, clean, and pool was awesome. Continental breakfast was not that great. We had to ask multiple times to keep having things refilled. Customer service included General Manager Kevin was ridiculously horrible to work with. They made a mistake on their end and did nothing to try and correct the problem. Pretty much got told it was my problem to deal with, they couldn't do anything. Sadly I am a Hilton Honors member which didn't seem to matter to them. Sad to see that customer service is non existent now days, even when you are paying good money for something. I will never stay here again because of the way we were treated!

reviews.title: Weekend getaway
reviews.text: We have stayed at many Hilton hotels including Homewood Suites. We were surprised by how this hotel did not meet standards. It was brand new so we were expecting a super clean hotel. Our room was not as fresh and clean. The hallway had a sewer smell as did the lobby. The staff was not friendly. Breakfast was also not the standard found at other Homewood Suites. The best part is the shuttle to the Aria. The driver was friendly and helpful. We will not stay here again.

reviews.title: Great place, good price!
reviews.text: This hotel is brand new, rooms are good and overall clean. The suites are fully equiped and quite nice! Beds are really good, staff is friendly, and is overall a very nice place to stay for a reasonable price. The hotel has a shuttle to the strip that runs every hour until 11pm (I believe it starts running at 10 am) and drops you off at the Aria (which is basically just across the street). The location is pretty good, away from the noise from the Strip, yet a 10-15 min walk to the Aria! I would definitely stay here again.
